rows.title: Business Strategy Intern
rows.descriptionText:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.



Job Description

Programme Eligibility

To join one of our 12-month Internships you must meet one of the following criteria:

You’re currently an undergraduate studying at University and returning to full time education in Autumn 2028You’re looking to gain work experience after completing your A-Levels, an equivalent course or an ApprenticeshipAdditionally, you must also:

Be eligible to work in the UK without restriction for the duration of the internship from Monday 5th July 2027 – Friday 21st July 2028Be able to work in NBCUniversal's Central London office on-site four days per weekWe recommend applying to just one internship role, this helps ensure your application is considered for the opportunity that best matches your interests and skills. Choosing one allows us to focus on what excites you most and where you’ll shine brightest.

What will I be doing?

Assist the SVP Strategy & Insight and Strategy & Business Ops team on multiple tasks for strategic projectsSupport construction of financial models and business cases (e.g., territory launches)Support on analysis and presentations for Execs, Commercial team, All staff meetings, etc. Manage key reporting (sourcing different inputs, critically assessing outputs, timely delivery)Monitor relevant market trends, research and consumer insights, trade news, etc. What will I learn from this opportunity?

Be exposed to senior decision-making from multiple strategic projects with a global reachLearn about the TV & Streaming business of one of the world’s leading media companiesBe at the forefront of media within streaming whilst learning about the wider TV business

Qualifications

What do I need to bring to the role?

Analytical skills, distilling insights from multiple quantitative and qualitative sourcesDemonstrate critical thinking, considering multiple aspects which can impact a strategic and operational decisionAbility to communicate well, summarizing complex information in an easily digestible way for audiences from all seniority levels and from all departmentsWork well under pressure, being able to meet deadlines and prioritise tasksInternship Programme Benefits & Perks

In addition to valuable hands-on experience, UK interns receive a competitive benefits package that supports their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. 

Additional perks include exclusive employee discounts, access to ‘myPerks’ NBCU’s employee programme with opportunities to win tickets to attend movie premieres, swag bundles and more. Plus, you’ll get free streaming access to your favourite platforms like Hayu and NOW TV. 

The responsibilities associated with this position are not limited to the above description and may be modified at any time by the Company. 

Media Group Values

Our business values, Teamwork, Trust, Transparency, Test & Learn are the foundation of who we are and how we work. They guide how we show up every day, how we collaborate, how we make decisions and how we represent the Media Group, both inside and outside The Company. When we lean into these values, we create a culture where everyone can thrive, innovate and do their best work.



Additional Information

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com.

rows.title: Actuarial (General Insurance) Industrial Placement Programme 2027
rows.descriptionText:
Location: London, Farnborough, Birmingham or Whiteley

Start Date: June 2027

Closing date for applications: Sunday 18th October 2026

Insurance is so much more than you think! 

Do you want to discover more about careers that will excite, challenge and inspire you? If so, a Zurich industrial placement could be just what you're looking for.

Forget any preconceptions you have about the insurance industry. Our one-year industrial placements give you a real job with real responsibility and a taste of life working at Zurich.

With plenty of support around you, you’ll experience how your future career might look and help us make a difference to our customers at a time when they need us the most.

Our industrial placements are ideal for students in their penultimate year of study. As well as gaining some great experience, successful completion of your industrial placement in 2027 could lead to you being offered a place on one of our graduate programmes starting in 2028.

What can I look forward to?

From day one, you'll be working on real business challenges that make a genuine difference. Our insurance solutions help protect everyone from individual customers and small businesses to local authorities and some of the world's largest organisations. Behind every insurance policy is a team of actuaries helping to understand risk, make informed decisions, and shape business strategy.

As part of the actuarial team, you'll learn from experienced actuaries and analysts across the UK and our wider global business. You'll be supported every step of the way, starting with a dedicated buddy before you join, who'll help you settle in and answer any questions as you begin your career.

Within our General Insurance business, there are two exciting actuarial pathways:

Actuarial reserving - Help answer one of the most important questions in insurance: how much will future claims cost? You'll use data, statistical techniques, and analytical thinking to predict future outcomes, identify emerging trends, provide valuable business insights, and support capital management decisions. Your work will play a key role in ensuring the long-term strength and stability of the business. Actuarial pricing - Discover how data drives business decisions. You'll help determine the price of insurance products by analysing risk, customer behaviour, and market trends. From improving customer segmentation to developing innovative pricing models and technology, you'll contribute to solutions that keep us competitive while delivering value to customers. 

As well as working alongside qualified actuaries, we also provide internal actuarial training to help you understand some of the other work we do, so you can get insight into work that you may not necessarily get a chance to be involved in.

What’s in it for you? 

As well as joining a company that is passionate about sustainability and our customers, you can expect:

£24,968.58 salary 28 days holiday plus an additional three volunteering days You can request to swap UK bank holidays for days off that have cultural or religious significance to you Full private medical cover 12% company pension contribution Annual company bonus Discounted gym membership Discounted gadget insurance Discounted technology offers 

What you’ll need: 

Although we are a hybrid workforce, you should be within a commutable distance of your assigned office.

Additioanlly, you'll need:

strong mathematical skills, an analytical approach and a high level of numerical aptitudeThe ability to learn new technical skills, feel comfortable working with large amounts of data or information, and have an eye for detail Excellent team-working, communication and interpersonal skills A strong interest in pursuing an actuarial career post-graduation, alongside maintaining office performance the ability to build strong working relationships

Entry Requirements: 

You must be in your penultimate year of study and on course to achieve a 2.1 (or above) in a STEM-related or Economics degree subject at a bachelor's level (or equivalent) A minimum C/4 grade in both English and Maths at GCSE level (or equivalent). A minimum A grade at Mathmatics A-level At least 128 UCAS points from 3 A-Level subjects (or equivalent) You must have an indefinite, full right to work and reside in the UK. We cannot accept applications from those who require sponsorship to work in the UK. You must have resided in the UK for a minimum of three consecutive years. 

Are you ready to create a brighter future?  

At Zurich our brand purpose is to create a brighter future together, for our customers, our partners, our employees and the planet. It’s a promise that for our customers, we will put their needs at the heart of everything we do and for our employees, to grow and develop together. For our partners, to collaborate to create mutual value and for the planet, to drive positive impact by integrating our sustainability work into how we do business. We put our customers at the heart of everything that we do, and we’re looking for like-minded people to join us.

We’re passionate about diversity and inclusion; we want our people to bring the whole of themselves to work. You’ll have every opportunity to use your drive and enthusiasm to innovate the future of Zurich. Everybody is made to feel welcome, different opinions are valued, personal needs are respected, and opportunity is equal for all.

So make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported, Love what you do. Work for us. 

Please note we are unable to progress your application if you don't meet our criteria listed above. Please ensure you have the right to reside and work in the UK before you apply as we are unable to provide sponsorship. You must have resided in the UK for a minimum of three consecutive years in order to apply.

Digital Marketing Manager — Live Events & Entertainment£38K - £45KLondon Office / 3 days in the office and 2 days remote working

We are looking on behalf of our client, a leading producer and curator of live spoken word and entertainment events, bringing some of the biggest names in culture and entertainment to audiences around the world. This is a confidential search and we're not able to disclose the client's name at this stage, but can share full details with suitable candidates once we've had an initial conversation.
Our client has built a reputation as a partner of choice for talent, publishers and agents both in the UK and internationally, with a programming line-up spanning major arena and theatre tours through to online conversations with some of the world's most recognised authors, actors and public figures. They operate across the UK, Europe, the USA, Canada and New Zealand.
A Culture of Equality and CreativityOur client's culture is central to why people join, stay and thrive there. They are dedicated to continuous improvement and self-reflection, with strong commitments to inclusion, the environment and sustainability, and employee wellbeing. They strive to create a working environment that promotes equity, diversity, inclusion and a sense of belonging, where everyone feels empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work in a creative and safe space. rows.title: Marketing Manager

location.linkedinText: Richmond Upon Thames, England, United Kingdom

rows.descriptionText:
Marketing Manager - Richmond Rugby
Would you like to have Richmond Rugby, the Richmond Athletic Ground and a calendar of live sport, major events and community activity as your marketing environment?
This isn't a role where you'll spend your week managing one brand and scheduling social posts. You'll help shape how people experience Richmond Rugby, from discovering a fixture and buying a ticket, to arriving at the RAG, experiencing the match, engaging with the club and receiving that next communication in their inbox.
You'll be marketing men's and women's rugby, six senior and performance teams, Minis and Youth rugby, supporter membership, hospitality, venue hire and major events, from fireworks and outdoor cinemas to seasonal celebrations and everything in between. You'll have the opportunity to build the systems, audience insight, content and campaigns that bring all of it together.
We're not looking for someone to simply keep the marketing wheels turning.
There is a huge opportunity to improve how we understand our audiences, how we communicate with them and how we turn interest into attendance, membership, bookings and revenue. You'll play a significant role in shaping the future of ticketing, CRM, data and automation, helping the club move from broad communications towards smarter, more targeted and more personalised marketing.
You'll help create the campaign that gets people through the gates, then help deliver the experience once they're there. You'll see the content go live, work with sponsors and partners, capture the moments that matter and use the data and feedback afterwards to make the next one better.
Some days you'll be planning a campaign. Other weeks you'll be pitch-side, producing content with players, running live communications or helping bring the RAG to life.
You'll have the opportunity to shape:
1. Brand, Strategy & GrowthOwn the marketing strategy, budgets, campaigns, audiences and performance, connecting marketing activity directly to attendance, participation and revenue.
2. Rugby & MatchdayDrive attendance, ticket sales, membership and the supporter experience across men's, women's and wider rugby. You'll help create compelling fixture campaigns, build matchday themes and offers, support ticketing and hospitality, and help make the experience at the RAG something supporters want to return to.
3. Content & AudienceBuild Richmond Rugby's voice and digital presence across social, web, email and video.You'll work with players, coaches, volunteers and teams to tell the stories that make the club what it is, from first-team rugby through to Minis and Youth. You'll oversee content across the club's channels, including match previews and reports, interviews, player profiles, newsletters, campaigns, short-form video and matchday content.
4. Events & the RAGHelp position the Richmond Athletic Ground as a destination beyond rugby.You'll develop and deliver campaigns for major events, hospitality and year-round venue hire, generating enquiries, bookings and new revenue. That could mean marketing fireworks, seasonal events, celebrations or the many other opportunities that make use of the RAG throughout the year.
5. CRM, Data & DigitalBuild a stronger understanding of our supporters and customers.You'll work across ticketing, CRM, analytics and digital platforms to improve segmentation, customer journeys and automation. You'll use data to understand what is working, where opportunities exist and how marketing can become more targeted and commercially effective.
6. Commercial & PartnershipsWork closely with the Commercial team and sponsors to create campaigns and activations that deliver value for partners and the club. You'll help bring sponsorships to life across digital, email, web, programme and matchday channels, while identifying opportunities to generate new commercial value.
This is a hands-on role.
We're a small marketing team, consisting of this role, supported by a Marketing Executive, so you'll need to be comfortable moving between strategy and execution. You'll work closely with our Rugby Department, Commercial, Operations, Community and Events, as well as sponsors, partners, photographers, volunteers, agencies, external suppliers and matchday freelancers. The role will involve some evening and weekend activity, particularly around senior team training, home fixtures and events.
We're looking for a marketer who combines commercial thinking with creativity.
You'll ideally have experience across a number of the following:Marketing strategy and campaign planningDigital and social mediaContent creation and storytellingTicketing, membership or customer acquisitionCRM and email marketingPaid social and digital advertisingData, analytics and campaign reportingEvents and/or hospitality marketingSponsorship and commercial activationWebsite and SEO managementBrand managementManaging agencies, suppliers or creative partners
This is an opportunity to join a small team and have a genuine influence on how Richmond Rugby and the Richmond Athletic Ground are seen, experienced and remembered.
If you want a marketing role where no two weeks look quite the same and where you can see the impact of your work in real time, we'd love to hear from you.
Please send CV and Covering letter to admin@the-raa.co.uk

rows.title: Media Intelligence & Digital Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
The Media Intelligence & Digital Specialist will be responsible for supporting the Company’s marketing intelligence, digital analytics and emerging technology capabilities. The role will monitor media and competitor activity, analyse campaign and consumer data, support online reputation monitoring and identify opportunities to use AI, automation and digital technologies to improve marketing effectiveness. The position will also support the development and optimisation of the Company’s wider digital ecosystem, including digital platforms, applications and CRM-related activities.
The successful candidate will be an analytical and digitally curious individual who combines strong data capability with an interest in marketing, consumer behaviour and emerging technology. They will be comfortable working with large amounts of information, identifying meaningful patterns and translating analysis into practical recommendations. The role requires someone who is proactive in exploring new technologies and can identify practical applications of AI, automation and digital tools rather than simply reporting data.
ResponsibilitiesKey Responsibilities
Marketing Intelligence & Reporting
• Develop regular reporting covering media performance, campaign effectiveness, competitor activity and market trends.
• Analyse marketing and consumer data to identify trends, opportunities and potential risks.
• Develop dashboards and reporting tools to support effective decision-making.
• Translate complex data into clear and actionable commercial recommendations.
Competitor & Market Intelligence
• Monitor competitor campaigns, media investment, communication strategies and product launches. • Track relevant developments in the automotive and wider consumer market.
• Identify emerging trends that may affect marketing strategy or brand positioning.
• Provide timely competitor and market intelligence to relevant stakeholders.
Brand Reputation Monitoring
• Monitor online conversations, customer feedback, social sentiment and emerging issues.
• Identify potential reputational risks and escalate significant issues appropriately.
• Support Marketing and Communications teams with data and insight relating to brand perception.
• Contribute to early identification and prevention of potential reputation issues.
AI, Automation & Emerging Technology
• Explore practical applications of AI and automation within marketing activities
• Identify opportunities to improve content creation, reporting, data processing and consumer insight through technology.
• Test and evaluate emerging digital tools.
• Support the implementation of solutions that improve marketing efficiency and effectiveness.
Digital Platforms & Ecosystem
• Support the operation and continuous improvement of digital platforms and applications.
• Assist with user experience and digital journey optimisation.
• Support CRM and wider digital ecosystem activities where required.
• Monitor digital performance and recommend opportunities for improvement.
QualificationsKey Requirements
• 1–3 years' experience in digital marketing, marketing analytics, data analytics, marketing technology, research or a related discipline.
• Strong analytical capability and confidence working with data.
• Experience using dashboards, analytics platforms and reporting tools.
• Ability to identify patterns and commercial insights from complex information.
• Strong interest in AI, automation and emerging digital technologies.
• Understanding of digital marketing and consumer behaviour.
• Experience with competitor intelligence or social listening tools is desirable.
• Exposure to CRM, digital platforms or app environments is desirable.
• Strong attention to detail and problem-solving capability.
• Interest in automotive, technology and marketing innovation.

Job Description

This is a 12-month internship opportunity located in Verisk London office starting in June 2027.

Verisk Catastrophe and Risk Solutions (formerly AIR Worldwide) is looking for a highly passionate, motivated individual to join the Consulting and Client Services Group.

As a member of Verisk’s consulting and client services team based in London, you will provide services to our London and international insurance and reinsurance clients. Use your technical, analytical, and project management skills to work with clients to enhance their usage of the Verisk suite of solutions and help troubleshoot any software-related issues.

Responsibilities

You will have the opportunity to learn and gain practical experience in:

Providing day to day client support helping clients use Verisk’s software platforms and understand Verisk’s catastrophe models and their outputProviding training sessions to clients to help them understand and use Verisk’s software and modelsPerforming sophisticated risk analyses using Verisk's cutting-edge technology for insurers, brokers, and other financial intermediaries in the internationally expanding business of catastrophe risk managementAdding value to modelled results through customization of output tailored to the needs of clientsCommunicating directly with clients working on consulting projectsHelping clients reliably assess and manage their catastrophe loss potential through interpretation of modelling results.

Qualifications

Strong analytical and quantitative skills, a solid understanding of probability concepts, excellent problem-solving skills and a commitment to client services.Knowledge of Touchstone and /or Touchstone Re is desirable but not essentialExcellent communication, time management and organizational skills are also required.Experience using Microsoft Office is essential and knowledge and understanding of the insurance/ reinsurance markets is preferred.Ability to code in languages such as SQL, R, Python will be highly beneficial. Knowledge of ArcGIS would be desirable.

Education

A degree in science, engineering or mathematics is preferable.You must have active student status for Internship period.

rows.title: Talent Investor (London) - The Bridge
rows.descriptionText:
Compensation: £54K–£75K base salary, depending on experience, plus performance-based upside.

WHAT IS THE BRIDGE?

The Bridge is the fastest way for Europeans to build massive companies in San Francisco from scratch.

At Entrepreneurs First, we’ve spent over a decade refining how to identify the most talented potential founders around the globe, help them build teams, ideate and raise funds from the world’s best VCs. The portfolio we’ve built this way is now worth over $15bn.

San Francisco is the most competitive startup ecosystem in the world - if you can win there, you can win globally. It has forged the most valuable companies to ever exist; for those that want to build something generational, there’s no better place to found.

That has led us to The Bridge: combining the best European talent with a decade of company-building knowledge, and bringing it to the SF ecosystem. Cohorts of 40-50 founders, living, working and building companies together from scratch, in a house in San Francisco.

8 weeks to go from nothing, to a funded startup.

This will be the place the next $100bn company gets created.

THE ROLE

Find Daniel Ek before he created Spotify. Mark Zuckerberg before Facebook. Whitney Wolfe Herd before Bumble. Patrick Collison before Stripe, when he’s 16 years old winning 1st place at the Irish Young Scientist and Technology Exhibition.

Your job is to identify these outlier individuals before the pivotal moments in their lives, then make sure they reach their potential. Once you’ve found them, help them build a moonshot.

You will learn how ideas become reality, have day-to-day exposure to world-class founders, and directly influence how we deploy millions of dollars every year into founders and teams in Europe and the US.

We’re creating a whole new category - you can be a pioneer.

What You’ll Do

Develop and execute theses on where you can find exceptionally talented individuals early in their career. Where’s the next Homebrew Computer Club?Become a trusted advisor to those individuals - help them unlock their ambition and reach their potential, from advising on career decisions to supporting them in building companies and raising funds.Sharpen your judgment: learn what exceptional founders and world-changing companies look like.Build relationships with experts in a broad range of fields.Be a key influencer in deciding which founders and companies EF invests in.

What This Looks Like

Sourcing talent in Europe: you will spend approximately eight months of the year working intensely on finding great people that we want to invest in. You will source them through doing deep work in both online and in person communities, all across Europe. Shaping talent and companies in San Francisco: you will spend approximately two to three months of the year in San Francisco, supporting the people we’ve invested in, to build their founding teams and figure out the ideas they want to work on. You’ll also help the founders as they raise their first round of investment with the best investors in the world. 

Fundamentally, Your Job Is To Find Exceptional People And Support Them To Build Exceptional Companies. If You Do This Job Well, You Will Become Part Of The Origin Story Of The Iconic Companies Of The Future - To Make This Concrete, Some Examples From Our Portfolio Include

Tractable - a computer vision unicorn, co-founded by Razvan and Alex, the latter joining EF immediately after completing his Computer Science Masters degree at Imperial.Magic Pony Technology - an AI company acquired by Twitter for $150m after just 18 months. Co-founders Rob and Zehan both studied at Imperial, but had never met - Rob was found by a Talent Investor as the first employee at Raspberry Pi.Ochre Bio - an AI drug discovery company co-founded by Jack and Quin. Quin was contacted by a Talent Investor while he was building a treehouse in the jungles of Costa Rica, taking a break after starting his own biotech.Cleo - an AI financial advisor now on a rocketship trajectory with $100m+ ARR. Barney, the founder, was an early employee at a high-growth Fintech in London - our Talent Investing team spent months with him prior to joining EF.Many others - e.g. Gensyn (distributed compute), Neoplants (genetically modified house plants)...

Who We Are

Entrepreneur First (“EF”) has existed for over a decade. We’re a small team within EF spinning out The Bridge, our newest product.

We’re backed by some of the most successful founders and investors in Silicon Valley and beyond. They include Founders Fund, John & Patrick Collison (founders of Stripe), Demis Hassabis (founder of DeepMind & Head of GoogleAI), Mustafa Suleyman (founder of DeepMind & head of MicrosoftAI), Reid Hoffman (founder of Linkedin), Charlie Songhurst (Board member at Meta), Lachy Groom (Founder of Physical Intelligence). They’ve built the biggest companies in the world, and are helping us back the next wave of companies that will shape the next decades of technology.

At The Bridge, we believe that a small number of exceptional people will have an extraordinary impact by creating the companies which shape the future in ways we cannot yet imagine. We exist to identify, and amplify the impact of, these individuals. We do this via our unique approach to company creation, which sees us identify and work with outliers before they even know they’re outliers, right through to the day they prove it. We call this Talent Investing. We’re looking for the next generation of Talent Investors to join us, and enable the world’s most exceptional people to fulfil their potential.

The companies built at EF are now worth over $15bn. They include Cleo (an AI consumer fintech unicorn), Aztec Network (the leading privacy layer for ethereum, backed by a16z), Gensyn (a distributed compute platform unicorn), PolyAI (AI voice agents backed by Khosla), Neptune Robotics (underwater robotics for ship cleaning, backed by Sequoia) and Magdrive (next generation satellite propulsion, backed by Founders Fund).

Who You Are

Early in your career, hungry to learn by doing, and ambitious. You bring around 2-4 years of experience, with a track record of ownership and impact.Intellectually curious: you dig for first principles, self-teach, and range across domainsDriven: you find creative ways through walls; you own your outcomesNetwork builder: you build meaningful relationships with exceptional people, peers and seniors alikeDiscerning judge of talent: high standards; optimistic yet realistic about people’s potentialTech-impact oriented: fascinated by how technology, especially via startups, changes the world

Be eligible to work in the UK without restriction for the duration of the internship from Monday 5th July 2027 – Friday 21st July 2028Be able to work in NBCUniversal's Central London office on-site four days per weekWe recommend applying to just one internship role, this helps ensure your application is considered for the opportunity that best matches your interests and skills. Choosing one allows us to focus on what excites you most and where you’ll shine brightest.

Conduct analysis on revenue performance of content across digital (sales and rentals)Manage regular reportingMonitor and communicate market trendsDatabase managementLiaise with internal and external stakeholdersWhat will I learn from this opportunity?

Technical Skills

Improve your skills and knowledge of Excel, databases and coding

Commercial Acumen

Work on analytical skills and ability to spot and investigate trends

Film Journey 

Learn how a film goes through its lifecycle, from cinema release to home entertainment



Qualifications

What do I need to bring to the role?

Excellent analytical skillsGreat attention to detailStrong organizational skills and ability to effectively prioritizeAdaptability and ability to learn new processes quicklyExperience with Excel/databases/coding (including using VBA, SQL, Python, R) is desirable but not essentialInternship Programme Benefits & Perks

In addition to valuable hands-on experience, UK interns receive a competitive benefits package that supports their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. 

Additional perks include exclusive employee discounts, access to ‘myPerks’ NBCU’s employee programme with opportunities to win tickets to attend movie premieres, swag bundles and more. Plus, you’ll get free streaming access to your favourite platforms like Hayu and NOW TV.

The responsibilities associated with this position are not limited to the above description and may be modified at any time by the Company.

rows.title: Media Intelligence & Digital Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
The Media Intelligence & Digital Specialist will be responsible for supporting the Company’s marketing intelligence, digital analytics and emerging technology capabilities. The role will monitor media and competitor activity, analyse campaign and consumer data, support online reputation monitoring and identify opportunities to use AI, automation and digital technologies to improve marketing effectiveness. The position will also support the development and optimisation of the Company’s wider digital ecosystem, including digital platforms, applications and CRM-related activities.
The successful candidate will be an analytical and digitally curious individual who combines strong data capability with an interest in marketing, consumer behaviour and emerging technology. They will be comfortable working with large amounts of information, identifying meaningful patterns and translating analysis into practical recommendations. The role requires someone who is proactive in exploring new technologies and can identify practical applications of AI, automation and digital tools rather than simply reporting data.
ResponsibilitiesKey Responsibilities
Marketing Intelligence & Reporting
• Develop regular reporting covering media performance, campaign effectiveness, competitor activity and market trends.
• Analyse marketing and consumer data to identify trends, opportunities and potential risks.
• Develop dashboards and reporting tools to support effective decision-making.
• Translate complex data into clear and actionable commercial recommendations.
Competitor & Market Intelligence
• Monitor competitor campaigns, media investment, communication strategies and product launches. • Track relevant developments in the automotive and wider consumer market.
• Identify emerging trends that may affect marketing strategy or brand positioning.
• Provide timely competitor and market intelligence to relevant stakeholders.
Brand Reputation Monitoring
• Monitor online conversations, customer feedback, social sentiment and emerging issues.
• Identify potential reputational risks and escalate significant issues appropriately.
• Support Marketing and Communications teams with data and insight relating to brand perception.
• Contribute to early identification and prevention of potential reputation issues.
AI, Automation & Emerging Technology
• Explore practical applications of AI and automation within marketing activities
• Identify opportunities to improve content creation, reporting, data processing and consumer insight through technology.
• Test and evaluate emerging digital tools.
• Support the implementation of solutions that improve marketing efficiency and effectiveness.
Digital Platforms & Ecosystem
• Support the operation and continuous improvement of digital platforms and applications.
• Assist with user experience and digital journey optimisation.
• Support CRM and wider digital ecosystem activities where required.
• Monitor digital performance and recommend opportunities for improvement.
QualificationsKey Requirements
• 1–3 years' experience in digital marketing, marketing analytics, data analytics, marketing technology, research or a related discipline.
• Strong analytical capability and confidence working with data.
• Experience using dashboards, analytics platforms and reporting tools.
• Ability to identify patterns and commercial insights from complex information.
• Strong interest in AI, automation and emerging digital technologies.
• Understanding of digital marketing and consumer behaviour.
• Experience with competitor intelligence or social listening tools is desirable.
• Exposure to CRM, digital platforms or app environments is desirable.
• Strong attention to detail and problem-solving capability.
• Interest in automotive, technology and marketing innovation.

The role will monitor media and competitor activity, analyse campaign and consumer data, support online reputation monitoring and identify opportunities to use AI, automation and digital technologies to improve marketing effectiveness. The position will also support the development and optimisation of the Company’s wider digital ecosystem, including digital platforms, applications and CRM-related activities.
The successful candidate will be an analytical and digitally curious individual who combines strong data capability with an interest in marketing, consumer behaviour and emerging technology. They will be comfortable working with large amounts of information, identifying meaningful patterns and translating analysis into practical recommendations. The role requires someone who is proactive in exploring new technologies and can identify practical applications of AI, automation and digital tools rather than simply reporting data.
ResponsibilitiesKey Responsibilities
Marketing Intelligence & Reporting
• Develop regular reporting covering media performance, campaign effectiveness, competitor activity and market trends.
• Analyse marketing and consumer data to identify trends, opportunities and potential risks.
• Develop dashboards and reporting tools to support effective decision-making.
• Translate complex data into clear and actionable commercial recommendations.
Competitor & Market Intelligence
• Monitor competitor campaigns, media investment, communication strategies and product launches. • Track relevant developments in the automotive and wider consumer market.
• Identify emerging trends that may affect marketing strategy or brand positioning.
• Provide timely competitor and market intelligence to relevant stakeholders.
Brand Reputation Monitoring
• Monitor online conversations, customer feedback, social sentiment and emerging issues.
• Identify potential reputational risks and escalate significant issues appropriately.
• Support Marketing and Communications teams with data and insight relating to brand perception.
• Contribute to early identification and prevention of potential reputation issues.
AI, Automation & Emerging Technology
• Explore practical applications of AI and automation within marketing activities
• Identify opportunities to improve content creation, reporting, data processing and consumer insight through technology.
• Test and evaluate emerging digital tools.
• Support the implementation of solutions that improve marketing efficiency and effectiveness.
Digital Platforms & Ecosystem
• Support the operation and continuous improvement of digital platforms and applications.
• Assist with user experience and digital journey optimisation.
• Support CRM and wider digital ecosystem activities where required.
• Monitor digital performance and recommend opportunities for improvement.
QualificationsKey Requirements
• 1–3 years' experience in digital marketing, marketing analytics, data analytics, marketing technology, research or a related discipline.
• Strong analytical capability and confidence working with data.
• Experience using dashboards, analytics platforms and reporting tools.
• Ability to identify patterns and commercial insights from complex information.
• Strong interest in AI, automation and emerging digital technologies.
• Understanding of digital marketing and consumer behaviour.
• Experience with competitor intelligence or social listening tools is desirable.
• Exposure to CRM, digital platforms or app environments is desirable.
• Strong attention to detail and problem-solving capability.
• Interest in automotive, technology and marketing innovation.

rows.descriptionText:
Junior Finance Analyst | London

Monex is a leading global financial solutions provider, offering a complete set of tools to support business growth and strategic financial operations.

We specialise in FX risk management and international payments, helping corporate and institutional clients design tailored FX solutions to navigate currency volatility with confidence. Our team of FX specialists implement well-considered currency strategies, offering dedicated support to help clients manage their payment needs – whether for goods, services, or direct investments.

In 2023, Monex facilitated $309 billion in FX turnover, managed $10.7 billion in assets, and processed 8.5 million transactions. With offices across North America (Canada, the US, and Mexico), Asia (Singapore), and Europe (the UK, Spain, and the Netherlands), we serve over 66,000 clients worldwide.

By combining global reach with deep local market expertise, Monex enhances businesses with a suite of financial solutions and FX market analysis to help optimise efficiency, mitigate currency risk, and protect margins in an increasingly complex financial landscape.

Job Overview

The Jnr Finance Analyst ensures timely billing, accurate invoicing, and effective management of customer accounts, minimizing bad debt while optimising cash flow.

The role involves a combination of billing management, credit control, accounts reconciliation, and customer relations.

Invoicing

Generate, verify, and process accurate customer invoices on time, ensuring compliance with company policies and client contracts.Maintain and update billing systems, records, and processes to improve efficiency.Resolve discrepancies in billing records or customer accounts.

Revenue Assurance

Ensure all billable products/activities are captured and invoiced correctly to avoid revenue leakage.Work with various internal teams (sales, finance, and operations) to verify data for accurate invoicing.

Reporting

Generate monthly, quarterly, and yearly billing reports for management review.Provide analysis on billing trends, revenue performance, and outstanding accounts

System Maintenance

Maintain the integrity of billing systems, update billing rates or charges, and assist in system enhancements or implementations.

Debt Collection

Monitor and manage outstanding customer accounts to ensure timely payment.Follow up on overdue invoices and take necessary action (e.g., reminder emails, calls).Negotiate payment plans if necessary, ensuring they align with company policies.

Credit Risk Assessment

Evaluate new and existing customers’ creditworthiness by analysing financial statements, credit reports, and payment histories.Set appropriate credit limits based on risk assessments.

Accounts Reconciliation

Reconcile customer accounts, ensuring payments are correctly allocated and discrepancies resolved.Investigate and resolve payment disputes, working with internal and external stakeholders.

Customer Relationship Management

Build and maintain strong relationships with customers to facilitate collections and resolve billing or payment issues.Serve as the main point of contact for customers regarding their accounts.

Reporting and Analysis

Prepare and present regular reports on outstanding debt, collections performance, and credit exposure.Analyse debtor performance and identify trends to improve cash flow and minimize risk.

Compliance & Internal Controls

Ensure compliance with financial regulations, industry standards, and company policies.Implement and follow internal controls to ensure the integrity of the billing and credit processes.

Key Skills And Experience

2-3 years of experience (Accounting Degree 2:1 preferred)Previous experience of working within in a regulated investment firmUnderstanding of business requirements from experience of working in a commercial environmentAbility to learn new tasks and procedures quicklyExperience in working in a varied and diverse administrative roleThe interest to use technology where appropriate to improve processesThe ability to manage a varied workload through effective organisation skillsKnowledge of Workday

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

rows.title: Graduate Billing Analyst - Finance
rows.descriptionText:
A Bit About Us

At Gamma we provide voice, data, and mobile solutions to businesses across the UK, Germany, Spain, and the Benelux region.

Our people are at the heart of everything we do. When you join us, you’ll be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking team that’s transforming how businesses connect and communicate globally.

We’re growing fast, but we never lose sight of what matters: our people. Whether you're looking to develop your skills, take on new challenges, or make a meaningful impact, Gamma is the place to do it.

What is the role responsible for? 

Billing is a vital and complex part of our business. As a Graduate Billing Data Analyst, you’ll be working in the heart of our business, in a friendly team which is delivering an industry leading standard of support to our customers.

Our work is a mixture of essential monthly billing tasks and development work. For a few days each month the focus is on executing the monthly billing processes, but a lot of our time is spent on improving those processes, adding to them to incorporate new products and services, investigating anomalies in their outputs, and resolving them. We have autonomy over our processes and are responsible for seeing them through from start to finish.

We’re a complex business with multiple products, clients and revenue streams, so our billing team handle large quantities of data from a variety of sources. We take raw data and transform it into clear understandable information to send out to our various stakeholders, be that customers, our Sales, Commercial, Accounts and Product teams or the business as a whole.

What will you be doing day-to-day?

Here are a few examples of what you could be involved with:

Using tools such as SQL, Python and Power BI, to produce consolidated and accurate billing information for our customers and the wider business. The timely reconciliation of suppler invoices. Sharing your understanding of the trends and variances within the data to our accounts team. Provide clear and concise reports and be able to demonstrate an understanding of the data contained within.You’ll be working with our commercial and product teams, understanding the offers they have built for our customers and how these translate to Billing. Continually developing and improving the completeness and efficiency of billing tasks, in conjunction with the wider Billing team.Ensuring that all process documentation is up to date and that knowledge is shared sufficiently within the team to provide a resilient service. 


What You’ll Bring

You don’t need experience in everything listed—but we’re especially keen to hear from people with some of the following skills:

We deal with large and complex data sets, so you’ll be naturally numerateA solid academic background in a STEM subject is strongly preferred. Maths, Physics, Chemistry and Biological Science graduates have traditionally performed well in this role, but we welcome applicants from areas like Data Science, Economics, Engineering and Computer Science.You are likely to have strong skills in Excel or SQL. Experience or knowledge of Python, Power BI, GIT or JIRA would be of use, but we will help you to develop all these skills when you are in the role.Good technical problem-solving skills – you’ll enjoy the challenge of working out how to make things work. You’ll be great at working with others to make things happen and resolve issues.You’ll have strong attention to detailYou will be able to understand complex concepts and be confident about asking questions to deepen your understanding.Based in our central London offices (near to Liverpool Street), this is a hybrid role, and you’ll be required in the office 3 days a week. 


What do we offer you?

25 days annual leave + birthdaySubsidised private medical insurance5.1% matched pension contributionsEnhanced parental leaveLife assurance and Income protectionShare save and incentive plansElectric Vehicle and Cycle schemeEmployee discountsVolunteer day


A few things to note

We require all candidates to be eligible to work in the UK and pass a basic DBS check.

If you don’t meet every requirement but feel you could thrive in this role, we would still encourage you to apply.

Gamma is an equal-opportunity employer committed to building diverse, inclusive teams where everyone feels valued and can be their authentic selves. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, especially those underrepresented in our industry. As a family-friendly employer, we foster a culture of trust, autonomy, and flexibility to support your work-life balance and help you thrive at Gamma.

For recruitment agencies – we have a network of fantastic partners that support us in our hiring from time to time. We’re not looking to increase that network currently, so please don’t send speculative CVs.

rows.title: Consumer Data - Associate Consultant
rows.descriptionText:
The Role

This is an exciting opportunity to join the Data Science & Insight Team as a Data Analyst. We have a wide-ranging client list, working with some of the biggest and most innovative brands in the UK across publishing, retail, financial services, utilities, leisure, gaming, and beyond, helping to support clients with their marketing activities. The team is responsible for the delivery of CACI’s portfolio of data products, which describe people and places in terms of demographics, behaviours, and attitudes.

What You’ll Be Doing

Delivering our Data Products: Either through standard off-the-shelf packages or using complex code to ingest and wrangle client data, the core part of your job will be working to ensure that our clients are able to access and use our data in the most effective way.Interacting with Clients: We work closely with the sales teams and account managers, so you’ll join them in conversations with clients to help them gain deeper insight into their customers.Innovation: We are always looking to develop new techniques and improve the efficiency of our existing processes. You’ll have the chance to join a “lab”, where we work collaboratively in small groups, focused on areas such as Automation, Image Analysis and Generative AI.Data Science and Visualisation: Once you’ve built up your knowledge of our data and processes, we’ll provide you with the opportunities to work on a variety of data science and data visualisation projects, which typically use CACI data in conjunction with information held by clients on their customers to deliver insight and recommendations. These would draw on a range of different software and analytical techniques and include the presentation of findings to external stakeholders.

How We’ll Help You Get Started

You’ll be learning from day one, and we aim to get you delivering projects within a week or so. We’ll train you on the job, so while we expect you to show that you have a great problem-solving mind, we don’t expect you to arrive knowing how to write the code we use day-to-day. The team is fun and close-knit, and you will have as much support as you need from your colleagues, many of whom are also recent graduates.

What We Require Of You

You have a 1st or 2:1 degree in a numerate subjectYou are personable, adaptable, inquisitive and eager to learnYou have a keen eye for detail and qualityYou love solving problemsYou enjoy talking to peopleYou are organised and are comfortable working on several projects at onceYou like to work as part of a team

British Transport Police (BTP) is the national police force for the rail network throughout Great Britain. We are the ‘Guardians of the Railway,’ putting passenger safety at the heart of what we do. Our values are simply: We Care, We Do the Right Thing, We Strive to Be Better Every Day, We Are One BTP, and We Are Proud to Protect. Join us and help create an environment where we can all be our best every day.

The Opportunity

British Transport Police has an exciting opportunity for an NDFU Insight Analyst to join the National Disruption Fusion Unit (NDFU). 

As an NDFU Insight Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in transforming complex data into meaningful insight that helps reduce disruption, improve safety, and support informed decision-making across the railway network. Working as a multi-disciplinary analytical specialist, you will combine intelligence analysis, performance analysis, and data science techniques to develop innovative tactical and strategic products for a wide range of stakeholders.

Using cutting-edge analytical methods and technologies, you will identify emerging trends, uncover opportunities for improvement, and provide evidence-based recommendations that help prevent major disruption events before they occur. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a nationally important function, working at the forefront of analytical innovation to help keep Britain's railways safe, efficient, and moving.

What You'll Be Doing

Designing and delivering innovative national insight products and reports that support decision-making across British Transport Police, Network Rail, and wider industry partners.Analysing complex data sets to identify trends, risks, and opportunities that help reduce disruption, improve railway safety, and enhance network performance.Developing and maintaining interactive dashboards and reporting solutions, including Power BI products, to enable stakeholder self-service and increase automation.Producing high-quality analytical reports with clear findings, evidence-based recommendations, and practical solutions for operational and strategic challenges.Presenting analytical insights to senior leaders and industry stakeholders, translating complex information into concise, impactful briefings and recommendations.Monitoring emerging trends and conducting horizon scanning to identify potential future risks, support continuous improvement, and help prevent major disruption events before they occur.

rows.title: Research Manager - Sampling & Survey Methodology
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Make Your Mark at Ipsos

Do you have expertise in survey research methods and quantitative research principles?

Ipsos is recruiting a Quantitative Research Manager to work within our Probability Surveys Unit (PSU). The PSU designs and manages some of the largest and most technically complex government studies.

This is an exciting opportunity for a quantitative researcher skilled in survey methodology, sampling and weighting. We are seeking someone with Knowledge of sampling and/or weighting approaches used in social, public affairs, market or academic research and experience working with large datasets and using SPSS, R, Stata or similar statistical software.

What is in it for you?

You Will Get The Opportunity To

Play a key role in designing and deliver high-quality random probability work through our online probability panel the KnowledgePanel as well as ad-hoc research. Contribute to the design, implementation and continuous improvement of survey methodologiesChallenge existing processes and seek to develop innovative improvements.Get exposure to the entire breath of Ipsos policy research, from politics, to public services, employment and welfare, transport, climate change and energy, societal attitudes and many more. 

The role

Role

These are the types of things you can expect to be doing during your day to day, though, as Ipsos is a dynamic organisation, we would encourage you to shape the role as other opportunities arise:

Working with the UK KnowledgePanel, Ipsos’s online random probability panel, to create sampling frames and draw random probability samples to maintain nationally representative samples.Supporting our Probability Surveys Unit to deliver large, complex probability surveys through sampling, weighting and methodological innovation.Collating and managing population data from official ONS statistics and other large scale probability surveys to support weighting methods.Writing clear and concise technical reports, documenting your activities, setting out objectives, challenges and solutions.Explaining complex methods clearly to clients and other non-technical colleagues.Work with junior staff to help develop their methodological and statistical skills.Lead and contribute to innovation work, keeping abreast of new relevant developments and aiming to continually improve processes and qualityContributing to the design of experimental approaches to deliver methodological innovations and efficiencies.You will use Ipsos’ in-house AI to support your work and help to develop AI agentic solutions.You will be supported by experienced staff who will provide support and guidance.

Essential Skills

Strong understanding of survey research methods and quantitative research principles.Knowledge of sampling and/or weighting approaches used in social, public affairs, market or academic research.Experience working with large datasets and using SPSS, R, Stata or similar statistical software.Strong statistical aptitude and confidence working with quantitative data.Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously, while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.Degree-level qualification or above in a quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Social Research Methods, Mathematics, Economics, Psychology, Data Science or a related subject, or equivalent relevant experience.

Desirable Skills

Experience designing or implementing survey samples for probability-based or random probability studies.Experience developing, applying or evaluating survey weights.Understanding of survey error, non-response bias, coverage error and weighting adjustment techniques.Experience working with online panels, longitudinal studies or official statistics.Experience of process automation, reproducible workflows, scripting or systems development. Experience developing technical documentation, methodological reports or survey standards.Experience contributing methodological expertise to proposals, bids or client presentations.Knowledge of multivariate statistical techniques and survey data analysis e.g. factor analysis, clustering, regressions, multilevel models

Benefits

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you as an individual. Our standard benefits include 25 days annual leave, pension contribution, income protection and life assurance. In addition, there are a range health & wellbeing, financial benefits and professional development opportunities.

We have a hybrid approach to work and ask people to be in the office or with clients for 3 days per week. We appreciate you may have commitments outside of work and will consider flexible working applications - please highlight what you are looking for when you make your application.

We are committed to equality, treating people fairly, promoting a positive and inclusive working environment and ensuring we have diversity of people and views. We recognise that this is important for our business success - a more diverse workforce will enable us to better reflect and understand the world we research and ultimately deliver better research and insight to our clients. We are proud to be a member of the Disability Confident scheme, certified as a Level 2 Disability Confident Employer. We provide an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Your application will be reviewed by someone from our Talent Team who will be in touch either way to let you know the outcome.

Ready to have an impact? Apply now!

About Us

Ipsos is one of the world’s largest research companies and currently the only one primarily managed by researchers, ranking as a #1 full-service research organization for four consecutive years. With over 75 different data-driven solutions, and presence in 90 markets, Ipsos brings together research, implementation, methodological, and subject-matter experts from around the world, combining thematic and technical experts to deliver top-quality research and insights. Simply speaking, we help the biggest companies solve some of their biggest problems, serving more than 5000 clients across the globe by providing research, data, and insights on their target markets. And we are proud of our continuous efforts in making Ipsos the best place to work!

About The Team

The Public Affairs Service Line is the world leader in Social and Opinion Research.We work with clients on political and public opinion polling, citizen and stakeholder management, social policy improvement, sustainable development strategy and identifying societal trends and perceptions across several sectors.We assess how government and public affairs policies as well as societal trends and views impact our client’s brand/products/markets.

Overview Of Role

The Asset Data and Planning Analyst is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and effective use of asset management data to support safe, reliable, and efficient asset delivery and maintenance. The role provides expert guidance on Asset Management Information Systems (AMIS), including delivering training to London Trams staff and ensuring system controls align with industry best practice and TfL standards. Through the management of asset data across its full life cycle—from creation and maintenance through to decommissioning—the post holder ensures asset records, maintenance regimes, and work plans are correctly structured, approved, and loaded into asset management systems such as Ellipse and Maximo via the Asset Data Management Function.

The role supports strategic and operational planning by producing scheduled asset plans, managing daily failure reporting and corrective work orders, and chairing daily and weekly planning and performance meetings with senior managers and delivery teams.

 Accountable developing guidance and delivery of AMIS training to LT staff. Develop and ensure system control in line with good industry practice and TfL standards. Run LT Daily failure meetings managing daily failure reporting with Senior Infrastructure and Asset Manager's. Schedule asset management data to produce weekly work packages from weekly to three year schedules. Manage weekly planning meetings with Asset Delivery Managers on their weekly to three yearly work plans/packages. Prepare asset data changes ensuring asset data is in the correct format for load and meets the data integrity rules and ensure data changes are correctly loaded into the Asset Management System(s). Ensure asset records and associated data attributes are accurately registered / decommissioned in the asset and associated systems. Review and approve asset data changes submitted by projects and maintenance to ensure accuracy and completeness. Supports the Asset Manager Accountable for preparation of asset maintenance data with Asset Manager's including handover including Maintenance Regimes, Standard Jobs, Work Groups). opportunities

Knowledge of TfL Project Management processes with a specific focus on asset data deliverable requirements and timings. Knowledge of the Asset Data Structure (including associated maintenance regime data) in the Asset Management System(s) (Ellipse, Maximo, FDM) and an appreciation of how the Asset Management System(s) support the asset management processes. Basic technical knowledge of the physical assets managed in Trams or Railway environment.

Experience

 

 Experience of working with Asset Planning Processes and reporting tools (FDM, BOXI, Axiom, Power BI etc..) Experience with Asset Maintenance Systems and Asset Data within similar in an engineering environment. (Ellipse/Maximo) Experience of using Asset Management System(s) asset registers.

rows.descriptionText:
About Us

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

About The Role

Read more about what we’re building here.

We're hiring full stack data scientists who love to get into the nitty gritty of the domain, have an instinct for commercial value, and own the entire process from data exploration to production.

Building, optimising, and deploying models that operate reliably at scaleDeveloping a deep understanding of energy markets, grid dynamics, and trading strategiesTaking ownership of the full lifecycle of your work, from research and prototyping through to productionWriting clean, production-quality code and contributing to robust, scalable systemsWorking beyond notebooks, turning ideas into real-world, productionised solutions

It’d be nice if you could bring:

Knowledge of the electricity system, specifically power tradingComfort speaking to clients (we’re a small team and wear many hats)Familiarity with time-series data

Tech stack

🐍 We build in Python + React for the frontend (less relevant for this role)

🐋 Everything we build lives in Docker, for minimal cross-platform faff and maximal reproducibility.

🤖 Unlimited Claude Code tokens - we are aggressive users and explorers of AI, and encourage everybody to reconsider their workflows regularly

☁️ We deploy on GCP

What's In It For You

A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary, with total compensation ranging from £75k–£200k (base salary + equity).

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Initial interviewTake-home exerciseFinal interview (in-person)Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

Compensation Range: £75K - £200K

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
The role:This is an exciting opportunity to join the Data Science & Insight Team as a Data Analyst. We have a wide-ranging client list, working with some of the biggest and most innovative brands in the UK across publishing, retail, financial services, utilities, leisure, gaming, and beyond, helping to support clients with their marketing activities. The team is responsible for the delivery of CACI’s portfolio of data products, which describe people and places in terms of demographics, behaviours, and attitudes.
What you’ll be doing:Delivering our Data Products: Either through standard off-the-shelf packages or using complex code to ingest and wrangle client data, the core part of your job will be working to ensure that our clients are able to access and use our data in the most effective way.Interacting with Clients: We work closely with the sales teams and account managers, so you’ll join them in conversations with clients to help them gain deeper insight into their customers.Innovation: We are always looking to develop new techniques and improve the efficiency of our existing processes. You’ll have the chance to join a “lab”, where we work collaboratively in small groups, focused on areas such as Automation, Image Analysis and Generative AI.Data Science and Visualisation: Once you’ve built up your knowledge of our data and processes, we’ll provide you with the opportunities to work on a variety of data science and data visualisation projects, which typically use CACI data in conjunction with information held by clients on their customers to deliver insight and recommendations. These would draw on a range of different software and analytical techniques and include the presentation of findings to external stakeholders.
How we’ll help you get started:You’ll be learning from day one, and we aim to get you delivering projects within a week or so. We’ll train you on the job, so while we expect you to show that you have a great problem-solving mind, we don’t expect you to arrive knowing how to write the code we use day-to-day. The team is fun and close-knit, and you will have as much support as you need from your colleagues, many of whom are also recent graduates.
What we require of you:You have a 1st or 2:1 degree in a numerate subjectYou are personable, adaptable, inquisitive and eager to learnYou have a keen eye for detail and qualityYou love solving problemsYou enjoy talking to peopleYou are organised and are comfortable working on several projects at onceYou like to work as part of a team

rows.descriptionText:
LSE is committed to building a diverse, equitable and truly inclusive university

 Management 

 Research Assistant 

 Salary  from £36,513 to £41,565 pa inclusive with potential to progress to £44,468 pa inclusive of London allowance 

 Funding is available to support this position for 12 months 

The post supports a research programme lead by Dr. Raúl Sánchez De La Sierra from LSE’s Department of Management. The research programme concerns armed groups, state formation, and governance in the eastern De mocratic Republic of Congo. This is a field-intensive post. The post holder will spend roughly half of each year in North and South Kivu, including in remote artisanal mining areas several hours or days from the nearest town, reached by motorbike or on foot.

Main duties and responsibilities include identifying appropriate methods of investigation or analysis according to data and objectives; conveying complex conceptual ideas or complex information which may be highly detailed, technical or specialist; interpreting and analysing patterns or trends in data; managing large scale databases.

Candidates should have a completed Master or Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in economics or other closely related quantitative discipline; graduate degree in economics or public policy that includes graduate level coursework in econometrics as well as in political economy, or Maters-level economics research training; knowledge of the research literature on the political economy of conflict and armed group governance; experience in cleaning and managing large survey and administrative datasets; proficiency in Stata, R, or Python; resilience to work for extended periods in a remote insecure setting .

We offer an occupational pension scheme, generous annual leave, hybrid working, and excellent training and development opportunities.

HMCTS is an agency of the Ministry of Justice responsible for the administration of criminal, civil and family Courts and Tribunals in England and Wales. Our roles support our service users and colleagues within HMCTS, where people and businesses access potentially life-changing justice.

National Services is a directorate within HMCTS Operations, comprised of Criminal Fines, Collection and Enforcement, National Business Centres and Courts & Tribunals Service Centres.

rows.descriptionText:
The Analyst role is a technically focused, hands-on position supporting the successful delivery of eDiscovery matters under the guidance of Consultants and Senior Consultants. Analysts contribute to a wide range of project tasks, including data processing, reporting, documentation, and platform configuration, while gaining exposure to client-facing work and cross-functional collaboration.

This dynamic role offers a strong foundation in modern eDiscovery practices, with opportunities to engage with emerging technologies such as AI and machine learning. Analysts are expected to demonstrate attention to detail, a proactive mindset, and a desire for continuous learning, while helping maintain project momentum, quality, and transparency across the full EDRM lifecycle.

This is a hybrid role, based in our London office.

Responsibilities

 Core Competencies (based on Consilio’s Values) 

 Be flexible and embrace change; Take ownership for providing outstanding service; Value and respect the contributions of others, building trust and relationships with stakeholders; Take initiative, act with urgency, be accountable and demonstrate unwavering commitment to doing the right thing; Recognize, develop and celebrate individual and team successes; Lead with conviction.

 Essential Responsibilities: 

 Support Consultants and Senior Consultants in the delivery of eDiscovery matters, assisting with task execution, documentation, and client communications. Assist with data ingestion and processing workflows, ensuring accurate handling of structured and unstructured data across various platforms and formats. Support the configuration and testing of AI/ML tools, such as technology-assisted review (TAR), continuous active learning (CAL), and predictive coding, under the guidance of senior team members. Help prepare client-facing documentation, including data summaries, workflow diagrams, and platform guides, contributing to transparency and client education. Participate in platform setup and user management, including workspace creation, permission settings, and review panel configuration. Assist in troubleshooting technical issues, escalating appropriately and documenting resolutions to support knowledge-sharing and process improvement. Contribute to internal knowledge bases and training materials, helping capture lessons learned and best practices for future reference. Engage in regular training, building proficiency in industry-standard tools such as Relativity, Nuix and Reveal. Monitor task progress and update project trackers, ensuring visibility for Consultants and Senior Consultants and helping maintain project momentum. Coordinate with internal teams to help implement workflows related to data collection, processing, review, analytics, and production/export deliverables, gaining hands-on experience and technical fluency. Contribute to quality assurance efforts, helping monitor adherence to established standards and flagging inconsistencies or risks for escalation. Support internal and external communications, including maintaining meeting notes, project documentation, and updates to ensure visibility and continuity. Build strong working relationships with internal teams and clients, demonstrating professionalism, responsiveness, and a willingness to learn. Engage with emerging technologies, including AI and machine learning tools used in document review and analytics, and actively seek opportunities for training and knowledge development.

Qualifications

 BA/BSc (2:1 or higher) degree (or minimum 3 years in the litigation support / legal industry); A proactive approach to problem-solving and the ability to anticipate client needs; The ability to confront unexpected problems quickly and effectively; Strong teamwork, communication (written and oral), client management, and interpersonal skills; Proven strong desire for knowledge growth and professional development Strong eye for detail and an unrelenting commitment to quality and accuracy of the work produced by themselves and their team A general awareness of industry standard software (e.g., Relativity, Nuix) is desirable, however full training would be provided. The ability and willingness to undergo Security Clearance.

Consilio’s True North Values

 Client Experience | Listen for the “why”. Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.  Collaboration | Treat everyone with respect. Welcome diverse views. Partner across geography, generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.  Innovation | Always be curious (ABC). Challenge the status quo. Experiment and fail forward. Build for the future.  Grit | Focus on what matters. Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner. Deliver results you’re proud of.

Shape the future through strategy and problem-solving
