In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

rows.title: Informatics Analyst I/II/III/IV
rows.descriptionText:
Summary

Job Description: 

Under the direction of Health Informatics leadership, the Informatics Analyst has the responsibility for the extraction and development of complex reports and/or analysis with summaries and recommendations on findings. Monitors and measures health care trends, outcomes and business processes using data mining techniques, statistical techniques, (i.e., control charting) and additional business intelligence technologies.

At the higher levels, the position supplies management with (1) the statistical information needed to make informed decisions, (2) the identification of trends, and (3) the use of data mining techniques and development of advanced predictive models.

Essential Accountabilities

Level I:

Understands analytic processes and tools such as Excel, Access, COGNOS and SAS. Develops on-going knowledge of Health Plan’s varied data sources and structures to independently take in business requirements, design and execute on requests.Understands and describes the provision of health care and identifies adverse trends and unusual practice patterns.Participates in work teams with other staff in the Health Informatics Department, prepares, develops, analyzes utilization, quality and medical expense data. Ensures that all data are accurate and that the results are provided in a timely manner.Participates in problem-solving and investigation, analyses, special projects and research projects as requested.Using SAS Software or other appropriate analytic tools and established SAS/SQL programming practices and methodology, defines and develops reporting and analytic solutions including routine reports and analyses, data mining, predictive analytics, stored processes, macros, cubes, dashboards, etc. to support customer requirements and Health Plan business strategies.Participates in reviewing and evaluating emerging trends in healthcare and considers/recommends appropriate Health Informatics applications and process changes.Assists in identifying cost containment and quality improvement opportunities and makes recommendations to customers for further analysis opportunities.Organizes and prioritizes tasks, proposes work assignments so as to successfully complete projects in a timely manner.Manages multiple projects with competing deadlines to successful completion.Consistently demonstrates high standards of integrity by supporting the Lifetime Healthcare Companies’ mission and values, adhering to the Corporate Code of Conduct and leading to the Lifetime Way values and beliefs.Maintains high regard for member privacy in accordance with the corporate privacy policies and procedures.Regular and reliable attendance is expected and required.Performs other functions as assigned by management.

Level II (in addition to Level I Accountabilities)

 At least a Bachelor's degree At least 3 years of experience

 Preference for a Master's or Masters of Business Administration degree in at least one of the following fields of study: Business Administration/Management, Marketing, Commerce, Finance, Management Information Systems, Computer and Information Science Demonstrating proficiency in Oracle Utilities Customer-to-Meter (C2M) Utilizing Oracle Revenue Management and Billing (ORMB) effectively Managing Oracle Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) Cloud solutions Excelling in Customer Experience (CX) strategies Leveraging analytical thinking to solve complex business issues Embracing change and adapting to new environments

rows.title: AI Execution Analyst and Reporting Lead 1 1 1
rows.descriptionText:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Today's world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of over 1000 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets. Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team help protect the EY brand and build client trust.

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.

The opportunity

As an Associate Director in Information Security, this position leads the application of AI engineering within a global technology program, working closely with program leadership, workstream leads and technologists from across the globe. The position is responsible for the AI agents and automation that produce the program's reporting to senior leadership and to regional teams, and for the technical standards that govern how the program builds with AI.

This position also serves as the AI leader for Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy, guiding teams across the function on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within our services and processes. This includes identifying which assurance, risk and policy activities are suited to AI, advising teams on the approach to take, and establishing the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function.

This is a hands-on engineering position at a senior technical grade, with authority across the program and no direct reports. The position runs and builds AI agents and automation using Claude alongside Python, Power Automate, and the Microsoft platform, and determines what work is given to an agent, how agent output is verified, and what remains with people.

Areas of focus

AI Engineering: Building agentic workflows in Claude that complete an entire piece of work, from reading source data through to producing the finished output.Functional AI Leadership: Acting as the AI leader for Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy, guiding teams on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes.Automation Delivery: Owning a program's automation estate, including what is automated, how it is built, and how it is supported over time.Assurance of AI Output: Accountability for reporting that is accurate, reconciled and defensible, with verification of agent output built into the systems that produce it.AI Standards and Capability: Setting the technical direction and standards for how the program builds with AI, and developing engineering capability across the program.

Key Responsibilities

Key responsibilities include:

Design, build and operate the AI agents and automation that produce the program's recurring reporting, using Claude and Claude Code, integrated with the enterprise systems.Own the AI and automation roadmap for the program, prioritizing work according to the effort it saves and the risk it reduces.Guide teams across Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes, including which activities are suited to AI and the approach to take.Establish the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function, and support teams in applying them.Establish how AI output is verified, including reconciliation and checks against source data on every run, and define the conditions under which an agent must stop and escalate rather than continue.Set the standards the program builds to for AI use, covering how work is scoped to an agent, prompt and context engineering, testing for repeatability, documentation and the handling of sensitive data.Advise program leadership on where AI is appropriate, including where a conventional solution is the better answer, and on the cost, risk and effort involved.Evaluate developments in AI tooling and models and introduce what is of value to the program.Build automation that is resilient and supportable, with error handling, secure credential management, logging and alerting, held in version control and documented so that it can be maintained by others.Work with IT and Information Security to secure approval, connectivity and ongoing support for AI tooling, and build within firm policy on AI use, data classification and client confidentiality.Represent the program's AI and automation position to senior stakeholders and governance forums.Develop AI engineering capability across the program through reusable components, documented patterns and practical working sessions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Proven technical authority in AI engineering, built on agents and automation in production that other people depend on.Ability to judge where AI is the right tool, where a conventional solution is better, and what should remain manual.Understanding of the limitations of AI models, and the ability to design verification appropriate to those limitations.Strong analytical skills, with the ability to validate the accuracy of reporting relied on by senior leadership.Capable of building relationships with senior stakeholders.Proficient in explaining technical trade-offs and their business implications to a non-technical audience.Ability to work independently and set technical priorities in a large program.Ability to team well with others and raise the AI engineering capability of colleagues.Strong organizational skills and the ability to deliver against fixed reporting deadlines.Ability to maintain a high level of integrity, trustworthiness and confidence when handling confidential information.

To qualify for the role, you must have

At least 10 years of experience in software, automation or data engineering, including significant time as a senior individual contributor with technical ownership of systems in production.Demonstrable experience building production solutions with Claude, including Claude Code and the Claude Agent SDK.Experience designing agentic workflows that complete an end-to-end task.Practical prompt and context engineering, including testing that model output is reliable and repeatable.Strong Python, including automation of document and data workflows with libraries such as python-pptx, python-docx, openpyxl and pandas, or the equivalent.Microsoft platform experience: Power Apps, Power BI, Dataverse, Copilot Studio and Microsoft Graph.Production experience with a major enterprise workflow automation platform such as Power Automate, including error handling and unattended runs.A track record of automating a recurring operational or reporting process end to end, with demonstrable outcomes.Experience building unattended systems that run reliably, including error handling, credential management, logging, alerting and scheduling.Experience working with large datasets drawn from multiple systems, including reconciling them and assessing whether the data supports the conclusions being drawn from it.Experience setting technical standards that other people build to, through review, shared components or documented patterns.A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.Strong English language communication skills and the ability to work with diverse, globally distributed teams.

Ideally, you'll also have

Experience integrating AI tooling with enterprise systems and data sources.Experience introducing AI tooling into a governed enterprise environment, including the approval and assurance path.Experience evaluating models or agent frameworks and making an adoption recommendation.Experience delivering security, technology risk or audit reporting to a senior audience.Familiarity with vulnerability management data and tooling.Experience coaching or building technical capability in colleagues who are not engineers.Relevant certification in cloud, data or security engineering.

What We Look For

We are looking for individuals with a passion for applied AI and a demonstrated ability to build with it to a standard that a global professional services firm can rely on. This is a senior hands-on position for someone who wants to build AI into the way a large program works and to set the standard for how it is used.

What We Offer You

The compensation ranges below are provided in order to comply with United States pay transparency laws. Other geographies will follow their local salary guidelines, which may not be a direct conversion of published US salary ranges. At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $188,600 to $339,400Bay Area California offices – $196,400 to $353,600All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $157,100 to $311,100 Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

The Research and Data Associate should have a strong interest in data-driven analysis and its intersection with RPA’s core values of health, equity, prosperity and sustainability. rows.title: Digital & Technology Rotational Program – Associate

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Digital and Technology Early Careers Program

The Digital and Technology Early Careers Program is a full-time, two-year accelerated development program for early-career professionals interested in building the technical, product, data, design, and business capabilities needed to succeed in an increasingly AI-native digital organization.

Rotations are intentionally structured to provide exposure to enterprise-scale technology, applied artificial intelligence, real-world business challenges, and cross-functional collaboration. Through these experiences, associates will build the capabilities needed to pursue long-term career opportunities within Pfizer's Digital organization.

The program is designed to develop AI-native talent who can combine strong foundational knowledge with applied experience. Associates will learn to use artificial intelligence, data, digital products, and modern technologies responsibly to solve problems, improve user experiences, and create measurable value for patients, customers, and colleagues.

As participants in an accelerated development program, associates are expected to build in-demand technical and professional capabilities while contributing to work that supports Pfizer's purpose: breakthroughs that change patients' lives.

Start Date: July 2027

Why Patients Need You

As a digitally enabled biopharmaceutical company, Pfizer uses digital technology, data, and artificial intelligence across research, development, manufacturing, commercial operations, and patient and customer engagement.

Digital colleagues help build and scale capabilities in areas such as:

Artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, analytics, and data engineeringSoftware engineering, cloud platforms, and enterprise architectureDigital product management, product analytics, and agile deliveryCustomer experience, digital design, and human-centered innovationDigital marketing, product positioning, adoption, and technology program management

As a colleague in the Digital and Technology Early Careers Program, you will work with modern technologies and multidisciplinary teams to support outcomes that advance innovation, strengthen the organization, and improve patient health.

What You Will Achieve

As an associate in the Digital and Technology Early Careers Program, you will be expected to demonstrate curiosity, learning agility, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous growth throughout the program.

Rotational assignments are project-based and aligned with organizational priorities, approved business needs, available roles, location requirements, manager capacity, and individual development goals.

Throughout the program, your experiences may include, but are not limited to:

Building a broad understanding of Pfizer's Digital ecosystem while developing deeper capabilities within one or more priority role familiesApplying artificial intelligence, data, technology, product, or design knowledge to address real business, user, or patient needsDeveloping practical experience with the responsible use of artificial intelligence, including testing, security, data quality, risk awareness, and appropriate human oversightStrengthening problem-solving, communication, collaboration, and professional networking skills while preparing for potential long-term placement opportunities within Pfizer

How You Will Achieve It

Rotational assignments may align with one or more of the following priority role families. The responsibilities listed below are illustrative and may vary based on business needs, organizational priorities, and the scope of each assignment.

Full-Stack Engineering

Full-stack engineering rotations may include developing, testing, and supporting digital applications, platforms, integrations, and cloud-based solutions.

Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Engineering

Artificial intelligence and machine learning rotations may include preparing data, developing and evaluating AI-enabled solutions, and applying responsible AI practices throughout the solution lifecycle.

Product Analytics

Product analytics rotations may include using data, experimentation, and business insights to measure performance and inform digital product decisions.

Digital Product Marketing

Digital product marketing rotations may include understanding user needs, communicating product value, and supporting awareness, adoption, and engagement of digital capabilities.

Customer Experience Design

Customer experience design rotations may include researching user needs and designing accessible, intuitive, and human-centered digital experiences.

Program Exposure

Rotational opportunities may be available across multiple areas of Pfizer's Digital organization, depending on confirmed business needs, organizational priorities, and available assignments.

rows.title: Data Analyst

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Us:American Technology Consulting (ATC) is a service-first tech company dedicated to helping businesses unlock their full potential through innovative technology solutions. We empower organizations to leverage data for smarter decisions and meaningful impact. At ATC, we foster a culture of growth and invite passionate individuals to join our team, contribute to impactful projects, and excel as data-driven problem solvers. We embrace diversity and welcome candidates from all educational and professional backgrounds, including recent Master’s graduates without prior technical experience.
Job Overview:As an Entry-Level Data Analyst at ATC, you will be at the forefront of turning raw data into actionable insights. This role offers a fantastic opportunity to work on real-world challenges, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and apply your problem-solving skills in a supportive and innovative environment.
Key Responsibilities:Collect, clean, and organize data to prepare it for analysis.Identify trends, patterns, and correlations using statistical and analytical tools.Develop insightful dashboards, visualizations, and reports using tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Excel.Assist teams in making data-driven decisions by presenting clear and concise insights.Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver solutions.Ensure data accuracy and consistency through validation and quality checks.Stay updated on industry trends, best practices, and new data tools or technologies.
Qualifications:Master’s degree.Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and a willingness to learn data visualization tools like Tableau or Power BI.Excellent communication skills to present findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.Candidates must have U.S. work authorization.
Preferred Qualifications:Internship or project experience in data analysis or visualization.Familiarity with SQL for querying and managing databases.Knowledge of statistical concepts and tools like Python or R (a plus but not required).
What We Offer:Career Growth: Opportunity to advance in a dynamic and supportive work environment.Mentorship: Guidance and training from experienced professionals in the field.Diversity in Projects: Work across various industries and innovative technologies.Comprehensive Benefits: Competitive salary, health insurance, and other perks.
Work Authorization Support:H1B sponsorship or related visa support for eligible candidates.Applications from individuals on F1/OPT are welcome.
Equal Opportunity Commitment:ATC is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer, fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees can thrive.

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Please direct all resume submissions to QuantTalentUS@mlp.com and reference REQ-29449 in the subject.

Job Description

We are seeking a Quantitative Analyst to join a small, collaborative team focused on systematic equity strategies. This role is well suited for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of equity research, alternative data, and quantitative modeling, with a particular focus on sector-specific signals, company-level KPIs, and custom dataset development.

The role offers direct exposure to the SPM and broader investment process, with the opportunity to contribute across idea generation, data work, signal research, model implementation, and backtesting.

Location

New York

Principal Responsibilities

Partner closely with the SPM and team on alpha research for systematic equity strategies, with a focus on sector-specific signals and company-level forecastingIdentify, collect, organize, and analyze structured and unstructured datasets relevant to company, product, and sector behaviorIntegrate Agentic AI workflows where they can improve productivity, model development, or operational robustnessDevelop creative, data-driven ways to track companies, industries, and products beyond traditional financial statement analysisContribute to the research, implementation, and backtesting of signals using alternative, fundamental, and positioning datasetsApply sound financial intuition and statistical techniques to turn raw data into investable insightsWork in a transparent, collaborative environment with visibility into the broader investment process

Preferred Technical Skills

Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Physics, or a related disciplineStrong Python skillsExperience working with company- and sector-specific KPIsExperience using alternative, fundamental, and positioning datasetsPractical experience using LLMs or modern ML tools in analytical, research, or dataset-building workflows is highly desirableStrong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

Preferred Experience

1–3 years of experience in data science, data analytics, quantitative research, or a related roleExperience at an investment firm, data analytics firm, research provider, or software company is preferredDemonstrated ability to take analytical projects from conception through implementation

Highly Valued Relevant Experience

Experience systematizing previously manual or judgment-based processesExperience with sector-specific equity research, particularly in industrials, commodities, healthcare, or financialsExperience building custom datasets or KPI frameworksExperience working with messy or incomplete real-world data and converting it into usable research inputs

Target Start Date

ASAP, though we will wait 6–9 months for an exceptional candidate

Millennium offers a total compensation package which includes a base salary, discretionary performance bonus, and comprehensive benefits. The estimated base salary range for this position is $150,000 to $200,000, which is specific to New York and may change in the future. When finalizing an offer, we take into consideration an individual’s experience level and the qualifications they bring to the role to formulate a competitive total compensation package.

rows.title: Certified Diabetes Educator
rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are

Community Healthcare Network (CHN) is a not-for-profit organization providing more than 65,000 New Yorkers with primary and behavioral healthcare, dental, nutrition, wellness, and needed support services.

Our network is made up of 14 federally qualified health centers throughout Brooklyn, the Bronx, Queens, and Manhattan, along with a fleet of mobile vans that bring health services to underserved people in need throughout New York City. We provide judgment-free, high-quality healthcare, without regard to race, religion, orientation, gender identity, immigration status or ability to pay. We turn no one away.

What We Offer

Growth and development: Access to various healthcare professionals and benefits to deepen understanding and interest in the various disciplines involved in community health programming.

Supportive Team culture: Be a part of an interdisciplinary environment where your ideas and work are valued and encouraged.

Comprehensive benefits: Including health, dental and vision insurance, retirement plans, employee assistance programming and more.

Position Summary

The Certified Diabetes Educator assists the clinical team with diabetes-specific education and care for patients, providing nutrition education and counseling in both individual and group settings, and working as part of a clinical team to provide coordinated care (medical, educational, and social services).

Duties And Responsibilities

Essential Functions:

Fields clinical nutrition and diabetes questions from staff.

Assists Diabetes Program Manager with standardized DSMES program implementation.

Evaluates and monitors the nutritional status of patients living with diabetes.

Conducts Diabetes-related nutrition education and counseling sessions.

Organizes and develops nutritional care plans and individualized therapeutic diets as needed.

Completes necessary reports and forms and document patient services in the appropriate medical record.

Facilitates related services for health center clients as appropriate with respect to their confidentiality and privacy.

Organizes, reviews, and distributes Diabetes education materials and patient screening forms.

Serves as a resource and educator of diabetes care to the clinical and social service staff.

Stay current on the latest diabetes management techniques and treatments.

Attends conferences and participates in trainings/informal sessions as requested by the Director of Nutrition.

Works closely with providers on treatment adherence, case management, and social service staff, to improve patient services.

Conferences with the Director of Nutrition/Diabetes Program Manager as necessary to seek consultation and share information that is pertinent to patient care.

Participates in clinic and central office team meetings as designated.

Plans and facilitates educational presentations and workshops for the agency.

Compliance with Employee Health Services.

Participates in the development of Diabetes-related program policies.

Perform other related duties as assigned by the Director of Nutrition.

Education & Experience Required

Bachelor’s Degree in Nutrition required, Master's preferredRegistered Dietitian/Certified Dietitian-Nutritionist AND Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist License RequiredMinimum of two (2) years of nutritional experience in a clinical/community health settingDemonstrated experience and/or training in Diabetes Education and/or Care and Medical Nutrition Therapy

Our teams operate with autonomy, while cross-team collaboration strengthens our conviction and empowers us to capitalize on market dislocations.

At SFM, we foster an ownership mindset, encouraging professionals to challenge the status quo, innovate, and take initiative. This culture of continuous growth and constructive debate fuels innovation and drives efficiencies.

Our impact is measured by both the returns we generate and the values we uphold, from environmental stewardship to social responsibility. Operating as a unified team across geographies and mandates, we remain committed to our mission, ensuring a meaningful, lasting impact.

Headquartered in New York City with offices in Greenwich, Garden City, London, and Dublin, SFM employs 200 professionals.

Team Overview

The Structured Products team invests across the breadth of the securitized products space, spanning Agency MBS, Non-Agency MBS, CLOs, and CMBS. We run a sector-relative-value approach, continuously evaluating opportunities across sectors, tranches, and the capital structure to position the portfolio for the best risk-adjusted carry and total return.

We are looking for a sharp, curious analyst to work directly with portfolio managers and help drive the investment process. This is a hands-on, high-visibility role with the opportunity to grow and take on more responsibility while deepening expertise across multiple sectors in securitized products.

Job Overview

We are looking for a sharp, curious analyst to work directly with portfolio managers and help drive the investment process. This is a hands-on, high-visibility role with the opportunity to grow and take on more responsibility while deepening expertise across multiple sectors in securitized products.

Job Responsibilities

The role spans daily portfolio analytics, workflows and investment/idea research.

Daily Portfolio & Risk

Run daily analytics and stress scenarios (rate, spread, and other risk factors), flagging anything requiring PM attention.Monitor spreads and relative-value signals across sectors and tranches in real time.Maintain portfolio positioning, carry, trade activity, and composition; coordinate with risk and operations as needed.

New Issue & Market Coverage

Track the new-issue calendar, maintain pipeline trackers, and coordinate with legal on NDAs and conflict checks.Follow sell-side research and sector calls to stay current across all covered markets.

Research & Surveillance

Monitor portfolio holdings for default trends, prepayment behavior, and collateral performance.Contribute to ad hoc research projects and, over time, develop sector views deep enough to generate investment ideas.

Automation & Process

Identify manual or repetitive workflows and build faster, automated solutions — with an emphasis on AI tools.

What We Value

Background in structured products, ideally with 2-4 years direct experience in Agency or Non-Agency MBS, and the ability to pick up and support other sectors (CLO, CMBS) over timeSolid grasp of fixed income risk concepts — including DV01, convexity, volatility, and spread risk — and how they apply across securitized sectors.Working knowledge of core industry tools: Intex, Yield Book, and Bloomberg.Comfort with portfolio analytics, risk scenarios, and large data sets.Demonstrated use of AI tools to improve efficiency and automate parts of the workflow.Strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to managing multiple workstreams alongside recurring daily deliverables.

Preferred / A Plus

Demonstrated ability to develop a deep understanding of a sector and translate it into actionable investment ideas.Programming experience in Python (or comparable tools) for analysis, automation, and tooling.Exposure to more than one securitized products sector.

We anticipate the base salary of this role to be between $150,000-$175,000. In addition to a base salary, the successful candidate will also be eligible to receive a discretionary year-end bonus.

Smart risk-taking // Owner’s Mindset // Teamwork // Humility // Integrity

rows.title: AI Execution Analyst and Reporting Lead 1 1 1
rows.descriptionText:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Today's world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of over 1000 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets. Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team help protect the EY brand and build client trust.

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.

The opportunity

As an Associate Director in Information Security, this position leads the application of AI engineering within a global technology program, working closely with program leadership, workstream leads and technologists from across the globe. The position is responsible for the AI agents and automation that produce the program's reporting to senior leadership and to regional teams, and for the technical standards that govern how the program builds with AI.

This position also serves as the AI leader for Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy, guiding teams across the function on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within our services and processes. This includes identifying which assurance, risk and policy activities are suited to AI, advising teams on the approach to take, and establishing the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function.

This is a hands-on engineering position at a senior technical grade, with authority across the program and no direct reports. The position runs and builds AI agents and automation using Claude alongside Python, Power Automate, and the Microsoft platform, and determines what work is given to an agent, how agent output is verified, and what remains with people.

Areas of focus

AI Engineering: Building agentic workflows in Claude that complete an entire piece of work, from reading source data through to producing the finished output.Functional AI Leadership: Acting as the AI leader for Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy, guiding teams on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes.Automation Delivery: Owning a program's automation estate, including what is automated, how it is built, and how it is supported over time.Assurance of AI Output: Accountability for reporting that is accurate, reconciled and defensible, with verification of agent output built into the systems that produce it.AI Standards and Capability: Setting the technical direction and standards for how the program builds with AI, and developing engineering capability across the program.

Key Responsibilities

Key responsibilities include:

Design, build and operate the AI agents and automation that produce the program's recurring reporting, using Claude and Claude Code, integrated with the enterprise systems.Own the AI and automation roadmap for the program, prioritizing work according to the effort it saves and the risk it reduces.Guide teams across Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes, including which activities are suited to AI and the approach to take.Establish the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function, and support teams in applying them.Establish how AI output is verified, including reconciliation and checks against source data on every run, and define the conditions under which an agent must stop and escalate rather than continue.Set the standards the program builds to for AI use, covering how work is scoped to an agent, prompt and context engineering, testing for repeatability, documentation and the handling of sensitive data.Advise program leadership on where AI is appropriate, including where a conventional solution is the better answer, and on the cost, risk and effort involved.Evaluate developments in AI tooling and models and introduce what is of value to the program.Build automation that is resilient and supportable, with error handling, secure credential management, logging and alerting, held in version control and documented so that it can be maintained by others.Work with IT and Information Security to secure approval, connectivity and ongoing support for AI tooling, and build within firm policy on AI use, data classification and client confidentiality.Represent the program's AI and automation position to senior stakeholders and governance forums.Develop AI engineering capability across the program through reusable components, documented patterns and practical working sessions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Proven technical authority in AI engineering, built on agents and automation in production that other people depend on.Ability to judge where AI is the right tool, where a conventional solution is better, and what should remain manual.Understanding of the limitations of AI models, and the ability to design verification appropriate to those limitations.Strong analytical skills, with the ability to validate the accuracy of reporting relied on by senior leadership.Capable of building relationships with senior stakeholders.Proficient in explaining technical trade-offs and their business implications to a non-technical audience.Ability to work independently and set technical priorities in a large program.Ability to team well with others and raise the AI engineering capability of colleagues.Strong organizational skills and the ability to deliver against fixed reporting deadlines.Ability to maintain a high level of integrity, trustworthiness and confidence when handling confidential information.

To qualify for the role, you must have

At least 10 years of experience in software, automation or data engineering, including significant time as a senior individual contributor with technical ownership of systems in production.Demonstrable experience building production solutions with Claude, including Claude Code and the Claude Agent SDK.Experience designing agentic workflows that complete an end-to-end task.Practical prompt and context engineering, including testing that model output is reliable and repeatable.Strong Python, including automation of document and data workflows with libraries such as python-pptx, python-docx, openpyxl and pandas, or the equivalent.Microsoft platform experience: Power Apps, Power BI, Dataverse, Copilot Studio and Microsoft Graph.Production experience with a major enterprise workflow automation platform such as Power Automate, including error handling and unattended runs.A track record of automating a recurring operational or reporting process end to end, with demonstrable outcomes.Experience building unattended systems that run reliably, including error handling, credential management, logging, alerting and scheduling.Experience working with large datasets drawn from multiple systems, including reconciling them and assessing whether the data supports the conclusions being drawn from it.Experience setting technical standards that other people build to, through review, shared components or documented patterns.A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.Strong English language communication skills and the ability to work with diverse, globally distributed teams.

Ideally, you'll also have

Experience integrating AI tooling with enterprise systems and data sources.Experience introducing AI tooling into a governed enterprise environment, including the approval and assurance path.Experience evaluating models or agent frameworks and making an adoption recommendation.Experience delivering security, technology risk or audit reporting to a senior audience.Familiarity with vulnerability management data and tooling.Experience coaching or building technical capability in colleagues who are not engineers.Relevant certification in cloud, data or security engineering.

What We Look For

We are looking for individuals with a passion for applied AI and a demonstrated ability to build with it to a standard that a global professional services firm can rely on. This is a senior hands-on position for someone who wants to build AI into the way a large program works and to set the standard for how it is used.

What We Offer You

The compensation ranges below are provided in order to comply with United States pay transparency laws. Other geographies will follow their local salary guidelines, which may not be a direct conversion of published US salary ranges. At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $188,600 to $339,400Bay Area California offices – $196,400 to $353,600All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $157,100 to $311,100 Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today. 

To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.For those living in California, please click here for additional information.At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
This position is eligible to receive a Sign-on Bonus.**

Located in Manhattan, The New York Proton Center (NYPC) is one of the most unique and respected clinical partnerships in the world of proton therapy. The collaboration between Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, Montefiore Medical Center, and Mount Sinai Health System brings state-of-the-art proton therapy treatment to the patients of New York and the surrounding areas.

Our team at NYPC is comprised of highly motivated, passionate, professional, and engaged individuals working together as a dynamic team to deliver an exceptional level of patient care, providing the most advanced proton therapy technology. We offer our employees a competitive compensation and benefits package with flexibility for growth and career advancement.

If you meet the criteria and would like to be a part of our collaborative, innovative, and patient-focused team, please apply with a cover letter and copy of your resume, or CV, to the current opportunity listed below.

Position Summary

The Post-Doctoral Research Fellow (PDRF) will design and conduct research within a specific field while receiving advanced training from a designated Principal Investigator to enhance professional skills and research independence needed for pursuing a professional career in Medical Physics. The ideal candidate will work with the Principal Investigator to develop new ideas, design and evaluate experiments, process and analyze data, and prepare scientific manuscripts for publication. The initial appointment is for one year, and renewal is expected upon the PDRF's performance.

Duties And Responsibilities

Support lead and contribute to the development of artificial intelligence (AI) and automation solutions for clinical applications in radiation oncology, with a strong emphasis on improving treatment planning, workflow efficiency, and decision support.Participate in and support a broad range of innovative clinical and translational projects, including proton treatment planning, treatment evaluation, device and software tool development, FLASH therapy, adaptive radiotherapy, reirradiation, and implementation of new clinical protocols.Apply physics, mathematical modeling, and analytical reasoning to interpret complex clinical problems and identify optimal solutions for research and clinical implementation.Comply with all New York Proton Center policies related to Privacy Rules established under the Health Information Privacy and Portability Act of 1996 (HIPAA).Other clinical and research supports as needed.

Qualifications

Ph.D. degree in Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, or related fields.Strong programming skills with MATLAB and Python; scripting skills in Eclipse are preferred.Experience in AI, machine learning, and automation development is highly preferred.Must possess strong technical problem-solving skills.Experience with Eclipse API scripting (C#) and medical image analysis/processing is preferred.Knowledge of Monte Carlo simulation for proton therapy is preferred.Strong oral and written communication skills.

About The Area

New York City is a major metropolitan city and is home to world-renowned cultural offerings. Outdoor attractions include a variety of parks and green spaces including Central Park, the Brooklyn Botanical Gardens, the Bronx Zoo, and the High Line; multiple waterfronts on the island afford convenient access to scenic activities. Cultural activities abound in Broadway, Madison Square Garden, Lincoln Center, The Metropolitan Museum of Art, and the Museum of Modern Art; iconic sites include the Statue of Liberty, Empire State Building, Rockefeller Center, Times Square, and the One World Trade Center; championship teams in every major league sport; shopping abounds in SoHo, Fifth Avenue, Chelsea Market, and the Fashion District; and dining offerings are second to none. The New York Proton Center, situated in Manhattan, is well-located for city living and suburb living, with multiple suburbs, located 25 minutes from the Center, home to some of the best public school systems in the country.

The New York Proton Center (NYPC) strives to maintain a workplace that accepts and appreciates the differences among our employees. rows.title: Marketing Coordinator
rows.descriptionText:
Job Title: Marketing Coordinator

Annual Salary: $58,000 to $68,000 commensurate with experience

Location: Brockton, MA

There’s a Place for You at NorthEast Electrical 

A career at NorthEast Electrical is more than a job. You’re investing in a brighter, more sustainable future together and joining a team that makes a real difference for our customers. NorthEast Electrical offers electrical products and services to contractors. If it helps bring electricity to an office, home, factory or other building – you can find it here. We operate throughout the Northeast and are part of the Sonepar group, the world’s #1 electrical distributor with over 45,000 associates around the globe.

Being “Powered by Difference” means we respect and value diverse perspectives. Within NorthEast Electrical we offer a supportive culture and great benefits, and as part of the larger Sonepar group, we can offer exciting opportunities to grow your career.

Reporting to the Director of Marketing, the Marketing Coordinator supports the execution of company events, tradeshows, branch merchandising initiatives, and day-to-day marketing activities. This entry-level role collaborates with marketing, sales, purchasing, branch teams, and vendor partners to coordinate projects, maintain marketing materials, and support engaging customer experiences. The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, creative, and eager to learn. This position provides hands-on experience in event coordination, merchandising, vendor relations, and marketing operations.

What a Day In This Role Looks Like

Event & Tradeshow Support 

Assist with planning and executing regional tradeshows, customer events, vendor showcases, training seminars, and company-sponsored events.

Coordinate event logistics, including registrations, attendee communications, promotional materials, signage, giveaways, shipping, and setup.

Support onsite event execution and post-event follow-up activities.

Maintain event calendars, project timelines, checklists, and schedules.

Coordinate with vendors and internal teams to help ensure event materials and services are delivered on time.

Collect event photos, attendance information, and feedback for post-event documentation.

Branch Merchandising Support 

Support merchandising initiatives across branch locations to help ensure consistent product presentation and customer experience.

Coordinate the distribution of signage, displays, product information, and merchandising materials.

Assist with seasonal displays, branch merchandising updates, and new product launches.

Visit branch locations as needed to support merchandising projects and display updates.

Work with vendors and branch teams to support product display initiatives.

Marketing & Vendor Coordination 

Assist with the development of event collateral, flyers, signage, presentations, and sales support materials.

Coordinate the printing, production, and distribution of marketing materials.

Help maintain brand consistency across customer-facing materials.

Coordinate with vendor partners to gather product information, marketing assets, and event support materials.

Organize and maintain marketing files, asset libraries, vendor resources, and promotional inventories, SharePoint

Project & Administrative Support 

Track project timelines, deliverables, and follow-up items for marketing initiatives.

Assist with budget tracking, and general department administration.

Maintain organized records for events, merchandising projects, and vendor information.

Provide general project and administrative support to the marketing team.

What You Can Bring To Us

Associate or bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Event Management, or a related field preferred. Equivalent education or relevant experience will also be considered.

Up to two years of related experience preferred. Relevant internships, co-op assignments, academic projects, volunteer experience, and customer-facing experience will be considered.

Strong organizational, time-management, and attention-to-detail skills.

Clear verbal and written communication skills.

Ability to balance multiple assignments and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

Willingness to learn, take initiative, and work collaboratively.

Experience Supporting Events, Tradeshows, Merchandising, Or Marketing Projects.

Familiarity with Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar design tools is preferred but not required.

Familiarity with social media platforms and digital marketing tools.

Experience working with vendors or coordinating materials and logistics.

Physical Requirements

Ability to stand for extended periods during events and tradeshows.

Ability to occasionally lift and move materials weighing up to 35 pounds.

Work Environment 

This position requires approximately 20% regional travel to branch locations, customer events, vendor meetings, and industry tradeshows. The Marketing Coordinator collaborates with marketing, sales, purchasing, branch teams, and vendor partners to support event execution, merchandising initiatives, and day-to-day marketing activities.

What We Offer You

We offer great family-friendly benefits to full-time associates:

Healthcare plans Dental & vision Paid time off Paid parental leave Professional and personal development programs Associate DiscountsTuition ReimbursementOpportunity to become a shareholder Employer-paid short- and long-term disability Employer-paid life insurance for spouse and dependents Robust wellness program Gym reimbursement Employee Assistance Program (EAP) 

We’re proud to be a military-friendly company, and our many employee resource groups (ERGs) help you make connections and feel supported.

Learn More About Us

Get to know us on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube, and learn how we’re “Powering Progress for Future Generations.”

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

The New Activities marketing Team of Agoda leads the marketing for new products such as flights, activities and trips. The team is looking for an Analyst to help us scale up our new business for Activities, improve our targeting and execute on ideas reaching millions of customers and driving a significant share of Agoda's overall performance.

rows.title: AI Marketing Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
This role is based in our Boston office on a hybrid schedule (3 days/week in-office).
We're looking for an AI Marketing Specialist to join the team behind MacPaw's fast-moving product lab that builds and ships AI-native applications at a high pace.
As an AI Marketing Specialist, you will own go-to-market execution for our portfolio of apps using AI as a core tool, not an afterthought. You'll design and run multi-variant ad campaigns, automate creative and copy workflows through generative AI, and work closely with product and to find what actually drives results. What you build here becomes the blueprint across marketing at MacPaw.
If you're excited to pioneer AI-native marketing inside a product company, and you want high visibility and real impact from day one, we'd love to hear from you.
In this role, you will:Develop and execute GTM strategy for a portfolio of fast-shipped AI-native apps.Launch performance ad campaigns to drive sales and new user growth by leveraging advanced generative AI workflows (Claude, Midjourney, Runway, Copy.ai, Jasper) to rapidly spin up, test, and iterate multi-variant ad creatives and copy across Meta, Google, and other platforms.Drive conversion rate, campaign, and budget optimization using AI-native web builders, predictive testing platforms, AI data agents, and machine learning algorithms to forecast market trends, segment highly targeted audiences, and automate real-time bidding and budget allocation.Work directly with the product and design team, marketing, and analytics to set up tracking, dashboards, and reporting flows.Experiment with new AI tools, evaluate what's actually worth adopting, and document what works so the broader team can learn from it.
Skills you'll need to bring:5+ years in data-driven Growth or Performance Marketing within SaaS or consumer subscription products, with hands-on multi-channel ad spend management.Deep, hands-on experience with LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini), prompt engineering, and image/video generative AI tools (Midjourney, Runway, Copy.ai, Jasper or similar).Expert-level proficiency in Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Google Analytics, and A/B testing methodologies.Strong command of acquisition metrics — CAC, ROAS, ROMI, LTV, conversion rate, payback period — and the ability to actually move them.Experience with campaign experimentation, optimization, and marketing automation.Analytical mindset: comfortable working with performance data, not just reading it.Ability to quickly learn and evaluate new tools and make a judgment call on what's worth the investment.Strong problem-solving and hypothesis-driven mindset.Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
As a plus:Experience with AppsFlyer, Looker/Tableau or similar analytics tools.Experience with attribution and incrementality testing.

rows.title: AI Execution Analyst and Reporting Lead 1 1 1
rows.descriptionText:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Today's world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of over 1000 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets. Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team help protect the EY brand and build client trust.

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.

The opportunity

As an Associate Director in Information Security, this position leads the application of AI engineering within a global technology program, working closely with program leadership, workstream leads and technologists from across the globe. The position is responsible for the AI agents and automation that produce the program's reporting to senior leadership and to regional teams, and for the technical standards that govern how the program builds with AI.

This position also serves as the AI leader for Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy, guiding teams across the function on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within our services and processes. This includes identifying which assurance, risk and policy activities are suited to AI, advising teams on the approach to take, and establishing the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function.

This is a hands-on engineering position at a senior technical grade, with authority across the program and no direct reports. The position runs and builds AI agents and automation using Claude alongside Python, Power Automate, and the Microsoft platform, and determines what work is given to an agent, how agent output is verified, and what remains with people.

Areas of focus

AI Engineering: Building agentic workflows in Claude that complete an entire piece of work, from reading source data through to producing the finished output.Functional AI Leadership: Acting as the AI leader for Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy, guiding teams on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes.Automation Delivery: Owning a program's automation estate, including what is automated, how it is built, and how it is supported over time.Assurance of AI Output: Accountability for reporting that is accurate, reconciled and defensible, with verification of agent output built into the systems that produce it.AI Standards and Capability: Setting the technical direction and standards for how the program builds with AI, and developing engineering capability across the program.

Key Responsibilities

Key responsibilities include:

Design, build and operate the AI agents and automation that produce the program's recurring reporting, using Claude and Claude Code, integrated with the enterprise systems.Own the AI and automation roadmap for the program, prioritizing work according to the effort it saves and the risk it reduces.Guide teams across Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes, including which activities are suited to AI and the approach to take.Establish the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function, and support teams in applying them.Establish how AI output is verified, including reconciliation and checks against source data on every run, and define the conditions under which an agent must stop and escalate rather than continue.Set the standards the program builds to for AI use, covering how work is scoped to an agent, prompt and context engineering, testing for repeatability, documentation and the handling of sensitive data.Advise program leadership on where AI is appropriate, including where a conventional solution is the better answer, and on the cost, risk and effort involved.Evaluate developments in AI tooling and models and introduce what is of value to the program.Build automation that is resilient and supportable, with error handling, secure credential management, logging and alerting, held in version control and documented so that it can be maintained by others.Work with IT and Information Security to secure approval, connectivity and ongoing support for AI tooling, and build within firm policy on AI use, data classification and client confidentiality.Represent the program's AI and automation position to senior stakeholders and governance forums.Develop AI engineering capability across the program through reusable components, documented patterns and practical working sessions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Proven technical authority in AI engineering, built on agents and automation in production that other people depend on.Ability to judge where AI is the right tool, where a conventional solution is better, and what should remain manual.Understanding of the limitations of AI models, and the ability to design verification appropriate to those limitations.Strong analytical skills, with the ability to validate the accuracy of reporting relied on by senior leadership.Capable of building relationships with senior stakeholders.Proficient in explaining technical trade-offs and their business implications to a non-technical audience.Ability to work independently and set technical priorities in a large program.Ability to team well with others and raise the AI engineering capability of colleagues.Strong organizational skills and the ability to deliver against fixed reporting deadlines.Ability to maintain a high level of integrity, trustworthiness and confidence when handling confidential information.

To qualify for the role, you must have

At least 10 years of experience in software, automation or data engineering, including significant time as a senior individual contributor with technical ownership of systems in production.Demonstrable experience building production solutions with Claude, including Claude Code and the Claude Agent SDK.Experience designing agentic workflows that complete an end-to-end task.Practical prompt and context engineering, including testing that model output is reliable and repeatable.Strong Python, including automation of document and data workflows with libraries such as python-pptx, python-docx, openpyxl and pandas, or the equivalent.Microsoft platform experience: Power Apps, Power BI, Dataverse, Copilot Studio and Microsoft Graph.Production experience with a major enterprise workflow automation platform such as Power Automate, including error handling and unattended runs.A track record of automating a recurring operational or reporting process end to end, with demonstrable outcomes.Experience building unattended systems that run reliably, including error handling, credential management, logging, alerting and scheduling.Experience working with large datasets drawn from multiple systems, including reconciling them and assessing whether the data supports the conclusions being drawn from it.Experience setting technical standards that other people build to, through review, shared components or documented patterns.A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.Strong English language communication skills and the ability to work with diverse, globally distributed teams.

Ideally, you'll also have

Experience integrating AI tooling with enterprise systems and data sources.Experience introducing AI tooling into a governed enterprise environment, including the approval and assurance path.Experience evaluating models or agent frameworks and making an adoption recommendation.Experience delivering security, technology risk or audit reporting to a senior audience.Familiarity with vulnerability management data and tooling.Experience coaching or building technical capability in colleagues who are not engineers.Relevant certification in cloud, data or security engineering.

What We Look For

We are looking for individuals with a passion for applied AI and a demonstrated ability to build with it to a standard that a global professional services firm can rely on. This is a senior hands-on position for someone who wants to build AI into the way a large program works and to set the standard for how it is used.

What We Offer You

The compensation ranges below are provided in order to comply with United States pay transparency laws. Other geographies will follow their local salary guidelines, which may not be a direct conversion of published US salary ranges. At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $188,600 to $339,400Bay Area California offices – $196,400 to $353,600All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $157,100 to $311,100 Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense

The Systems Engineering and Test Capabilities (SE&TC) Surface Radars and Sensors Center is seeking a talented Systems Engineer II to join our Radar Performance and Analysis team supporting the AN/TPY-2 missile defense radar program. This position will be onsite in Woburn, MA. The AN/TPY-2 radar is a state-of-the-art missile defense system operating in the X-band, with a flawless performance record against ballistic missiles. In this role, you will evaluate radar data, conduct end-to-end performance assessments, and manage system requirements. You will be responsible for tracking and reporting Key Performance Metrics (KPMs) and Technical Performance Measures (TPMs), ensuring the radar meets stringent tactical mission objectives. Through your engineering expertise, you will develop automated data-processing workflows and analytical models to transform complex sensor outputs into actionable engineering insights.

What You Will Do

Parse, process, and analyze raw sensor data, tracks, and detections to evaluate algorithm performance, target discrimination, and tracking accuracy. Conduct scenario-based analysis to identify and resolve technical observations. Perform system performance assessments and validation testing to ensure compliance with requirements and specifications. Lead system-level requirements analysis, decomposition, and traceability, managing the full verification and validation (V&V) lifecycle. Establish, monitor, and report on KPMs and TPMs, proactively identifying performance trends, variances, and system risks. Develop and maintain robust MATLAB and Python scripts to automate large-scale data ingestion, statistical modeling, and performance report generation. Translate complex data findings into clear technical presentations, dashboards, and documentation for program leadership and military stakeholders. 

Qualifications You Must Have

Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 2 years of prior relevant experience. Experience in test methodology, data analysis, scripting, and/or software development. Experience with Matlab, Python, Perl, C/C++, Unix, and/or Linux. 

Qualifications We Prefer

Proven experience in radar systems engineering, signal processing analysis, or performance assessment within a defense framework. Advanced proficiency in MATLAB (including toolboxes) and Python for automated scripting, data visualization, and mathematical modeling. Familiarity with systems engineering tools (e.g., IBM DOORS) for managing requirements tracking and verification matrices. Strong troubleshooting skills for resolving complex anomalies in large-scale tactical data feeds. In-depth understanding of radar systems technology, particularly radar design, analysis, and systems engineering development. Experience in creating test plans and test scripts. Experience in mission planning activities. Prior experience with the AN/TPY-2 System and/or missile defense programs. Excellent communication, technical writing, oral presentation, and interpersonal skills. Proven ability to interface with customers and lead technical solutions to complex challenges. Knowledge of and ability to work within the Agile Scrum development practice. Ability to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment with time-critical requirements. Proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook. PhD or Master’s degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Business, or a related discipline. Existing DoD Security Clearance

What We Offer:

Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation. Relocation Eligible – Relocation assistance available

rows.title: Scientist- Cancer immunology/immunotherapy
rows.descriptionText:
We are seeking a motivated and hands-on Scientist- Cancer immunology/immunotherapy with experience in mammalian cell culture and a strong interest in cellular immunology to join our growing research organization. The successful candidate will contribute to the design, development, and execution of complex immune assays to identify and validate novel targets that support our immuno-oncology research programs. You will work with primary human samples, apply key immunological techniques such as flow cytometry and ELISpot, and generate high-quality scientific data that will advance our understanding of immune responses and inform the development of innovative therapies.

As a Scientist, you will be an integral member of a multidisciplinary team based in Boston, collaborating closely with colleagues across discovery and translational research. You will bring strong laboratory skills, scientific curiosity, and a collaborative mindset to support assay development, data generation, and scientific decision-making. This role offers the opportunity to contribute directly to novel immunotherapeutic approaches while continuing to develop your expertise in a dynamic and cutting-edge research environment.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, and execute complex cellular immunology assays to identify and validate novel targets for cancer immunotherapy research.Perform mammalian cell culture, including maintenance and manipulation of primary human immune cells such as T cells and other patient-derived cell populations.Assess T cell activation, functionality, and immune responses using techniques including flow cytometry, ELISpot, and cell-based functional assays.Generate, analyze, interpret, and communicate experimental data in a clear and scientifically rigorous manner.Maintain detailed and accurate laboratory records in compliance with Good Laboratory Practice (GLP), Safety, Health and Environment standards, and AstraZeneca policies.Collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams to share scientific knowledge and support project objectives across research programs.Contribute to the optimization and continuous improvement of assay platforms, methodologies, and laboratory workflows.Support the preparation of scientific reports, presentations, publications, and other documentation to communicate research findings.Stay current with advancements in immunology and related scientific fields and apply new knowledge to ongoing research activities.

Essential Skills/Experience

Bachelor's degree, Master's degree, PhD, or equivalent experience in Immunology, Cell Biology, Microbiology, Molecular Biology, or a related life sciences discipline.Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience. Hands-on experience with mammalian cell culture, including primary human immune cells such as T cells.Experience performing immunological assays, including flow cytometry (FACS) and ELISpot.Working knowledge of biochemical and cellular assay techniques, including ELISA and cell-based functional assays.Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret experimental data and draw scientifically sound conclusions.Excellent attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate laboratory records and documentation.Strong organizational, communication, and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.Demonstrated enthusiasm for scientific learning and a proactive approach to acquiring new skills and knowledge.

Desirable Skills/Experience

Experience working with patient-derived samples and primary human tissues.Knowledge of multi-parameter flow cytometry panel design, optimization, and analysis using FlowJo or equivalent software.Experience with high-content imaging, multiplex cytokine analysis, or other advanced immunological assay platforms.Understanding of antigen-specific T cell biology, cancer immunology, or vaccine research.Experience supporting translational research or biomarker discovery programs.Familiarity with experimental design, statistical analysis, and data visualization tools.Previous experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or academic research environment.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems.
