Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense

The Systems Engineering and Test Capabilities (SE&TC) Surface Radars and Sensors Center is seeking a talented Systems Engineer II to join our Radar Performance and Analysis team supporting the AN/TPY-2 missile defense radar program. This position will be onsite in Woburn, MA. The AN/TPY-2 radar is a state-of-the-art missile defense system operating in the X-band, with a flawless performance record against ballistic missiles. In this role, you will evaluate radar data, conduct end-to-end performance assessments, and manage system requirements. You will be responsible for tracking and reporting Key Performance Metrics (KPMs) and Technical Performance Measures (TPMs), ensuring the radar meets stringent tactical mission objectives. Through your engineering expertise, you will develop automated data-processing workflows and analytical models to transform complex sensor outputs into actionable engineering insights.

What You Will Do

Parse, process, and analyze raw sensor data, tracks, and detections to evaluate algorithm performance, target discrimination, and tracking accuracy. Conduct scenario-based analysis to identify and resolve technical observations. Perform system performance assessments and validation testing to ensure compliance with requirements and specifications. Lead system-level requirements analysis, decomposition, and traceability, managing the full verification and validation (V&V) lifecycle. Establish, monitor, and report on KPMs and TPMs, proactively identifying performance trends, variances, and system risks. Develop and maintain robust MATLAB and Python scripts to automate large-scale data ingestion, statistical modeling, and performance report generation. Translate complex data findings into clear technical presentations, dashboards, and documentation for program leadership and military stakeholders. 

Qualifications You Must Have

Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 2 years of prior relevant experience. Experience in test methodology, data analysis, scripting, and/or software development. Experience with Matlab, Python, Perl, C/C++, Unix, and/or Linux. 

Qualifications We Prefer

Proven experience in radar systems engineering, signal processing analysis, or performance assessment within a defense framework. Advanced proficiency in MATLAB (including toolboxes) and Python for automated scripting, data visualization, and mathematical modeling. Familiarity with systems engineering tools (e.g., IBM DOORS) for managing requirements tracking and verification matrices. Strong troubleshooting skills for resolving complex anomalies in large-scale tactical data feeds. In-depth understanding of radar systems technology, particularly radar design, analysis, and systems engineering development. Experience in creating test plans and test scripts. Experience in mission planning activities. Prior experience with the AN/TPY-2 System and/or missile defense programs. Excellent communication, technical writing, oral presentation, and interpersonal skills. Proven ability to interface with customers and lead technical solutions to complex challenges. Knowledge of and ability to work within the Agile Scrum development practice. Ability to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment with time-critical requirements. Proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook. PhD or Master’s degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Business, or a related discipline. Existing DoD Security Clearance

rows.title: Student Research Intern – Quantum Computing for Medical Imaging

company.name: Harvard Medical School and Massachusetts General Hospital

rows.descriptionText:
We are seeking highly motivated undergraduate/graduate students for a temporary research internship opportunity within our team at Harvard Medical School and Massachusetts General Hospital (MGH).The project is focused on advancing computational methods for medical imaging and exploring emerging hybrid quantum-classical computing approaches for healthcare applications. Interns will have the opportunity to work at the intersection of quantum computing, computational imaging, medical physics, artificial intelligence, and biomedical data science, contributing to research that may help shape the future of PET/CT imaging and related technologies.

Expected ResponsibilitiesAssist in the development and evaluation of computational algorithms for large-scale medical imaging applications.Contribute to research involving hybrid quantum-classical computing frameworks.Implement, optimize, and benchmark algorithms using modern scientific computing tools.Support simulation studies, image analysis, and quantitative performance evaluation.Work with high-performance computing resources, GPU-accelerated computing environments, and emerging quantum computing platforms.Participate in research discussions, software development, manuscript preparation, and presentation of scientific results.

Minimum QualificationsCurrent undergraduate or graduate student in Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, Medical Physics, or a related field.Proficiency in Python and MATLAB programming.Familiarity with scientific computing, numerical methods, and data analysis.Strong analytical, mathematical, and problem-solving skills.Ability to work independently and collaboratively within an interdisciplinary research team.Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred QualificationsExperience with medical imaging, image processing, signal processing, computational physics, or scientific computing.Experience with machine learning, optimization algorithms, or scientific software development.Familiarity with GPU computing, CUDA, parallel computing, or high-performance computing environments.Exposure to quantum computing concepts and/or frameworks such as Qiskit, CUDA-Q, PennyLane, Cirq, or related platforms.Previous research experience and interest in contributing to scientific publications and conference presentations.Interest in translational healthcare technologies and next-generation medical imaging systems.The position is open to undergraduate students, though graduate students and applicants with prior research experience are especially encouraged to apply.
📩 Interested candidates should send a CV/resume, a brief statement of interest, and any relevant research or project experience via LinkedIn message or email at sahashemi@mgh.harvard.edu.

rows.title: Postdoctoral Scientist - Boston Area
rows.descriptionText:
Current HHMI Employees, click here to apply via your Workday account.

HHMI is focused on supporting and moving science forward in a variety of different ways ranging from conducting basic biomedical research, empowering educators, inspiring students, developing the next generation of scientists – even stretching into film and media production. Our Headquarters is in the greater Washington, DC metro area and is home to over 300 employees with expertise in investments, communications, digital production, biomedical sciences, and everything in between. The work housed here supports and augments the groundbreaking research conducted in HHMI labs across the nation. As HHMI scientists continue to push boundaries in laboratories and classrooms, you can be sure that your contributions while working here are making a difference.

We are always open to finding self-motivated and highly organized Postdoctoral Scientist candidates for potential opportunities within our labs in the greater Boston area.

Applications are accepted on a rolling basis. You will be contacted by a member of our Recruitment team if your skills and experience appear to be a match when a role opens.

The Postdoctoral Scientist performs a variety of research and/or laboratory tasks and experiments under general supervision. Analyzes data and records the results and conclusions of laboratory experiments. Interprets analytical data and prepares research reports. May assist in the establishment of experimental protocols. Postdoc appointments are tied to a research program advised by the Investigator.

Principal Duties And Responsibilities

Performs research and/or development in collaboration with others for projects. Makes detailed observations, analyzes data, and interprets resultsExercises technical discretion in the design, execution, and interpretation of experiments that contribute to project strategies. Prepares technical reports, summaries, protocols, and quantitative analyses. Maintains familiarity with current scientific literatureContributes to project process within their scientific field. Investigates, builds, and develops new methods and technologies for project advancement. Maintains high level of professional expertise through familiarity with scientific literature. May participate in scientific conferences and contribute to scientific journals. Uses professional concepts in accordance with HHMI’s objectives to tackle complex problems in creative and effective ways. May determine methods and procedures on new assignments and may provide mentorship to staff in the laboratory. 

Qualifications

Education

Ph.D. degree in a scientific field or MD degree

Skills And Abilities

Proven understanding of scientific principlesExercises independent judgment in developing methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for acquiring resultsAbility to perform highly complex experiments with high levels of reliability and accuracy within time constraintsOperational knowledge of sophisticated lab equipmentAbility to provide work and supervise directions to othersAbility to initiate and compose communications for various purposes in an appropriate styleAbility to work successfully within a collaborative and congenial environment and foster this ability in others. Ability to review goals, analyze processes vital to achieve those goals, and develop techniques and systems required to meet those goals. Often explores new areas and seeks opportunities to apply new knowledge to work. 

Physical Requirements

Remaining in a normal seated or standing position for extended periods of time; reaching and grasping by extending hand(s) or arm(s); dexterity to manipulate objects with fingers, for example using a keyboard; communication skills using the spoken word; ability to see and hear within normal parameters; ability to move about workspace. The position requires mobility, including the ability to move materials weighing up to several pounds (such as a laptop computer or tablet).

Persons with disabilities may be able to perform the essential duties of this position with reasonable accommodation. Requests for reasonable accommodation will be evaluated on an individual basis.

Please Note:

This job description sets forth the job’s principal duties, responsibilities, and requirements; it should not be construed as an exhaustive statement, however. Unless they begin with the word “may,” the Essential Duties and Responsibilities described above are “essential functions” of the job, as defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act.

Hiring Pay Range

Postdoc 00 – $70,000.00 - $91,000.00 (maximum)

Pay Type: Annual

The posted range reflects HHMI’s good faith estimate of the anticipated hiring salary range for this role at the time of posting. Actual hiring compensation is determined by a candidate’s qualifications, experience, and internal equity.

Compensation And Benefits

Our employees are compensated from a total rewards perspective in many ways for their contributions to our mission, including competitive pay, exceptional health benefits, retirement plans, time off, and a range of recognition and wellness programs. Visit our Benefits at HHMI site to learn more.

HHMI is an Equal Opportunity Employer

We use E-Verify to confirm the identity and employment eligibility of all new hires.

rows.title: Scientist- Cancer immunology/immunotherapy
rows.descriptionText:
We are seeking a motivated and hands-on Scientist- Cancer immunology/immunotherapy with experience in mammalian cell culture and a strong interest in cellular immunology to join our growing research organization. The successful candidate will contribute to the design, development, and execution of complex immune assays to identify and validate novel targets that support our immuno-oncology research programs. You will work with primary human samples, apply key immunological techniques such as flow cytometry and ELISpot, and generate high-quality scientific data that will advance our understanding of immune responses and inform the development of innovative therapies.

As a Scientist, you will be an integral member of a multidisciplinary team based in Boston, collaborating closely with colleagues across discovery and translational research. You will bring strong laboratory skills, scientific curiosity, and a collaborative mindset to support assay development, data generation, and scientific decision-making. This role offers the opportunity to contribute directly to novel immunotherapeutic approaches while continuing to develop your expertise in a dynamic and cutting-edge research environment.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, and execute complex cellular immunology assays to identify and validate novel targets for cancer immunotherapy research.Perform mammalian cell culture, including maintenance and manipulation of primary human immune cells such as T cells and other patient-derived cell populations.Assess T cell activation, functionality, and immune responses using techniques including flow cytometry, ELISpot, and cell-based functional assays.Generate, analyze, interpret, and communicate experimental data in a clear and scientifically rigorous manner.Maintain detailed and accurate laboratory records in compliance with Good Laboratory Practice (GLP), Safety, Health and Environment standards, and AstraZeneca policies.Collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams to share scientific knowledge and support project objectives across research programs.Contribute to the optimization and continuous improvement of assay platforms, methodologies, and laboratory workflows.Support the preparation of scientific reports, presentations, publications, and other documentation to communicate research findings.Stay current with advancements in immunology and related scientific fields and apply new knowledge to ongoing research activities.

Essential Skills/Experience

Bachelor's degree, Master's degree, PhD, or equivalent experience in Immunology, Cell Biology, Microbiology, Molecular Biology, or a related life sciences discipline.Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience. Hands-on experience with mammalian cell culture, including primary human immune cells such as T cells.Experience performing immunological assays, including flow cytometry (FACS) and ELISpot.Working knowledge of biochemical and cellular assay techniques, including ELISA and cell-based functional assays.Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret experimental data and draw scientifically sound conclusions.Excellent attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate laboratory records and documentation.Strong organizational, communication, and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.Demonstrated enthusiasm for scientific learning and a proactive approach to acquiring new skills and knowledge.

Desirable Skills/Experience

Experience working with patient-derived samples and primary human tissues.Knowledge of multi-parameter flow cytometry panel design, optimization, and analysis using FlowJo or equivalent software.Experience with high-content imaging, multiplex cytokine analysis, or other advanced immunological assay platforms.Understanding of antigen-specific T cell biology, cancer immunology, or vaccine research.Experience supporting translational research or biomarker discovery programs.Familiarity with experimental design, statistical analysis, and data visualization tools.Previous experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or academic research environment.

The annual base pay for this position ranges from $92,252.00 - $138,378.00. Our positions offer eligibility for various incentives—an opportunity to receive short-term incentive bonuses, equity-based awards for salaried roles and commissions for sales roles. Benefits offered include qualified retirement programs, paid time off (i.e., vacation, holiday, and leaves), as well as health, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

Job Summary:Come join the Cardiometabolic Research (CMR) at Company! We are focused on the discovery and early phase clinical development of biologic, small molecule, oligonucleotide, and cell therapies for treatment of diabetes, obesity, cardiovascular disease, and associated metabolic disorders. The Data Science team within CMR is seeking someone with wide-ranging experience in next-generation sequencing library preparation to help achieve our research goals. Organisation passionately promotes food security and fosters the human-animal bond to enrich the lives of its customers and the customers they serve as well. Our values: integrity, excellence, respect for people. Greater than 90% of workers rate their Company assignment as above average or excellent.

rows.title: Postdoctoral Scholar - Physics & Astronomy
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

The high energy physics group at Tufts University invites applications for a Postdoctoral Research Associate to work on the ATLAS experiment at the LHC and future collider R&D.

What You'll Do

The successful candidate will play a leading role in ATLAS physics analyses, the upgrade and commissioning of the ATLAS TDAQ system, and future collider R&D efforts. The candidate will have opportunities to contribute to new and ongoing research directions, develop original analysis and AI/ML tools, and mentor graduate and undergraduate students.

The Tufts ATLAS group pursues an exciting and diverse research program, with physics interests ranging from precision measurements of QCD to searches for new phenomena, including both targeted and model-agnostic approaches. Building on its expertise and leadership in the ATLAS muon spectrometer, the group is developing a new program in Trigger/DAQ for the HL-LHC upgrade. The group is also actively involved in the development and application of advanced AI/ML techniques, including novel unfolding methods and AI-on-chip R&D for future particle physics detectors.

What We're Looking For

Applicants must have, or be about to earn, a Ph.D. in experimental particle physics. Preferred qualifications include experience with an LHC experiment, AI/ML development, trigger and data acquisition systems, detector instrumentation, and hardware-oriented programming. The successful candidate may be based at either CERN or Tufts University in the Boston area, with residence at CERN preferred.

Applicants should submit a 1-page cover letter, CV, and 2-3 page research statement, and arrange for three letters of reference to be submitted. The research statement should describe the applicant’s research experience and interests, future research goals, and approach to mentorship, collaboration, and scientific leadership. Applications received by November 6 will receive full consideration, and review of applications will continue until the position is filled.

Pay Range

Minimum $67,500.00, Midpoint $67,500.00, Maximum $67,500.00

Salary is based on related experience, expertise, and internal equity; generally, new hires can expect pay between the minimum and midpoint of the range.

JOB SUMMARY

The Postdoctoral Research Fellow will support a program of research at the intersection of physical activity, disability, rehabilitation, and health equity in the TRIBE Lab, Department of Physical Therapy, Movement, and Rehabilitation Sciences. The position contributes to developing and testing educational interventions for rehabilitation professionals and to evaluating community-based physical activity programs for people with disabilities. Working under the direction of the faculty principal investigator, the postdoc will coordinate studies, lead qualitative and mixed-methods analyses, contribute to manuscripts and grant applications, and mentor student researchers while developing toward an independent research career. Knowledge of qualitative and mixed-method research design and analysis, research ethics and IRB procedures, and disability, rehabilitation, or physical activity research. As normally acquired through a doctoral degree (PhD or equivalent) in kinesiology, rehabilitation science, public health, health professions education, or a related field, completed by the start date, and 0–3 years of postdoctoral research experience.

rows.title: Marketing & Brand Design Associate — Two Brands. Two Industries. A Lot to Create.
rows.descriptionText:
Description

Marketing | Brand Design | Content | Digital | Creative

Full-Time | Washington, DC | In-Person | $50,000–$70,000 + Overtime Eligible

Some marketing jobs give you one channel to manage.

This one gives you two brands to help build.

Hylton-Rodic Law is a growing intellectual property law firm working at the intersection of science, technology, law, and innovation. EPIARX Diagnostics is a growing private pathology practice helping families, healthcare organizations, attorneys, and other professionals find answers when they matter most.

Different industries. Different audiences. Different voices.

And one creative role with a lot of room to make your mark.

We're looking for an emerging marketer and designer with serious creative instincts—someone who doesn't just know how to make things, but has ideas about what should be made and how to make it better.

You might spend one morning developing the visual concept for a life-sciences campaign and the afternoon creating collateral for a new pathology service. You could design a conference campaign, build a newsletter, develop a new sub-brand, reimagine a webpage, turn a technical topic into a scroll-stopping LinkedIn post, create firm swag, or take a rough business-development idea from “What if we...?” to finished campaign.

We will give you context, objectives, feedback, and room to grow.

We do not want to give you every creative answer.

We want someone who can take a rough idea, push it further, and occasionally put something in front of us that makes us stop and think: “You just blew our socks off.”

Not every project. Not every time.

But if the idea of occasionally surprising us with something better than what we asked for sounds like your kind of challenge, keep reading.

Two Organizations. Two Very Different Stories to Tell.

Hylton-Rodic Law (HRL)

HRL is a boutique intellectual property law firm headquartered in Washington, DC. We work with biotechnology, pharmaceutical, university, and life-sciences innovators to protect and commercialize technologies shaping the future of medicine and science.

Our brand is sophisticated, intelligent, polished, creative, and decidedly not stuffy. You'll help us tell the stories behind innovative technologies, our people, our clients, and a law firm we're deliberately building differently.

EPIARX Diagnostics

EPIARX is a modern private pathology practice providing independent autopsy, pathology, consultation, and related services. Our audiences range from families seeking answers to funeral homes, hospitals, attorneys, and healthcare professionals.

The voice is different: clear, compassionate, trustworthy, accessible, and human.

EPIARX is growing its services, referral relationships, and regional presence. You won't simply maintain an established brand. You'll help build what comes next.

Working across both organizations will teach you something enormously valuable: how to understand an audience, switch voices, translate complicated subjects, and create marketing that actually supports growth.

What You'll Actually Do

You'll work across HRL and EPIARX, with priorities shifting as campaigns, events, business-development initiatives, and organizational needs evolve.

You'll Help

Create original visual concepts, graphics, carousels, social content, and campaigns for LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and other channels.Write, edit, design, and publish newsletters, blogs, website content, email campaigns, and digital communications.Turn complicated topics in intellectual property, life sciences, healthcare, and pathology into content people can actually understand—and want to read.Create polished print and physical collateral, including brochures, flyers, conference materials, mailers, signage, leave-behinds, business cards, and branded materials.Maintain and develop both organizations' Squarespace websites, including content, imagery, layout, landing pages, and new marketing initiatives.Support SEO/AIO and digital-content optimization.Build marketing calendars and move campaigns from idea ? creation ? review ? publication.Help develop brands and sub-brands, including visual concepts, service identities, messaging, taglines, templates, and branded materials.Support email campaigns and CRM/marketing data through GoHighLevel.Help coordinate conferences, webinars, sponsorships, speaking engagements, and other events.Partner with business-development team members on campaigns, presentations, outreach materials, and growth initiatives.Coordinate with printers, photographers, designers, and other outside partners when needed.Create internal culture materials, welcome items, celebrations, swag, and the occasional project we haven't thought of yet.

And most importantly: Bring ideas.

We don't expect every idea to be used.

We do expect you to have them.

We Can Teach You Our Industries. Bring Us the Creative Instinct.

You do not need to arrive knowing patent law or pathology.

You do need to be curious enough to learn them.

And you need an eye.

You understand typography, composition, hierarchy, imagery, color, spacing, and the details that separate something merely finished from something genuinely designed.

You can start with a blank page—not just a template.

You can take a rough brief, develop a creative direction, make thoughtful choices, and explain why you made them.

You write exceptionally well and understand that words and visuals have to work together.

You notice when something isn't good enough before someone else has to tell you.

You are comfortable receiving detailed feedback, revising your work, killing an idea that isn't working, and coming back with something better.

Your first draft should give us something to react to—not something we have to rescue.

We're not looking for someone who has already mastered everything.

We're looking for talent, taste, curiosity, judgment, drive, and the desire to become exceptional.

Requirements

What You Should Bring

Required

Bachelor's degree or equivalent demonstrated experience in graphic design, visual communication, marketing, advertising, communications, or a related creative discipline.Approximately 0–4 years of relevant professional experience, including substantive internships, freelance work, or exceptional student work.A portfolio demonstrating strong original visual-design work.Strong understanding of typography, composition, visual hierarchy, layout, and brand consistency.Exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading skills.Experience creating digital and/or print marketing materials.Ability to take a creative brief from concept through finished execution.Strong organization and project-management skills.Proficiency with modern creative tools. Canva is useful, but Canva proficiency alone is not the design qualification for this role.

Especially Valuable

Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Illustrator, InDesign, and/or Photoshop.Figma or comparable design tools.Squarespace or other website-building experience.CRM/email-marketing experience; GoHighLevel is a plus.SEO/AIO or digital-content optimization.Photography, video, motion graphics, or multimedia production.Experience developing visual identities, campaigns, or brand systems.Experience with science, healthcare, technology, professional services, or other complex subject matter.Bachelor's degree or equivalent demonstrated experience in graphic design, visual communication, marketing, advertising, communications, or a related creative discipline.Approximately 0–4 years of relevant professional experience, including substantive internships, freelance work, or exceptional student work.

Compensation & Benefits

This position is non-exempt and overtime eligible.

Benefits include health, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) with employer matching; commuter benefits; paid time off; mental-health days; celebratory birthday leave; Sunshine Fridays; professional-development support; and our extended year-end holiday break.

Yes, We Want to See Your Work.

A résumé tells us where you've been.

Your Portfolio Tells Us What You Can Do.

Please submit one combined PDF application package, in this order:

Cover letterRésuméCollege transcript — unofficial is acceptablePortfolio/work samples

Your portfolio should include 3–6 examples of your strongest work. Professional, internship, freelance, academic, student-organization, and personal projects are all welcome.

For at least two pieces, briefly tell us: What was the objective? Who was the audience? What did you personally create? What creative choices did you make—and why?

If a piece was collaborative, clearly identify your contribution.

Applications without a portfolio demonstrating original creative work will not be considered.

Your Cover Letter

Please don't use your cover letter to summarize your résumé.

We already have that.

Instead, imagine it's your first week working with us.

You have been asked to create one piece of marketing for HRL and one for EPIARX.

What would you create—and why?

Then tell us briefly about one piece of marketing, design, content, or brand work you've created that you're particularly proud of. What did you contribute? What problem were you trying to solve? What made the finished work successful in your view?

There are no “right” answers.

We Want To See How You Think.

Please combine all four required application materials into a single PDF before uploading. Incomplete application packages will not be considered.

rows.descriptionText:
Position Summary and Essential Functions:The Senior Associate, Digital Platforms & Marketing Operations is responsible for the operational administration, governance, measurement, and continuous improvement of OFN's communications technology ecosystem, including the systems and workflows that power OFN's website, email marketing, digital campaigns, audience engagement, analytics, and reporting.
Reporting to the SVP, Strategic Communications, the role serves as the team's primary technical operator: managing platform administration, website publishing, user access and credentials, vendor support, analytics, KPI dashboards, performance reporting, digital asset management, quality assurance, and troubleshooting. Distinct from OFN's content and marketing functions, the role ensures the underlying platforms, data, and processes are stable, secure, documented, and measurable, and establishes the operational foundation for OFN's future digital engagement function.
OFN is the nation's leading investment intermediary and network of CDFIs serving rural, urban, and Native communities across the United States. With over $1 billion in total assets under management, OFN manages a national membership network of over 490 mission-driven lenders and CDFIs, including community development loan funds, credit unions, green banks, community development banks, minority depository institutions, and venture capital funds. OFN is a trusted investment partner to the public, private, and philanthropic sectors — foundations, corporations, banks, government agencies, and others. For more than 40 years, our team has helped partners invest in communities to catalyze change and create economic opportunities for people and places traditional finance doesn't reach.
To learn more, visit www.ofn.org
People who work at OFN come from a variety of professional and academic backgrounds. If you have:Passion for the mission and true believer in our core purpose.Courage to be a fearless advocate who is confident and resilient in our fight to drive capital into low-income communities.Smart, quick seekers of knowledge who thrive on creating and developing new strategies, products, and programs for increasing capital to communities we serve.Desire to be a collaborative team player who possesses humility and a willingness to lean in all areas of our work.Come be a part of our growing diverse, highly committed, skilled, and collaborative staff. At OFN, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive workplace, so if you are excited about this role but your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply nonetheless. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles.
***This position is based in Washington, D.C. All staff currently work a hybrid schedule.***

lead platform workstreams such as enhancements, integrations, migrations, and automation.Maintain platform governance, including the technology inventory, system owners, backup administrators, vendor contacts, licenses, renewals, permissions, and documentation; manage onboarding, offboarding, and role-based access with Technology, reducing single points of failure.Diagnose and resolve two-factor authentication, permission, account recovery, integration, and deliverability issues, escalating to vendors, Technology, security, or leadership as appropriate; define requirements, test solutions, and coordinate complex development with external web partners.Conduct quality assurance for website changes (links, forms, mobile display, accessibility, search visibility, accuracy); monitor site health and performance; support governance, content lifecycle, SEO, accessibility, taxonomy, and user experience improvements.Email & Campaign OperationsAdminister OFN's email marketing platform, templates, user access, audience data, segmentation, preference management, archives, and reporting; build or support technically complex campaigns, automations, forms, integrations, and audience journeys.Troubleshoot deliverability, authentication, data, template, and rendering issues; maintain disciplined QA covering audiences, links, subject lines, personalization, and approvals; improve email and audience workflows through documentation, automation, and testing.Analytics & ReportingPartner with Communications leadership to define and maintain KPIs, targets, reporting cadences, dashboard definitions, and source-of-truth data; maintain analytics implementation across web, email, campaigns, social, search, and media channels.Build and improve executive-ready dashboards; own monthly, quarterly, campaign, and ad hoc performance reporting; write concise narratives that distinguish activity, output, engagement, conversion, and outcomes and translate findings into practical recommendations.Monitor tagging, tracking, and data quality; investigate anomalies, reconcile conflicting platform data, document methodology, and coordinate fixes when measurement becomes unreliable.Vendor & Cross-Functional CoordinationServe as primary day-to-day liaison for communications technology vendors, developers, and platform support teams; manage tickets, upgrades, training, requirements, timelines, and deliverables, holding vendors accountable for timely, effective resolution.Partner with Technology on security, infrastructure, data governance, and procurement while owning communications-specific needs; identify opportunities to automate workflows and reduce administrative burden; support annual planning and budgeting for platforms, licenses, and vendors.Serve as the team's internal resource for communications technology, providing technical guidance, platform training, and clear operating standards for staff, consultants, interns, and cross-functional partners.

communications, marketing operations, web production, marketing technology, or a related field.Knowledge, Skills, and AbilitiesRecent, hands-on experience administering a meaningful combination of website CMS, email marketing and automation, analytics and tag management, CRM or audience databases, social media management, project management, creative, and AI-enabled tools.Demonstrated experience independently owning platform operations and leading technical or digital workstreams from requirements through implementation and ongoing administration.Demonstrated ability to make website updates directly in a CMS, troubleshoot platform issues, manage permissions, and work effectively with developers and technical vendors.Experience managing user access, digital credentials, authentication processes, licenses, and platform documentation in a security-conscious environment.Demonstrated experience building and maintaining KPI dashboards and recurring digital performance reports, including validating data, documenting methodology, identifying trends, and translating findings into decisions.Experience creating governance standards, SOPs, access controls, training materials, and continuity plans for a complex multi-platform environment.Hands-on experience with WordPress and Mailchimp or comparable CMS and email platforms strongly preferred.Familiarity with AWS, FormAssembly, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Meltwater, Cision/PR Newswire, Asana, Canva, and related tools.Experience in a nonprofit, financial services, economic development, public policy, membership association, or other mission-driven environment preferred.Experience within or demonstrated knowledge of the Community Development Financial Institution (CDFI) industry preferred.Standard physical requirements for an office position, with occasional travel. rows.title: AI Execution Analyst and Reporting Lead 1 1 1
rows.descriptionText:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Today's world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of over 1000 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets. Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team help protect the EY brand and build client trust.

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.

The opportunity

As an Associate Director in Information Security, this position leads the application of AI engineering within a global technology program, working closely with program leadership, workstream leads and technologists from across the globe. The position is responsible for the AI agents and automation that produce the program's reporting to senior leadership and to regional teams, and for the technical standards that govern how the program builds with AI.

This position also serves as the AI leader for Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy, guiding teams across the function on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within our services and processes. This includes identifying which assurance, risk and policy activities are suited to AI, advising teams on the approach to take, and establishing the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function.

This is a hands-on engineering position at a senior technical grade, with authority across the program and no direct reports. The position runs and builds AI agents and automation using Claude alongside Python, Power Automate, and the Microsoft platform, and determines what work is given to an agent, how agent output is verified, and what remains with people.

Areas of focus

AI Engineering: Building agentic workflows in Claude that complete an entire piece of work, from reading source data through to producing the finished output.Functional AI Leadership: Acting as the AI leader for Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy, guiding teams on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes.Automation Delivery: Owning a program's automation estate, including what is automated, how it is built, and how it is supported over time.Assurance of AI Output: Accountability for reporting that is accurate, reconciled and defensible, with verification of agent output built into the systems that produce it.AI Standards and Capability: Setting the technical direction and standards for how the program builds with AI, and developing engineering capability across the program.

Key Responsibilities

Key responsibilities include:

Design, build and operate the AI agents and automation that produce the program's recurring reporting, using Claude and Claude Code, integrated with the enterprise systems.Own the AI and automation roadmap for the program, prioritizing work according to the effort it saves and the risk it reduces.Guide teams across Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes, including which activities are suited to AI and the approach to take.Establish the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function, and support teams in applying them.Establish how AI output is verified, including reconciliation and checks against source data on every run, and define the conditions under which an agent must stop and escalate rather than continue.Set the standards the program builds to for AI use, covering how work is scoped to an agent, prompt and context engineering, testing for repeatability, documentation and the handling of sensitive data.Advise program leadership on where AI is appropriate, including where a conventional solution is the better answer, and on the cost, risk and effort involved.Evaluate developments in AI tooling and models and introduce what is of value to the program.Build automation that is resilient and supportable, with error handling, secure credential management, logging and alerting, held in version control and documented so that it can be maintained by others.Work with IT and Information Security to secure approval, connectivity and ongoing support for AI tooling, and build within firm policy on AI use, data classification and client confidentiality.Represent the program's AI and automation position to senior stakeholders and governance forums.Develop AI engineering capability across the program through reusable components, documented patterns and practical working sessions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Proven technical authority in AI engineering, built on agents and automation in production that other people depend on.Ability to judge where AI is the right tool, where a conventional solution is better, and what should remain manual.Understanding of the limitations of AI models, and the ability to design verification appropriate to those limitations.Strong analytical skills, with the ability to validate the accuracy of reporting relied on by senior leadership.Capable of building relationships with senior stakeholders.Proficient in explaining technical trade-offs and their business implications to a non-technical audience.Ability to work independently and set technical priorities in a large program.Ability to team well with others and raise the AI engineering capability of colleagues.Strong organizational skills and the ability to deliver against fixed reporting deadlines.Ability to maintain a high level of integrity, trustworthiness and confidence when handling confidential information.

To qualify for the role, you must have

At least 10 years of experience in software, automation or data engineering, including significant time as a senior individual contributor with technical ownership of systems in production.Demonstrable experience building production solutions with Claude, including Claude Code and the Claude Agent SDK.Experience designing agentic workflows that complete an end-to-end task.Practical prompt and context engineering, including testing that model output is reliable and repeatable.Strong Python, including automation of document and data workflows with libraries such as python-pptx, python-docx, openpyxl and pandas, or the equivalent.Microsoft platform experience: Power Apps, Power BI, Dataverse, Copilot Studio and Microsoft Graph.Production experience with a major enterprise workflow automation platform such as Power Automate, including error handling and unattended runs.A track record of automating a recurring operational or reporting process end to end, with demonstrable outcomes.Experience building unattended systems that run reliably, including error handling, credential management, logging, alerting and scheduling.Experience working with large datasets drawn from multiple systems, including reconciling them and assessing whether the data supports the conclusions being drawn from it.Experience setting technical standards that other people build to, through review, shared components or documented patterns.A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.Strong English language communication skills and the ability to work with diverse, globally distributed teams.

Ideally, you'll also have

Experience integrating AI tooling with enterprise systems and data sources.Experience introducing AI tooling into a governed enterprise environment, including the approval and assurance path.Experience evaluating models or agent frameworks and making an adoption recommendation.Experience delivering security, technology risk or audit reporting to a senior audience.Familiarity with vulnerability management data and tooling.Experience coaching or building technical capability in colleagues who are not engineers.Relevant certification in cloud, data or security engineering.

We are looking for individuals with a passion for applied AI and a demonstrated ability to build with it to a standard that a global professional services firm can rely on. This is a senior hands-on position for someone who wants to build AI into the way a large program works and to set the standard for how it is used.

rows.title: Operations Analyst - Secret clearance
rows.descriptionText:
Operations Analyst - Full time - Hybrid - Arlington, VA
The Operations Analyst - Journeyman serves as a specialized systems analyst focused on service level objective (SLO) performance across mission‑critical services in a highly regulated federal IT environment. The role designs and maintains SLO monitoring and reporting solutions, analyzes performance data, and recommends technical and process improvements to keep services within agreed thresholds. The analyst collaborates closely with incident, problem, and performance management teams to investigate SLO breaches, coordinate remediation with service providers, and ensure operational expectations and documentation remain current and actionable.
Key Responsibilities

Define, implement, and maintain SLO monitoring solutions for complex enterprise systems, including thoughtful threshold design, alerting rules, and performance dashboards that align with business and mission priorities.
Analyze key performance indicators and SLO trend data to identify root causes of degradation, translate findings into actionable technical changes and process improvements, and track outcomes over time.
Collaborate with incident, problem, and performance management functions to investigate SLO breaches, correlate events across systems, and drive sustainable remediation with infrastructure and application owners.
Develop, maintain, and regularly update SLO documentation, service catalogs, and operational level agreements to clearly capture expectations, dependencies, and escalation paths for supported services.
Integrate SLO management into end‑to‑end IT service management lifecycle activities using ITIL‑aligned practices and enterprise ticketing and monitoring platforms.
Produce concise compliance dashboards, reports, and stakeholder‑facing visualizations that highlight SLO status, emerging risk, and impact to mission‑critical services.
Coordinate with infrastructure and application owners to validate monitoring coverage, troubleshoot SLO‑related issues, and support continuous service improvement initiatives.
Maintain awareness of DoD 8140 baseline certification expectations and security protocols, ensuring SLO monitoring and reporting activities comply with clearance and data access requirements.

Rate - 70,000 - 91,000/yr
Required Qualifications

U.S. citizenship with an Active Secret Clearance
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
Typically 4-7 years of experience monitoring, managing, and reporting on SLO compliance in technical, highly regulated environments, including federal or defense IT.
Demonstrated experience working with incident, problem, and performance management processes and tools in an ITIL‑aligned service environment.
Meets DoD 8140 requirements and holds an active Secret clearance appropriate for work in a cleared federal IT environment.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills with the ability to interpret performance data and clearly convey findings to technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with enterprise application performance monitoring (APM) or observability platforms (e.g., APM, log analytics, distributed tracing) used for fine‑grained SLO analysis.
Hands‑on background with incident and problem management supporting government or defense organizations in an ITIL‑based service desk context.
Possession of a DoD 8140‑recognized cybersecurity or IT certification such as Security+ or an equivalent baseline credential.
Familiarity with compliance reporting for federal stakeholders and experience presenting metrics and SLO status to leadership forums or service review boards.

#cjpost

Compensation: $70,000 - $91,000 per year, depending on experience.

rows.title: Management Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
When you become a member of Team DHCF (Department of Health Care Finance), the state Medicaid agency for the District of Columbia, you join our "Mission Possible!" We work every day, in concert with various District government agencies, to streamline access to comprehensive, affordable, and quality healthcare services for District residents. Whatever your position within our agency, you will positively impact beneficiaries, their families, and their future! We invite you to bring your skills, your experience, and your passion to a job that makes a difference.

Job Summary

This position is located within the Department of Health Care Finance (DHCF), Office of the Health Care and Public Benefits Ombudsman and Bill of Rights. The mission of the Department of Health Care Finance is to improve health outcomes by providing access to comprehensive, cost-effective, and quality healthcare services for residents of the District of Columbia. This position has responsibility for assisting District residents who are covered by the Health Care Bill of Rights.

The incumbent serves as a Management Analyst, responsible for assisting the administration with handling customer inquiries, analyzing, evaluating, and providing information relative to the operation and program services of the administration. In addition, responds to inquiries from the general public pertaining to provision of benefits (eligibility requirements), applicable laws and regulations, case management issues, and/or general information. This position has responsibility for assisting District residents that are covered by the Health Care Bill of Rights.

Duties And Responsibilities

Responds to a wide variety of inquiries from the general public pertaining to the availability of public assistance benefits and eligibility of needy individuals in the District of Columbia. Gathers information from the caller through a systematic questionnaire and records all data into a computerized work tracking system. Explains and encourages the use of agency and community resources to customers as a means of dealing with an identified problem. Evaluates the customer's need for services due to both emergency and chronic situations and contacts the appropriate agencies on the customer’s behalf when necessary, follows up on problem resolutions with case managers or others, and returns calls to customers within a certain timeframe.

Provides interpretations of applicable laws, regulations, and policies to customers regarding information that is covered by specific guidelines and established procedures. Explains current criteria for benefits or obligations that apply directly to the individual. Supports the planning, coordination, and evaluation of outreach and community engagement activities by assisting with work plans, tracking performance metrics, and assessing outreach effectiveness to inform program improvements. Collects and analyzes data and service-utilization trends to identify emerging needs, monitor program impact, and support data-driven decision-making for targeted outreach and consumer assistance initiatives.

Qualification and Education

Specialized Experience – Experience that equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the duties of the position successfully, and this is typically in or related to the work of the position to be filled. To be creditable, at least one (1) year of specialized experience must have been equivalent to at least the next lower grade level in the normal line of progression.

LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS

None

WORKING CONDITIONS/ENVIRONMENT

The work is performed in an office setting and is sedentary in nature.

Other Significant Facts

Tour of Duty: Monday – Friday; 8:15 a.m. - 4:45 p.m.

Duration of Appointment:  Career Service/Regular

Promotion Potential: Promotion Potential to Grade 11

Pay Plan, Series and Grade: CS-0343-9

Collective Bargaining: This position is covered under a collective bargaining unit, American Federation of State, County and Municipal Employees (AFSCME), Local 2401, and is subject to union dues through payroll deduction

Position Designation:  This position has been deemed security sensitive. Accordingly, the incumbent will be subject to pre-employment checks (criminal background, consumer credit check, traffic record check, and drug testing, if applicable) as a condition of employment, and will be subject to periodic criminal background checks for the duration of tenure.

rows.title: FP&A Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data.
The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity.
Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control.
For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production.
Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide.

Our technology ecosystem includes Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Okta, ServiceNow, Teradata, Alation, Atlan, and Starburst — connecting Immuta to the data, cloud, identity, and enterprise platforms powering modern data and AI environments.
Immuta has been recognized by Forbes as a top American startup employer, by Inc. Magazine and Built In as one of the best workplaces, and by Fast Company as one of the world’s most innovative companies.
Immuta has raised $263 million from investors including NightDragon, Snowflake, Databricks, ServiceNow, Citi Ventures, Dell Technologies Capital, DFJ Growth, IAG, Intel Capital, March Capital, Okta Ventures, StepStone, Ten Eleven Ventures, and Wipro Ventures.
We operate as a hybrid workplace with offices in Boston, MA; Columbus, OH; and College Park, MD.


ABOUT THE TEAM
Immuta’s Finance organization is a key strategic partner in our mission to make data secure, accessible, and trusted for every organization. Within Finance, the FP&A team drives forecasting accuracy, financial reporting, and strategic insights that fuel Immuta’s continued growth as a global SaaS leader.
We work cross-functionally to provide data-driven recommendations that optimize performance, allocate resources effectively, and maximize profitability. Joining FP&A means helping shape Immuta’s financial future while collaborating with executives and cross-functional leaders in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.

ABOUT THE ROLE
As an FP&A Analyst, you’ll support and increasingly own recurring financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and analysis activities that help Immuta make informed business decisions. You’ll have broad exposure to the business and the opportunity to work across multiple areas of Finance rather than being limited to a single process. Reporting to the VP of FP&A, you’ll work with FP&A, Accounting, Recruiting, and business partners to improve visibility and accuracy in financial planning.
This role is designed for someone who has a professional foundation in accounting, FP&A, financial analysis, or a related area. You’ll apply your understanding of financial statements and business drivers while building deeper expertise, and growing your ability to turn financial and operational data into clear insights. The role has the potential to be remote and is well suited to someone who can manage competing priorities, work through ambiguity, and deliver accurate analysis under tight timelines.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
Support annual planning and quarterly forecasting cycles by collecting inputs, preparing analyses, and documenting assumptions, and identifying changes that may affect the forecast.
Prepare recurring budget-to-actual reporting for assigned departments, including Sales, and investigate significant variances across headcount, operating expenses, and other financial drivers.
Build, maintain, and improve financial models, schedules, and scenario analyses using Google Sheets, Excel, and other financial planning or reporting tools.
Track selected SaaS and operating metrics, identify trends, and summarize insights for Finance leadership and cross-functional partners.
Reconcile financial and operational inputs with business partners to improve data quality and reporting accuracy.
Contribute to the improvement of FP&A processes, systems, documentation, and reporting workflows for consistency as Immuta scales.
Support ad hoc financial analyses, scenario modeling, and short-turnaround requests that inform business decisions and other strategic Finance priorities.
Develop and maintain AI-enabled reporting and automation workflows in Dust, including sales reporting, sales efficiency analysis, and dashboards used by senior leadership.
Maintain accurate Sales pipeline reporting and help evaluate pipeline integrity, stage progression, pipeline coverage, conversion trends, bookings or revenue assumptions, and other sales efficiency indicators.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
Professional Experience: Approximately two or more years of professional experience in FP&A, accounting, financial analysis, business analysis, or a related finance role.
Financial Foundations: Working knowledge of financial statements, including the income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statement, as well as core concepts related to assets, liabilities, expenses, and operating results.
Financial Analysis: Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, budget-to-actual reporting, variance analysis, financial reporting, financial models, schedules, or scenario analyses.
Technical Skills: Working proficiency with Google Sheets and Excel, including formulas, lookups such as VLOOKUP or comparable functions, QUERY functions, IMPORTRANGE or comparable data connections, pivot tables, and organizing data from multiple sources. Familiarity with Salesforce or another CRM is helpful.
Analytical Skills: Ability to validate inputs, identify trends and variances, investigate inconsistencies, and translate quantitative information into clear business insights.
Communication & Collaboration: Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain financial information to Finance and non-Finance audiences and build effective cross-functional partnerships.
Mission Values: Ability to work independently on assigned deliverables, while managing changing priorities, respond to short-turnaround requests, learn new processes and systems, and remain effective in a fast-paced environment.



BENEFITS
 
At Immuta, our goal is to help bridge the gap between personal and professional growth, so that our team members can be well and thrive personally and professionally. After all, great professional success stories rarely happen without great personal success stories! Our generous benefits package given to all full time employees includes:

100% employer paid Healthcare (Medical, Dental, Vision) premiums for you and your dependents (including Domestic Partners)
Stock Options
Paid parental leave (Both Maternity and Paternity)
Unlimited Paid time off (U.S. based positions)
Learning and Development Resources

Immuta complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment.
 
NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY RECRUITERS: Immuta does not accept candidates from third party recruiters. All candidates submitted through are considered to be submissions by the candidate and no submission will obligate Immuta to pay any third party for the referral or hiring of a candidate.

AI NOTICE: As part of our hiring process, Immuta may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support recruiting activities, such as application review and interview coordination. These tools assist our recruiting team but do not replace human decision-making.

To protect the privacy of all participants and the confidentiality of Immuta information discussed during interviews, candidates may not use external recording tools, AI meeting assistants, or third-party transcription platforms during interviews unless approved in advance by Immuta.

 Work closely with a team of data scientists, software developers, network engineers, senior investigators, program managers, researchers, and data analysts to design, build, and optimize a Data Science platform. Position Summary

Base-2 Solutions is seeking a Data Scientist to perform research-level data analytics at a customer site in Bethesda, MD.  Work closely with a team of data scientists, software developers, network engineers, senior investigators, program managers, researchers, and data analysts to design, build, and optimize a Data Science platform.  Analyze a variety of big data covering national security, cybersecurity, business intelligence, online social media, human behavior, and more.  Support multiple simultaneous projects, independently and collaboratively making mission-relevant discoveries and delivering findings to non-technical audiences.  Identify novel data sources to improve predictive algorithms and encourage user adoption of data analytics platforms.  Leverage expertise in research design, exploratory analysis, quantitative methods, user interface application design, and customer outreach and engagement.

 B.S. Degree in a quantitative or analytical field such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, or Computational Social Science with 2+ years of experience; or Master's degree or equivalent graduate degree including certificate-based advanced training courses with less than 2 years of experience. Ability to analyze and assess software development or data acquisition requirements and determine cost-effective solutions.  Familiarity with git or other version control technologies.  Ability to own work and complete tasks on time with little or no supervision.

company.name: NORC at the University of Chicago

rows.descriptionText:
Job Summary

NORC at the University of Chicago is seeking a Research Associate I to join the Health Sciences Research Department.  This Research Associate I will be responsible for providing general support to research projects. Research Associates are responsible for project support and completing tasks related to research design, data collection, study management systems design and testing, monitoring, cleaning, analysis and delivery; assisting Task Leads and/or the Project Manager in keeping tasks on track; developing instruments for quantitative and/or qualitative data collection; planning and conducting a wide range of data collection activities; and contributing to the preparation of trainings, proposals, reports, and presentations.

The role will be supporting a large-scale, long-term NIH funded research initiative designed to advance precision medicine by building one of the most comprehensive and diverse health databases in the United States. The initiative aims to collect multiple types of health information on participants, including electronic health records, surveys, genomic data, physical measurements, biospecimens, environmental information, and data from wearable technologies. NORC supports rigorous data collection methods through systems development and participant and partner support for this initiative.

Location : This is a hybrid role based in our Chicago Loop or Washington, DC, office, with a minimum of six days per month in the office. 

Qualified applicants must be eligible to work in the U.S. We regret that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future.

DEPARTMENT: Health Sciences

NORC’s Health Sciences staff produce rich data on health care priorities including the use of innovative survey methods, the use of electronic clinical data in research, and the applications and effectiveness of health information technology.  

NORC’s Health Sciences staff work closely with colleagues across the organization to offer program, policy, and research solutions. Our work is guided by a commitment to long-lasting partnerships, transparency, and high-quality, nonpartisan research that improves health and health care for all people. 

Responsibilities

Project responsibilities 

 Support activities through documentation and administrative coordination.   Taking supporting role on key tasks related to research design, data collection and analysis while helping the Project Manager keep tasks on track  Maintain project documentation, processes, and data-related records.   Track deliverables, deadlines, and action items.   Collaborate with technical and non-technical team members.   Develop training materials for internal users of technical systems.   Create user guides, job aids, and other instructional resources.   Translate technical processes into clear, easy-to-understand content.   Maintain and update training documentation as systems and processes evolve.   Track attendance, completion rates, and training records using learning management systems (LMS).  Leverage AI tools to enhance training materials, improving learner engagement, readability, and accessibility.  Conduct background research including literature reviews, environmental scans, draft memos, summaries, and sections of reports under direction of more senior staff  Serve as a liaison with other departments (e.g., TSSO, Statistics, IT, etc.) to execute project plans. 

Additional duties

 Provide general support on proposals and projects related to health research.   Takes meeting notes and prepares meeting summaries.   Supports proposal development efforts through coordination of document preparation and reproduction.  

Required Skills

 Bachelor's degree in health policy, public health, public administration, sociology, or other social science-related field.   6 months of research experience (internships included) in social sciences with qualitative and/or quantitative methods and analysis required.   Outstanding interpersonal, critical reasoning, analytic, and writing skills.    Strong problem-solving capabilities.     Demonstrated attentiveness to detailed tasks, strong organizational and time management skills.    Ability to meet multiple requirements simultaneously, and to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.     Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including MS Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive.     Experience conducting analysis using standard statistical software packages (e.g., R, Python) is beneficial.     Experience with Absorb/Articulate is beneficial.  Occasional travel for site visits and meetings may be required.   This is a hybrid role based in our Chicago Loop or Washington, DC office, with a minimum of six days per month in the office.  

Qualified applicants must be eligible to work in the U.S. We regret that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position.

Please include a Resume and Cover Letter when applying. Candidates should be prepared to provide professional references upon request. 

Salary And Benefits

The pay range for this position is $56,000. 

Benefits

This position is classified as regular. Regular staff are eligible for NORC’s comprehensive benefits program. Benefits include, but are not limited to:

 Generously subsidized health insurance, effective on the first day of employment  Dental and vision insurance  A defined contribution retirement program, along with a separate voluntary 403(b) retirement program  Group life insurance, long-term and short-term disability insurance  Benefits that promote work/life balance, including generous paid time off, holidays; paid parental leave, bereavement leave, tuition assistance, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP). 

NORC is committed to equity and transparency in its pay practices. We publish salary ranges and benefit information for every job. The listed hiring range reflects what we, in good faith, expect to pay at the time of posting, though actual compensation may vary and may be adjusted over time. A candidate’s placement within the range depends on factors such as competencies, education, qualifications, experience, skills, performance, and organizational needs.

What We Do

NORC at the University of Chicago is an objective, non-partisan research institution that delivers reliable data and rigorous analysis to guide critical programmatic, business, and policy decisions. Since 1941, our teams have conducted groundbreaking studies, created and applied innovative methods and tools, and advanced principles of scientific integrity and collaboration. Today, government, corporate, and nonprofit clients around the world partner with us to transform increasingly complex information into useful knowledge.

Who We Are

For over 80 years, NORC has evolved in many ways, moving the needle with research methods, technical applications and groundbreaking research findings. But our tradition of excellence, passion for innovation, and commitment to collegiality have remained constant components of who we are as a brand, and who each of us is as a member of the NORC team. With world-class benefits, a business casual environment, and an emphasis on continuous learning, NORC is a place where people join for the stellar research and analysis work for which we’re known, and stay for the relationships they form with their colleagues who take pride in the impact their work is making on a global scale.

Eeo Statement

NORC is an equal opportunity employer. NORC evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, sexual orientation, and other legally protected characteristics.

Position Summary

Base-2 Solutions is seeking a Data Scientist to perform research-level data analytics at a customer site in Bethesda, MD. The role supports programs advancing research and advanced machine learning, natural language processing, and data fusion applications for mission-focused big data analytics. The Data Scientist will work as part of a research-focused team to advance national security objectives, analyze results, disseminate findings, and contribute to publications and presentations with actionable intelligence insights.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

 Work closely with a team of data scientists, software developers, network engineers, senior investigators, program managers, researchers, and data analysts to design, build, and optimize a Data Science platform.  Analyze a variety of big data covering national security, cybersecurity, business intelligence, online social media, human behavior, and more.  Support multiple simultaneous projects, independently and collaboratively making mission-relevant discoveries and delivering findings to non-technical audiences.  Identify novel data sources to improve predictive algorithms and encourage user adoption of data analytics platforms.  Leverage expertise in research design, exploratory analysis, quantitative methods, user interface application design, and customer outreach and engagement. 

 Required Qualifications 

 B.S. Degree in a quantitative or analytical field such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, or Computational Social Science with 2+ years of experience; or Master's degree or equivalent graduate degree including certificate-based advanced training courses with less than 2 years of experience.  Experience in data science, analytics, or quantitative intelligence analysis with progressive technical development and outcomes.  Proficiency in one or more scripting languages such as Python.  Experience deploying data science applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and/or OpenShift.  Experience with information retrieval and search technologies such as Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch and Kibana) and/or Structured Query Language (SQL).  Experience working with hybrid teams of analysts, engineers, and developers to conduct research and build and deploy complex but user-friendly algorithms and analytical platforms.  Previous experience performing Data Science or Research in data analytics or big data that does not fit in memory.  Track record of active learning and creative problem solving.  Ability to analyze and assess software development or data acquisition requirements and determine cost-effective solutions.  Familiarity with git or other version control technologies.  Ability to own work and complete tasks on time with little or no supervision. 

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Significant data analytics experience supporting military or intelligence community customers with progressive technical development and mission-focused outcomes.  Experience with at least two of the following data classes: forensic media (DOMEX), open source publicly available information (PAI), measurement and signatures intelligence (MASINT), or cybersecurity and cyber forensics.  Experience with Knowledge Graphs and related technologies such as neo4j or graph machine learning.  Experience developing predictive algorithms, image classifiers, and object detectors.  Familiarity with social network analysis, supply chain analysis, forensic accounting, pattern of life analysis, natural language processing, social media analysis, classification algorithms, and/or image processing.  Experience blending analytical methodologies and leveraging existing COTS/GOTS/OS tools in unconventional ways.  Experience with on-premises air-gapped environments and/or Amazon Web Services (AWS/C2S).  Familiarity with hardware platforms such as CPUs, GPUs, and FPGAs. 

 Required Education and Experience Equivalency 

 B.S. Degree in a quantitative or analytical field with 2+ years of experience.  Master's degree or equivalent graduate degree including certificate-based advanced training courses with Less than 2 years of experience. 

 Required Certifications 

 None specified. 

 Required Security Clearance 

 Active Top Secret/SCI 

 Pay & Benefit Highlights  Compensation 

 Competitive fixed salary or hourly pay (based on experience, skills, location, and internal equity).  Employee referral bonuses up to $10,000 per hired referral.  Additional bonus opportunities for exceptional performance and contributions to business development and company growth (role-dependent). 

 Health 

 100% company-paid medical premiums for employees and eligible dependents.  Choose from multiple plan options with CareFirst, Kaiser, and UnitedHealthcare, including PPO, POS, HMO, and HSA-compatible plans.  100% company-paid dental premiums for employees and eligible dependents.  100% company-paid vision premiums for employees and eligible dependents. 

 Income Protection 

 100% company-paid premiums for short-term disability.  100% company-paid premiums for long-term disability.  100% company-paid premiums for accidental death & dismemberment (AD&D).  100% company-paid premiums for life insurance up to $200,000. 

 Retirement 

 401(k) with immediate vesting: 4% company match plus a 4% non-elective company contribution (8% total).  401(k) pre-tax and Roth options. 

 Leave 

 Up to 20 days of flexible paid time off (PTO).  11 paid floating holidays.

 Flexible work schedules, including flex time and compressed work periods (contract and project-dependent).
