rows.title: AI Execution Analyst and Reporting Lead 1 1 1
rows.descriptionText:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Today's world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of over 1000 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets. Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team help protect the EY brand and build client trust.

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.

The opportunity

As an Associate Director in Information Security, this position leads the application of AI engineering within a global technology program, working closely with program leadership, workstream leads and technologists from across the globe. The position is responsible for the AI agents and automation that produce the program's reporting to senior leadership and to regional teams, and for the technical standards that govern how the program builds with AI.

This position also serves as the AI leader for Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy, guiding teams across the function on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within our services and processes. This includes identifying which assurance, risk and policy activities are suited to AI, advising teams on the approach to take, and establishing the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function.

This is a hands-on engineering position at a senior technical grade, with authority across the program and no direct reports. The position runs and builds AI agents and automation using Claude alongside Python, Power Automate, and the Microsoft platform, and determines what work is given to an agent, how agent output is verified, and what remains with people.

Areas of focus

AI Engineering: Building agentic workflows in Claude that complete an entire piece of work, from reading source data through to producing the finished output.Functional AI Leadership: Acting as the AI leader for Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy, guiding teams on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes.Automation Delivery: Owning a program's automation estate, including what is automated, how it is built, and how it is supported over time.Assurance of AI Output: Accountability for reporting that is accurate, reconciled and defensible, with verification of agent output built into the systems that produce it.AI Standards and Capability: Setting the technical direction and standards for how the program builds with AI, and developing engineering capability across the program.

Key Responsibilities

Key responsibilities include:

Design, build and operate the AI agents and automation that produce the program's recurring reporting, using Claude and Claude Code, integrated with the enterprise systems.Own the AI and automation roadmap for the program, prioritizing work according to the effort it saves and the risk it reduces.Guide teams across Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes, including which activities are suited to AI and the approach to take.Establish the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function, and support teams in applying them.Establish how AI output is verified, including reconciliation and checks against source data on every run, and define the conditions under which an agent must stop and escalate rather than continue.Set the standards the program builds to for AI use, covering how work is scoped to an agent, prompt and context engineering, testing for repeatability, documentation and the handling of sensitive data.Advise program leadership on where AI is appropriate, including where a conventional solution is the better answer, and on the cost, risk and effort involved.Evaluate developments in AI tooling and models and introduce what is of value to the program.Build automation that is resilient and supportable, with error handling, secure credential management, logging and alerting, held in version control and documented so that it can be maintained by others.Work with IT and Information Security to secure approval, connectivity and ongoing support for AI tooling, and build within firm policy on AI use, data classification and client confidentiality.Represent the program's AI and automation position to senior stakeholders and governance forums.Develop AI engineering capability across the program through reusable components, documented patterns and practical working sessions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Proven technical authority in AI engineering, built on agents and automation in production that other people depend on.Ability to judge where AI is the right tool, where a conventional solution is better, and what should remain manual.Understanding of the limitations of AI models, and the ability to design verification appropriate to those limitations.Strong analytical skills, with the ability to validate the accuracy of reporting relied on by senior leadership.Capable of building relationships with senior stakeholders.Proficient in explaining technical trade-offs and their business implications to a non-technical audience.Ability to work independently and set technical priorities in a large program.Ability to team well with others and raise the AI engineering capability of colleagues.Strong organizational skills and the ability to deliver against fixed reporting deadlines.Ability to maintain a high level of integrity, trustworthiness and confidence when handling confidential information.

To qualify for the role, you must have

At least 10 years of experience in software, automation or data engineering, including significant time as a senior individual contributor with technical ownership of systems in production.Demonstrable experience building production solutions with Claude, including Claude Code and the Claude Agent SDK.Experience designing agentic workflows that complete an end-to-end task.Practical prompt and context engineering, including testing that model output is reliable and repeatable.Strong Python, including automation of document and data workflows with libraries such as python-pptx, python-docx, openpyxl and pandas, or the equivalent.Microsoft platform experience: Power Apps, Power BI, Dataverse, Copilot Studio and Microsoft Graph.Production experience with a major enterprise workflow automation platform such as Power Automate, including error handling and unattended runs.A track record of automating a recurring operational or reporting process end to end, with demonstrable outcomes.Experience building unattended systems that run reliably, including error handling, credential management, logging, alerting and scheduling.Experience working with large datasets drawn from multiple systems, including reconciling them and assessing whether the data supports the conclusions being drawn from it.Experience setting technical standards that other people build to, through review, shared components or documented patterns.A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.Strong English language communication skills and the ability to work with diverse, globally distributed teams.

Ideally, you'll also have

Experience integrating AI tooling with enterprise systems and data sources.Experience introducing AI tooling into a governed enterprise environment, including the approval and assurance path.Experience evaluating models or agent frameworks and making an adoption recommendation.Experience delivering security, technology risk or audit reporting to a senior audience.Familiarity with vulnerability management data and tooling.Experience coaching or building technical capability in colleagues who are not engineers.Relevant certification in cloud, data or security engineering.

What We Look For

We are looking for individuals with a passion for applied AI and a demonstrated ability to build with it to a standard that a global professional services firm can rely on. This is a senior hands-on position for someone who wants to build AI into the way a large program works and to set the standard for how it is used.

What We Offer You

The compensation ranges below are provided in order to comply with United States pay transparency laws. Other geographies will follow their local salary guidelines, which may not be a direct conversion of published US salary ranges. At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $188,600 to $339,400Bay Area California offices – $196,400 to $353,600All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $157,100 to $311,100 Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

rows.title: Marketing & Brand Design Associate — Two Brands. Two Industries. A Lot to Create.
rows.descriptionText:
Description

Marketing | Brand Design | Content | Digital | Creative

Full-Time | Washington, DC | In-Person | $50,000–$70,000 + Overtime Eligible

Some marketing jobs give you one channel to manage.

This one gives you two brands to help build.

Hylton-Rodic Law is a growing intellectual property law firm working at the intersection of science, technology, law, and innovation. EPIARX Diagnostics is a growing private pathology practice helping families, healthcare organizations, attorneys, and other professionals find answers when they matter most.

Different industries. Different audiences. Different voices.

And one creative role with a lot of room to make your mark.

We're looking for an emerging marketer and designer with serious creative instincts—someone who doesn't just know how to make things, but has ideas about what should be made and how to make it better.

You might spend one morning developing the visual concept for a life-sciences campaign and the afternoon creating collateral for a new pathology service. You could design a conference campaign, build a newsletter, develop a new sub-brand, reimagine a webpage, turn a technical topic into a scroll-stopping LinkedIn post, create firm swag, or take a rough business-development idea from “What if we...?” to finished campaign.

We will give you context, objectives, feedback, and room to grow.

We do not want to give you every creative answer.

We want someone who can take a rough idea, push it further, and occasionally put something in front of us that makes us stop and think: “You just blew our socks off.”

Not every project. Not every time.

But if the idea of occasionally surprising us with something better than what we asked for sounds like your kind of challenge, keep reading.

Two Organizations. Two Very Different Stories to Tell.

Hylton-Rodic Law (HRL)

HRL is a boutique intellectual property law firm headquartered in Washington, DC. We work with biotechnology, pharmaceutical, university, and life-sciences innovators to protect and commercialize technologies shaping the future of medicine and science.

Our brand is sophisticated, intelligent, polished, creative, and decidedly not stuffy. You'll help us tell the stories behind innovative technologies, our people, our clients, and a law firm we're deliberately building differently.

EPIARX Diagnostics

EPIARX is a modern private pathology practice providing independent autopsy, pathology, consultation, and related services. Our audiences range from families seeking answers to funeral homes, hospitals, attorneys, and healthcare professionals.

The voice is different: clear, compassionate, trustworthy, accessible, and human.

EPIARX is growing its services, referral relationships, and regional presence. You won't simply maintain an established brand. You'll help build what comes next.

Working across both organizations will teach you something enormously valuable: how to understand an audience, switch voices, translate complicated subjects, and create marketing that actually supports growth.

What You'll Actually Do

You'll work across HRL and EPIARX, with priorities shifting as campaigns, events, business-development initiatives, and organizational needs evolve.

You'll Help

Create original visual concepts, graphics, carousels, social content, and campaigns for LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and other channels.Write, edit, design, and publish newsletters, blogs, website content, email campaigns, and digital communications.Turn complicated topics in intellectual property, life sciences, healthcare, and pathology into content people can actually understand—and want to read.Create polished print and physical collateral, including brochures, flyers, conference materials, mailers, signage, leave-behinds, business cards, and branded materials.Maintain and develop both organizations' Squarespace websites, including content, imagery, layout, landing pages, and new marketing initiatives.Support SEO/AIO and digital-content optimization.Build marketing calendars and move campaigns from idea ? creation ? review ? publication.Help develop brands and sub-brands, including visual concepts, service identities, messaging, taglines, templates, and branded materials.Support email campaigns and CRM/marketing data through GoHighLevel.Help coordinate conferences, webinars, sponsorships, speaking engagements, and other events.Partner with business-development team members on campaigns, presentations, outreach materials, and growth initiatives.Coordinate with printers, photographers, designers, and other outside partners when needed.Create internal culture materials, welcome items, celebrations, swag, and the occasional project we haven't thought of yet.

And most importantly: Bring ideas.

We don't expect every idea to be used.

We do expect you to have them.

We Can Teach You Our Industries. Bring Us the Creative Instinct.

You do not need to arrive knowing patent law or pathology.

You do need to be curious enough to learn them.

And you need an eye.

You understand typography, composition, hierarchy, imagery, color, spacing, and the details that separate something merely finished from something genuinely designed.

You can start with a blank page—not just a template.

You can take a rough brief, develop a creative direction, make thoughtful choices, and explain why you made them.

You write exceptionally well and understand that words and visuals have to work together.

You notice when something isn't good enough before someone else has to tell you.

You are comfortable receiving detailed feedback, revising your work, killing an idea that isn't working, and coming back with something better.

Your first draft should give us something to react to—not something we have to rescue.

We're not looking for someone who has already mastered everything.

We're looking for talent, taste, curiosity, judgment, drive, and the desire to become exceptional.

Requirements

What You Should Bring

Required

Bachelor's degree or equivalent demonstrated experience in graphic design, visual communication, marketing, advertising, communications, or a related creative discipline.Approximately 0–4 years of relevant professional experience, including substantive internships, freelance work, or exceptional student work.A portfolio demonstrating strong original visual-design work.Strong understanding of typography, composition, visual hierarchy, layout, and brand consistency.Exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading skills.Experience creating digital and/or print marketing materials.Ability to take a creative brief from concept through finished execution.Strong organization and project-management skills.Proficiency with modern creative tools. Canva is useful, but Canva proficiency alone is not the design qualification for this role.

Especially Valuable

Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Illustrator, InDesign, and/or Photoshop.Figma or comparable design tools.Squarespace or other website-building experience.CRM/email-marketing experience; GoHighLevel is a plus.SEO/AIO or digital-content optimization.Photography, video, motion graphics, or multimedia production.Experience developing visual identities, campaigns, or brand systems.Experience with science, healthcare, technology, professional services, or other complex subject matter.Bachelor's degree or equivalent demonstrated experience in graphic design, visual communication, marketing, advertising, communications, or a related creative discipline.Approximately 0–4 years of relevant professional experience, including substantive internships, freelance work, or exceptional student work.

Compensation & Benefits

This position is non-exempt and overtime eligible.

Benefits include health, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) with employer matching; commuter benefits; paid time off; mental-health days; celebratory birthday leave; Sunshine Fridays; professional-development support; and our extended year-end holiday break.

Yes, We Want to See Your Work.

A résumé tells us where you've been.

Your Portfolio Tells Us What You Can Do.

Please submit one combined PDF application package, in this order:

Cover letterRésuméCollege transcript — unofficial is acceptablePortfolio/work samples

Your portfolio should include 3–6 examples of your strongest work. Professional, internship, freelance, academic, student-organization, and personal projects are all welcome.

For at least two pieces, briefly tell us: What was the objective? Who was the audience? What did you personally create? What creative choices did you make—and why?

If a piece was collaborative, clearly identify your contribution.

Applications without a portfolio demonstrating original creative work will not be considered.

Your Cover Letter

Please don't use your cover letter to summarize your résumé.

We already have that.

Instead, imagine it's your first week working with us.

You have been asked to create one piece of marketing for HRL and one for EPIARX.

What would you create—and why?

Then tell us briefly about one piece of marketing, design, content, or brand work you've created that you're particularly proud of. What did you contribute? What problem were you trying to solve? What made the finished work successful in your view?

There are no “right” answers.

We Want To See How You Think.

Please combine all four required application materials into a single PDF before uploading. Incomplete application packages will not be considered.

Operations Analyst - Full time - Hybrid - Arlington, VA
The Operations Analyst - Journeyman serves as a specialized systems analyst focused on service level objective (SLO) performance across mission‑critical services in a highly regulated federal IT environment. The role designs and maintains SLO monitoring and reporting solutions, analyzes performance data, and recommends technical and process improvements to keep services within agreed thresholds. The analyst collaborates closely with incident, problem, and performance management teams to investigate SLO breaches, coordinate remediation with service providers, and ensure operational expectations and documentation remain current and actionable.
Key Responsibilities

Define, implement, and maintain SLO monitoring solutions for complex enterprise systems, including thoughtful threshold design, alerting rules, and performance dashboards that align with business and mission priorities.
Analyze key performance indicators and SLO trend data to identify root causes of degradation, translate findings into actionable technical changes and process improvements, and track outcomes over time.
Collaborate with incident, problem, and performance management functions to investigate SLO breaches, correlate events across systems, and drive sustainable remediation with infrastructure and application owners.
Develop, maintain, and regularly update SLO documentation, service catalogs, and operational level agreements to clearly capture expectations, dependencies, and escalation paths for supported services.
Integrate SLO management into end‑to‑end IT service management lifecycle activities using ITIL‑aligned practices and enterprise ticketing and monitoring platforms.
Produce concise compliance dashboards, reports, and stakeholder‑facing visualizations that highlight SLO status, emerging risk, and impact to mission‑critical services.
Coordinate with infrastructure and application owners to validate monitoring coverage, troubleshoot SLO‑related issues, and support continuous service improvement initiatives.
Maintain awareness of DoD 8140 baseline certification expectations and security protocols, ensuring SLO monitoring and reporting activities comply with clearance and data access requirements.

Rate - 70,000 - 91,000/yr
Required Qualifications

U.S. citizenship with an Active Secret Clearance
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
Typically 4-7 years of experience monitoring, managing, and reporting on SLO compliance in technical, highly regulated environments, including federal or defense IT.
Demonstrated experience working with incident, problem, and performance management processes and tools in an ITIL‑aligned service environment.
Meets DoD 8140 requirements and holds an active Secret clearance appropriate for work in a cleared federal IT environment.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills with the ability to interpret performance data and clearly convey findings to technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with enterprise application performance monitoring (APM) or observability platforms (e.g., APM, log analytics, distributed tracing) used for fine‑grained SLO analysis.
Hands‑on background with incident and problem management supporting government or defense organizations in an ITIL‑based service desk context.
Possession of a DoD 8140‑recognized cybersecurity or IT certification such as Security+ or an equivalent baseline credential.
Familiarity with compliance reporting for federal stakeholders and experience presenting metrics and SLO status to leadership forums or service review boards.

rows.descriptionText:
Job Summary

NORC at the University of Chicago is seeking a Research Associate I to join the Health Sciences Research Department.  This Research Associate I will be responsible for providing general support to research projects. Research Associates are responsible for project support and completing tasks related to research design, data collection, study management systems design and testing, monitoring, cleaning, analysis and delivery; assisting Task Leads and/or the Project Manager in keeping tasks on track; developing instruments for quantitative and/or qualitative data collection; planning and conducting a wide range of data collection activities; and contributing to the preparation of trainings, proposals, reports, and presentations.

The role will be supporting a large-scale, long-term NIH funded research initiative designed to advance precision medicine by building one of the most comprehensive and diverse health databases in the United States. The initiative aims to collect multiple types of health information on participants, including electronic health records, surveys, genomic data, physical measurements, biospecimens, environmental information, and data from wearable technologies. NORC supports rigorous data collection methods through systems development and participant and partner support for this initiative.

Location : This is a hybrid role based in our Chicago Loop or Washington, DC, office, with a minimum of six days per month in the office. 

Qualified applicants must be eligible to work in the U.S. We regret that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future.

DEPARTMENT: Health Sciences

NORC’s Health Sciences staff produce rich data on health care priorities including the use of innovative survey methods, the use of electronic clinical data in research, and the applications and effectiveness of health information technology.  

NORC’s Health Sciences staff work closely with colleagues across the organization to offer program, policy, and research solutions. Our work is guided by a commitment to long-lasting partnerships, transparency, and high-quality, nonpartisan research that improves health and health care for all people. 

Responsibilities

Project responsibilities 

 Support activities through documentation and administrative coordination.   Taking supporting role on key tasks related to research design, data collection and analysis while helping the Project Manager keep tasks on track  Maintain project documentation, processes, and data-related records.   Track deliverables, deadlines, and action items.   Collaborate with technical and non-technical team members.   Develop training materials for internal users of technical systems.   Create user guides, job aids, and other instructional resources.   Translate technical processes into clear, easy-to-understand content.   Maintain and update training documentation as systems and processes evolve.   Track attendance, completion rates, and training records using learning management systems (LMS).  Leverage AI tools to enhance training materials, improving learner engagement, readability, and accessibility.  Conduct background research including literature reviews, environmental scans, draft memos, summaries, and sections of reports under direction of more senior staff  Serve as a liaison with other departments (e.g., TSSO, Statistics, IT, etc.) to execute project plans. 

Additional duties

 Provide general support on proposals and projects related to health research.   Takes meeting notes and prepares meeting summaries.   Supports proposal development efforts through coordination of document preparation and reproduction.  

Required Skills

 Bachelor's degree in health policy, public health, public administration, sociology, or other social science-related field.   6 months of research experience (internships included) in social sciences with qualitative and/or quantitative methods and analysis required.   Outstanding interpersonal, critical reasoning, analytic, and writing skills.    Strong problem-solving capabilities.     Demonstrated attentiveness to detailed tasks, strong organizational and time management skills.    Ability to meet multiple requirements simultaneously, and to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.     Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including MS Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive.     Experience conducting analysis using standard statistical software packages (e.g., R, Python) is beneficial.     Experience with Absorb/Articulate is beneficial.  Occasional travel for site visits and meetings may be required.   This is a hybrid role based in our Chicago Loop or Washington, DC office, with a minimum of six days per month in the office.  

Qualified applicants must be eligible to work in the U.S. We regret that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position.

Please include a Resume and Cover Letter when applying. Candidates should be prepared to provide professional references upon request. 

Salary And Benefits

The pay range for this position is $56,000. 

Benefits

This position is classified as regular. Regular staff are eligible for NORC’s comprehensive benefits program. Benefits include, but are not limited to:

 Generously subsidized health insurance, effective on the first day of employment  Dental and vision insurance  A defined contribution retirement program, along with a separate voluntary 403(b) retirement program  Group life insurance, long-term and short-term disability insurance  Benefits that promote work/life balance, including generous paid time off, holidays; paid parental leave, bereavement leave, tuition assistance, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP). 

NORC is committed to equity and transparency in its pay practices. We publish salary ranges and benefit information for every job. The listed hiring range reflects what we, in good faith, expect to pay at the time of posting, though actual compensation may vary and may be adjusted over time. A candidate’s placement within the range depends on factors such as competencies, education, qualifications, experience, skills, performance, and organizational needs.

What We Do

NORC at the University of Chicago is an objective, non-partisan research institution that delivers reliable data and rigorous analysis to guide critical programmatic, business, and policy decisions. Since 1941, our teams have conducted groundbreaking studies, created and applied innovative methods and tools, and advanced principles of scientific integrity and collaboration. Today, government, corporate, and nonprofit clients around the world partner with us to transform increasingly complex information into useful knowledge.

Who We Are

For over 80 years, NORC has evolved in many ways, moving the needle with research methods, technical applications and groundbreaking research findings. But our tradition of excellence, passion for innovation, and commitment to collegiality have remained constant components of who we are as a brand, and who each of us is as a member of the NORC team. With world-class benefits, a business casual environment, and an emphasis on continuous learning, NORC is a place where people join for the stellar research and analysis work for which we’re known, and stay for the relationships they form with their colleagues who take pride in the impact their work is making on a global scale.

NORC is an equal opportunity employer. NORC evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, sexual orientation, and other legally protected characteristics.

rows.descriptionText:
111 Michigan Avenue Northwest Washington, DC 20010

Kids Are Our Everything.

Department

10379 Ctr for Cancer Immunology Rsch

Pay Range

$51,584.00 - $85,987.20

The Clinical Research Coordinator participates in or leads day-to-day operations of clinical research studies conducted by a principal investigator. The Research Coordinator performs a variety of duties involved in the collection, compilation, documentation and analysis of clinical research data. The Research Coordinator will develop a progressive functional knowledge of Good Clinical Practices (GCP), Office of Human Research Protections (OHRP) regulations and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations. This position may direct the work of junior staff, train personnel and direct the work of a Clinical Research Assistant as assigned.

Minimum Education

B.A./B.S. degree in a science, technical, health-related field or other applicable discipline (Required)

Minimum Work Experience

1 year of applicable work, research or internship experience (e.g. research assistant, data manager, clinician or other interaction with a research population). (Required)

Functional Accountabilities

Responsible Conduct of Research

Consistently demonstrates adherence to the standards for the responsible conduct of research. Plans, conducts and manages research projects within federal and institutional regulations and policies under the direction of the principal investigator. Stays informed of and adheres to institutional policies and federal regulations (e.g. Titles 21 and 45 of the Code of Federal Regulations) and guidance (International Counsel on Harmonization) regarding human subjects research and use of protected health information. Uses research funds and resources appropriately. Maintains confidentiality of data as required. Meets all annual job-related training and compliance requirements. 

Research Administration

Maintains knowledge and comprehension of assigned research protocols, including study procedures, timelines and eligibility. Accurately creates, completes, maintains and organizes study documents. Accounts for study materials, including participant lists and visit logs, regulatory binders, case report forms, laboratory kits, investigational product(s) and participation incentives. Uses and accounts for research funds and resources at performance level, including reconciling research subject billing if assigned. Reviews current literature to obtain information relevant to clinical research program, as directed. Attends study meetings, which could include overnight travel, as requested by principal investigator. Works well with other members of the research team and seeks and provides input when appropriate. Serves as an effective liaison between the investigators, sponsors, hospital departments involved with research studies and the Clinical Research Center. 

Participant Enrollment

Employs strategies to recruit and retain research participants, while adhering to the IRB-approved recruitment plan.Screens subjects for eligibility per the protocol and institutional policies.Communicates effectively and provides information to a diverse, vulnerable subject population in accordance with institutional policies.Independently coordinates, conducts and documents visits and protocol-specific testing/interviews according to study protocol, operational plans of clinical departments and SOPs for minimal risk studies or for other studies under direction.Interacts with study participants and/or legally authorized representatives (LARs) to communicate study purpose and participation details and to assess participation interest.Engages participants/LARs in the informed consent process according to institutional policies.Follows procedures for documentation of study payments and participation incentives.

Study Management

Plans, conducts and manages research activities in accordance with federal regulations and guidance documents and sponsor and institutional policies under the direction of a senior study team member. Ensures regulatory integrity of protocols through the accurate and timely preparation and submission of documents and reports to the sponsor, IRB and other oversight bodies in accordance with federal regulations, sponsor SOPs and institutional policies. Collects, prepares, processes, ships and maintains accurate inventory of research specimens, and trains others in performing these tasks. Suggests improvements to specimen handling processes, when needed. Authors study documents, including informed consents, protocol-specific source documents and IRB contingency responses. Registers and records participant visits in the appropriate tracking system. Anticipates study needs and subject caseload in order to meet organizational objectives and deadlines in a timely manner. Coordinates, prepares for and responds to routine oversight body visits and audits. Performs query resolution and assists with addressing and correcting audit findings. 

Data Collection

Collects data from patient medical records, interviews, questionnaires, diagnostic tests and other sources. Ensures data is collected as required by protocol and in accordance with research data principles (ALCOAC: Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate and Complete). Ensures that queries are resolved within sponsor and institutional timelines. Plans and performs research specimen collection, labeling and storage/shipping if assigned; maintains accurate sample accountability/chain of custody documentation. Ensures secure storage of study documents. 

Benefits That Support You

Comprehensive health coverage, including medical, prescription, infertility, and transgender health services.Generous paid time off, including vacation accrual from day one, sick leave, holidays, and a personal day.Financial wellness support, including a 401(k) plan and healthcare and dependent care spending accounts.Employer-paid life, AD&D, and long-term disability coverage, with optional supplemental plans.Additional perks, including tuition assistance, fitness resources, employee assistance, commuter benefits, and more.

Position Summary

Base-2 Solutions is seeking a Data Scientist to perform research-level data analytics at a customer site in Bethesda, MD. The role supports programs advancing research and advanced machine learning, natural language processing, and data fusion applications for mission-focused big data analytics. The Data Scientist will work as part of a research-focused team to advance national security objectives, analyze results, disseminate findings, and contribute to publications and presentations with actionable intelligence insights.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

 Work closely with a team of data scientists, software developers, network engineers, senior investigators, program managers, researchers, and data analysts to design, build, and optimize a Data Science platform.  Analyze a variety of big data covering national security, cybersecurity, business intelligence, online social media, human behavior, and more.  Support multiple simultaneous projects, independently and collaboratively making mission-relevant discoveries and delivering findings to non-technical audiences.  Identify novel data sources to improve predictive algorithms and encourage user adoption of data analytics platforms.  Leverage expertise in research design, exploratory analysis, quantitative methods, user interface application design, and customer outreach and engagement. 

 Required Qualifications 

 B.S. Degree in a quantitative or analytical field such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, or Computational Social Science with 2+ years of experience; or Master's degree or equivalent graduate degree including certificate-based advanced training courses with less than 2 years of experience.  Experience in data science, analytics, or quantitative intelligence analysis with progressive technical development and outcomes.  Proficiency in one or more scripting languages such as Python.  Experience deploying data science applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and/or OpenShift.  Experience with information retrieval and search technologies such as Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch and Kibana) and/or Structured Query Language (SQL).  Experience working with hybrid teams of analysts, engineers, and developers to conduct research and build and deploy complex but user-friendly algorithms and analytical platforms.  Previous experience performing Data Science or Research in data analytics or big data that does not fit in memory.  Track record of active learning and creative problem solving.  Ability to analyze and assess software development or data acquisition requirements and determine cost-effective solutions.  Familiarity with git or other version control technologies.  Ability to own work and complete tasks on time with little or no supervision. 

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Significant data analytics experience supporting military or intelligence community customers with progressive technical development and mission-focused outcomes.  Experience with at least two of the following data classes: forensic media (DOMEX), open source publicly available information (PAI), measurement and signatures intelligence (MASINT), or cybersecurity and cyber forensics.  Experience with Knowledge Graphs and related technologies such as neo4j or graph machine learning.  Experience developing predictive algorithms, image classifiers, and object detectors.  Familiarity with social network analysis, supply chain analysis, forensic accounting, pattern of life analysis, natural language processing, social media analysis, classification algorithms, and/or image processing.  Experience blending analytical methodologies and leveraging existing COTS/GOTS/OS tools in unconventional ways.  Experience with on-premises air-gapped environments and/or Amazon Web Services (AWS/C2S).  Familiarity with hardware platforms such as CPUs, GPUs, and FPGAs. 

 Required Education and Experience Equivalency 

 B.S. Degree in a quantitative or analytical field with 2+ years of experience.  Master's degree or equivalent graduate degree including certificate-based advanced training courses with Less than 2 years of experience. 

 Required Certifications 

 None specified.

 Active Top Secret/SCI

 Competitive fixed salary or hourly pay (based on experience, skills, location, and internal equity).  Employee referral bonuses up to $10,000 per hired referral.  Additional bonus opportunities for exceptional performance and contributions to business development and company growth (role-dependent).

Choose from multiple plan options with CareFirst, Kaiser, and UnitedHealthcare, including PPO, POS, HMO, and HSA-compatible plans.  100% company-paid dental premiums for employees and eligible dependents.  100% company-paid vision premiums for employees and eligible dependents.

Position Summary

Base-2 Solutions is seeking a Data Scientist to perform research-level data analytics at a customer site in Bethesda, MD. The role supports programs advancing research and advanced machine learning, natural language processing, and data fusion applications for mission-focused big data analytics. The Data Scientist will work as part of a research-focused team to advance national security objectives, analyze results, disseminate findings, and contribute to publications and presentations with actionable intelligence insights.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

 Work closely with a team of data scientists, software developers, network engineers, senior investigators, program managers, researchers, and data analysts to design, build, and optimize a Data Science platform.  Analyze a variety of big data covering national security, cybersecurity, business intelligence, online social media, human behavior, and more.  Support multiple simultaneous projects, independently and collaboratively making mission-relevant discoveries and delivering findings to non-technical audiences.  Identify novel data sources to improve predictive algorithms and encourage user adoption of data analytics platforms.  Leverage expertise in research design, exploratory analysis, quantitative methods, user interface application design, and customer outreach and engagement. 

 Required Qualifications 

 B.S. Degree in a quantitative or analytical field such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, or Computational Social Science with 2+ years of experience; or Master's degree or equivalent graduate degree including certificate-based advanced training courses with less than 2 years of experience.  Experience in data science, analytics, or quantitative intelligence analysis with progressive technical development and outcomes.  Proficiency in one or more scripting languages such as Python.  Experience deploying data science applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and/or OpenShift.  Experience with information retrieval and search technologies such as Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch and Kibana) and/or Structured Query Language (SQL).  Experience working with hybrid teams of analysts, engineers, and developers to conduct research and build and deploy complex but user-friendly algorithms and analytical platforms.  Previous experience performing Data Science or Research in data analytics or big data that does not fit in memory.  Track record of active learning and creative problem solving.  Ability to analyze and assess software development or data acquisition requirements and determine cost-effective solutions.  Familiarity with git or other version control technologies.  Ability to own work and complete tasks on time with little or no supervision. 

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Significant data analytics experience supporting military or intelligence community customers with progressive technical development and mission-focused outcomes.  Experience with at least two of the following data classes: forensic media (DOMEX), open source publicly available information (PAI), measurement and signatures intelligence (MASINT), or cybersecurity and cyber forensics.  Experience with Knowledge Graphs and related technologies such as neo4j or graph machine learning.  Experience developing predictive algorithms, image classifiers, and object detectors.  Familiarity with social network analysis, supply chain analysis, forensic accounting, pattern of life analysis, natural language processing, social media analysis, classification algorithms, and/or image processing.  Experience blending analytical methodologies and leveraging existing COTS/GOTS/OS tools in unconventional ways.  Experience with on-premises air-gapped environments and/or Amazon Web Services (AWS/C2S).  Familiarity with hardware platforms such as CPUs, GPUs, and FPGAs. 

 Required Education and Experience Equivalency 

 B.S. Degree in a quantitative or analytical field with 2+ years of experience.  Master's degree or equivalent graduate degree including certificate-based advanced training courses with Less than 2 years of experience. 

 Required Certifications 

 None specified. 

 Required Security Clearance 

 Active Top Secret/SCI

 Competitive fixed salary or hourly pay (based on experience, skills, location, and internal equity).  Employee referral bonuses up to $10,000 per hired referral.  Additional bonus opportunities for exceptional performance and contributions to business development and company growth (role-dependent). 

 Health 

 100% company-paid medical premiums for employees and eligible dependents.  Choose from multiple plan options with CareFirst, Kaiser, and UnitedHealthcare, including PPO, POS, HMO, and HSA-compatible plans.  100% company-paid dental premiums for employees and eligible dependents.  100% company-paid vision premiums for employees and eligible dependents. 

 Income Protection 

 100% company-paid premiums for short-term disability.  100% company-paid premiums for long-term disability.  100% company-paid premiums for accidental death & dismemberment (AD&D).  100% company-paid premiums for life insurance up to $200,000.

 401(k) with immediate vesting: 4% company match plus a 4% non-elective company contribution (8% total).  401(k) pre-tax and Roth options. 

 Leave 

 Up to 20 days of flexible paid time off (PTO).  11 paid floating holidays.

 Flexible work schedules, including flex time and compressed work periods (contract and project-dependent).

cFocus Software seeks a Data Scientist to join our program supporting the United States Air Force (USAF). This position is on-site in Linthicum Heights, MD. This position requires an Active TS/SCI clearance.
Qualifications:Active TS/SCI clearanceB.S. Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related fieldExperience applying data science, statistical analysis, and machine learning to practical business or mission problems.Proficiency in analytical programming and querying, with ability to build reproducible workflows.Experience cleaning and transforming data, engineering features, and assessing data quality.Experience comparing, training, testing, validating, and tuning machine learning models.Ability to select appropriate metrics, interpret results, and explain model limitations and uncertainty.Experience creating reports, visualizations, or dashboards for technical and nontechnical audiences.Understanding of version control, DevSecOps, model monitoring, and auditable model lifecycle practices.Ability to follow data governance and security requirements and collaborate with multidisciplinary teamsDuties:Work with Government stakeholders to define business problems, analytical questions, AI use cases, machine learning objectives, and performance measures for approval.Assess data readiness and supporting infrastructure, identifying gaps in data availability, quality, accessibility, and suitability for proposed analyses.Gather, clean, transform, and prepare data from Government-approved sources; support assigned AI model evaluation for knowledge or records management functions.

6-month Fixed Term Contract

We are recruiting for an Execution Specialist in our Transport HUB. This is a 6-month fixed term contract opportunity which will report into Lee Metcalfe, Transport & Planning Service Manager.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a transport department within a global business as Execution Specialist. Your role will involve driving service performance by proactively identifying and resolving potential service issues, communicating them as they are identified.

Our head office in York was chosen to become the base of Nestlé’s first and new European Transport Hub. The Hub has responsibility for planning and executing Nestlé’s transportation within Europe which simplify and standardise our European transportation processes. We manage the transport of intermarket flows between Nestlé ‘s European factories and distribution centres, as well as inbound raw and packaging materials from our major suppliers where opportunity arise.

We take pride in championing inclusion and diversity. We proudly signed the Business in the Community Race at Work Charter, are committed to Disability Confidence, and have been recognised as a Times Top 50 Employer for gender equality for three consecutive years. Additionally, we are a headline partner of Diversity and Inclusion in grocery.

Your impact

You will perform a variety of roles that range from tracking loads, to working with carriers and Nestle stakeholders to find solutions to delays, dealing with the unexpected but ultimately ensuring that all European market queries are dealt with, and every load arrives. All this whilst supporting the KPI balance of cost and service.

The main aim for this role is to drive end to end Inter-Market transportation service across Nestle markets and category businesses in Europe.

Your responsibilities will include:

Following THUB strategies to support the balance of cost and service.Working with hauliers to find viable international transport solutions.Identifying and escalating gaps, that do not support the THUB strategy with carriers, to ensure key KPIs such as service, cost, and performance are met.Be an operational point of contact for haulier enquiries and Nestle stakeholders, proactively communicating regarding load status and resolution action plans.Problem solving and identifying issues related to not meeting expected standards affecting carriers, DC's, customers, traffic, weather, etc., and work with wider team to develop effective solutions. The ideal candidate will understand Supply Chain end to end processes and will have some experience of an operational environment, ideally transport.

You will be proactive and creative to find solutions.

You will have strong communication skills, the ability to build effective working relationships across Europe and a problem-solving mentality.

You will also:

Be fluent in English (speaking and writing) - EssentialIdeally have language skills in either Spanish, Polish, German, French or Turkish – Desirable but not essential.Be data driven and able to use analytics to drive results.

rows.title: Data Governance Activation Manager
rows.descriptionText:
No Relocation Assistance Offered

Job Number #175162 - Piscataway, New Jersey, United States

Who We Are

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

THIS ROLE CAN REPORT TO OUR NYC OR PISCATAWAY, NJ OFFICE

Role Summary

As the Manager: Data Governance, you are the bridge between data policy and daily operations. Your mission is to move data governance from a set of theoretical guidelines into a living, breathing part of the company’s DNA. You will lead a data transformation program that instills data ownership, data stewardship, and key data governance disciplines, ensuring that business domains don't just "comply" with data rules but actually recognize their value on the path towards making CP’s data AI Ready. Without activation, data governance is just "shelf-ware." You are the catalyst that ensures the organization's data is trusted, discoverable, and usable, directly impacting the success of strategic AI and Analytics initiatives.

Responsibilities:

Operationalize the Framework: Translate high-level data governance policies and standards into actionable processes and workflows for business and technical teams. Stewardship Leadership: Manage a network of Data Stewards across the organization, providing them with the tools and motivation to maintain high-quality data. Build out a community of practitioners to mature the data governance best practices. Value Creation From Data Initiatives: Drive adoption of a strategic intake process to identify data use cases that solve business challenges and articulate the resulting business values. Ensure each use case contains detailed business context along with high-level data requirements that can be mapped to potential data product priority and roadmap in collaboration with domain teams. Tool Adoption: Oversee the implementation and day-to-day use of various data governance solutions (i.e. Data Catalog, Data Quality/ Data Observability, Data Security, etc.) to ensure data is discoverable, trusted and secured as a "source of truth" rather than just a mere repository for documentation. Analytics & AI Data Readiness & Enablement: Partner closely with cross functional teams to define and enforce the data standards, quality checks, and metadata enrichment necessary to produce trusted, clean, and scalable data products that will fuel CP’s most strategic AI and Analytics capabilities. Change Management: Act as the primary advocate for a "Data-First" culture. This involves creating communication plans, training, and feedback loops to help the organization understand and adapt to key data governance concepts and overcome resistance. Collaborate with domain teams to embed data governance deliverables into data delivery efforts. Metric Development: Define and track "Activation KPIs"—going beyond just data quality scores to measure user adoption, metadata completeness, and the speed of data issue resolution, etc. Cross-Functional Liaison: Work closely with business and IT stakeholders, including domain and divisional business teams , analytics teams, data delivery teams, platform team and data privacy, legal and CISO team, to ensure data governance supports—rather than hinders—business agility. 

Required Qualifications:

Completed Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Business Administration or a related field. Minimum 8 years of work experience in large data transformation programs focusing on data governance and data quality

Preferred Qualifications:

Proven ability to manage multiple business stakeholders, including effectively engaging and aligning with enterprise senior leadership to drive data governance initiatives and strategies in line with the overall organizational goals. Ability to influence without authority and drive change adoption for data governance framework, processes and supporting toolsAbility to break down complex data concepts to non-technical stakeholders, with strong business acumen and domain knowledge (e.g. Customer Development/Sales) in CPG industry Exceptional critical thinking and problem-solving abilities, coupled with a keen eye for detail and a commitment to delivering high quality data Experience with data catalog and data quality platform such as Atlan, BigID, Collibra, Informatica, Talend, SAP, DQLabs, Monte Carlo or a similar solution requiredExtensive knowledge of data management and data governance principles, implementations and latest industry trends. 

Compensation And Benefits

Salary Range $124,000.00 - $174,000.00 USD

Pay is determined based on experience, qualifications, and location. Salaried employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses, profit-sharing, and long-term incentives for Executive-level roles.

Benefits: Salaried employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, basic life insurance, paid parental leave, disability coverage, and participation in the 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions subject to eligibility requirements. Additional benefits include a minimum of 15 vacation/PTO days (hourly employees receive a minimum of 120 hours) and 13 paid holidays (vacation days are prorated based on the employee's hire date within the calendar year). Paid sick leave is adjusted based on role and location in accordance with local laws. Detailed information regarding paid sick leave entitlements will be provided to employees upon hiring and may be subject to adjustments based on changes in legislation or company policies.

Our journey begins with our people—developing strong talent with diverse backgrounds and perspectives to best serve our consumers around the world and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging. We are dedicated to ensuring that each individual can be their authentic self, is treated with respect, and is empowered by leadership to contribute meaningfully to our business.

We have an amazing opportunity in our Louisville, CO or White Plains, NY offices for a Manager, Internal Control. Your focus will be the Sourcing and Finance business processes and control evaluation, with operations testing/traveling and other macroprocess support, as needed. Your Day to Day and The Future

Operational Integration: Embed procurement rigor into the supply chain by balancing inventory and working capital requirements, while maintaining strict adherence to EOHS, Quality, and Regulatory compliance standards. Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

The Infrastructure and Platform Services (IPS) group, part of EA’s Central Tech organization, powers the platforms behind EA’s global game ecosystem. From Cloud to Commerce, Gameplay Services, Identity, Social and AI Platform, we provide reusable capabilities that let game teams focus on building world-class experiences. We’re behind the curtain, making it all work together. Come power the future of play with us.

Within IPS, the AI Platform team builds the foundational capabilities that power AI and machine learning across EA across Core AI, Generative AI and Agentic AI. We provide the underlying systems for data, compute, and features that enable teams to train and access models efficiently, deploy them reliably, and operate at scale. At a company level, we are responsible for developing AI platform foundations, governance and reusable enterprise AI capabilities - in particular, paved roads for agentic AI. Our mission is to make it simple, secure and cost-effective for product teams, data scientists, and researchers to use large-scale AI workflows and unlock new player and developer experiences.

As a Principal Product Manager for the AI Platform, you will report into a Product Director, leading innovation and influencing stakeholders across the company to develop and evangelize foundational enterprise AI capabilities. You will shape and implement platform capabilities that make it easier for product teams to onboard and operate AI tools, while ensuring governance through key control points such as identity, MCP registry, agent registries, a model gateway and observability.

rows.title: Research Manager - Sampling & Survey Methodology
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Make Your Mark at Ipsos

Do you have expertise in survey research methods and quantitative research principles?

Ipsos is recruiting a Quantitative Research Manager to work within our Probability Surveys Unit (PSU). The PSU designs and manages some of the largest and most technically complex government studies.

This is an exciting opportunity for a quantitative researcher skilled in survey methodology, sampling and weighting. We are seeking someone with Knowledge of sampling and/or weighting approaches used in social, public affairs, market or academic research and experience working with large datasets and using SPSS, R, Stata or similar statistical software.

What is in it for you?

You Will Get The Opportunity To

Play a key role in designing and deliver high-quality random probability work through our online probability panel the KnowledgePanel as well as ad-hoc research. Contribute to the design, implementation and continuous improvement of survey methodologiesChallenge existing processes and seek to develop innovative improvements.Get exposure to the entire breath of Ipsos policy research, from politics, to public services, employment and welfare, transport, climate change and energy, societal attitudes and many more. 

The role

Role

These are the types of things you can expect to be doing during your day to day, though, as Ipsos is a dynamic organisation, we would encourage you to shape the role as other opportunities arise:

Working with the UK KnowledgePanel, Ipsos’s online random probability panel, to create sampling frames and draw random probability samples to maintain nationally representative samples.Supporting our Probability Surveys Unit to deliver large, complex probability surveys through sampling, weighting and methodological innovation.Collating and managing population data from official ONS statistics and other large scale probability surveys to support weighting methods.Writing clear and concise technical reports, documenting your activities, setting out objectives, challenges and solutions.Explaining complex methods clearly to clients and other non-technical colleagues.Work with junior staff to help develop their methodological and statistical skills.Lead and contribute to innovation work, keeping abreast of new relevant developments and aiming to continually improve processes and qualityContributing to the design of experimental approaches to deliver methodological innovations and efficiencies.You will use Ipsos’ in-house AI to support your work and help to develop AI agentic solutions.You will be supported by experienced staff who will provide support and guidance.

Essential Skills

Strong understanding of survey research methods and quantitative research principles.Knowledge of sampling and/or weighting approaches used in social, public affairs, market or academic research.Experience working with large datasets and using SPSS, R, Stata or similar statistical software.Strong statistical aptitude and confidence working with quantitative data.Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously, while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.Degree-level qualification or above in a quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Social Research Methods, Mathematics, Economics, Psychology, Data Science or a related subject, or equivalent relevant experience.

Desirable Skills

Experience designing or implementing survey samples for probability-based or random probability studies.Experience developing, applying or evaluating survey weights.Understanding of survey error, non-response bias, coverage error and weighting adjustment techniques.Experience working with online panels, longitudinal studies or official statistics.Experience of process automation, reproducible workflows, scripting or systems development. Experience developing technical documentation, methodological reports or survey standards.Experience contributing methodological expertise to proposals, bids or client presentations.Knowledge of multivariate statistical techniques and survey data analysis e.g. factor analysis, clustering, regressions, multilevel models

Benefits

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you as an individual. Our standard benefits include 25 days annual leave, pension contribution, income protection and life assurance. In addition, there are a range health & wellbeing, financial benefits and professional development opportunities.

We have a hybrid approach to work and ask people to be in the office or with clients for 3 days per week. We appreciate you may have commitments outside of work and will consider flexible working applications - please highlight what you are looking for when you make your application.

We are committed to equality, treating people fairly, promoting a positive and inclusive working environment and ensuring we have diversity of people and views. We recognise that this is important for our business success - a more diverse workforce will enable us to better reflect and understand the world we research and ultimately deliver better research and insight to our clients. We are proud to be a member of the Disability Confident scheme, certified as a Level 2 Disability Confident Employer. We provide an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Your application will be reviewed by someone from our Talent Team who will be in touch either way to let you know the outcome.

Ready to have an impact? Apply now!

About Us

Ipsos is one of the world’s largest research companies and currently the only one primarily managed by researchers, ranking as a #1 full-service research organization for four consecutive years. With over 75 different data-driven solutions, and presence in 90 markets, Ipsos brings together research, implementation, methodological, and subject-matter experts from around the world, combining thematic and technical experts to deliver top-quality research and insights. Simply speaking, we help the biggest companies solve some of their biggest problems, serving more than 5000 clients across the globe by providing research, data, and insights on their target markets. And we are proud of our continuous efforts in making Ipsos the best place to work!

About The Team

The Public Affairs Service Line is the world leader in Social and Opinion Research.We work with clients on political and public opinion polling, citizen and stakeholder management, social policy improvement, sustainable development strategy and identifying societal trends and perceptions across several sectors.We assess how government and public affairs policies as well as societal trends and views impact our client’s brand/products/markets.

Overview

As the Director, Product Management, you will lead product strategy and execution for Reporting & Measurement within Epsilon’s Campaign Diversity team. Reporting to the VP of Campaign Diversity, you will lead the evolution of Epsilon’s reporting and measurement capabilities so campaign results are faster, easier to understand, and better aligned with the third-party environments clients already use to judge performance. This role will focus on near-real-time reporting, self-service dashboards, third-party measurement integrations, and the productization of KPI, evidence, and source-of-truth logic across internal and client-facing workflows.

This role will play a key part in shaping the future of Epsilon’s performance layer. Success will require translating the needs of internal operators, agencies, clients, and commercial collaborators into a clear product strategy. This strategy reduces reporting friction, strengthens measurement credibility, and improves Epsilon's performance in independent measurement environments. You will define priorities and coordinate collaborators. You will lead product development to improve reporting speed, consistency of important metrics, and confidence in the signals used for optimization and performance review.

This is a highly strategic role that requires a resourceful product leader with strong judgment, organizational savvy, self-motivation, and excellent communication skills. You will have a proven track record of driving product strategy and disciplined execution, with the ability to move confidently between long-term capability planning and the practical realities of improving workflows that teams rely on every day.

rows.title: Director, International Pricing and Revenue Management
rows.descriptionText:
Domino’s Pizza, which began in 1960 as a single store location in Ypsilanti, MI, has had a lot to celebrate lately: we’re a reshaped, reenergized brand of honesty, transparency and accountability – not to mention, great food! In the rise to becoming a true technology leader, the brand is now consistently one of the top five companies in online transactions and 65% of our sales in the U.S. are taken through digital channels. The brand continues to ‘deliver the dream’ to local business owners, 90% of which started as delivery drivers and pizza makers in our stores. That’s just the tip of the iceberg…or as we might say, one “slice” of the pie! If this sounds like a brand you’d like to be a part of, consider joining our team!

Job Description

The International Pricing & Revenue Management Director partners with Master Franchisee (MFZ) organizations and Domino’s Pizza International (DPI) teams to define, influence, and support pricing strategies that maximize revenue, profitability, and long-term market competitiveness.

This role will leverage data analytics, consumer insights, and competitive intelligence to optimize menu pricing, promotions, and value positioning while balancing brand perception and traffic. Acting as a trusted strategic advisor, the Director helps shape Domino’s international point of view on Pricing and Revenue Management, builds scalable knowledge and tools, and leads a high performing international pricing consulting team.

The ideal candidate will have a proven history of driving revenue growth through data-driven pricing strategies. and showcasing exceptional leadership, collaboration, and influencing abilities at senior levels across diverse markets. The role operates within a broad collaboration network, working alongside International Markets leadership, Business Teams, Brand and Digital COEs, and external aggregator partners.

General Responsibilities

Strategic Pricing & Revenue Management:

Support international markets in defining, refining, and optimizing pricing strategies to optimize revenue and profitability across all menu categories and channels. Provide hands‑on strategic pricing consulting to priority markets, from opportunity assessment through execution support. Leverage competitive benchmarking, market trends, and economic factors to inform pricing decisions. Collaborate with finance, marketing, operations, and supply chain teams to align pricing strategies with business objectives. Lead A/B testing and price elasticity studies to assess the impact of price changes on demand and profitability. Drive menu optimization initiatives to enhance overall value perception and sales mix. Utilize data analytics and modeling to evaluate pricing effectiveness and identify growth opportunities. Develop and track key pricing performance indicators (KPIs) to measure success. Conduct margin analysis to ensure price adjustments align with cost structures and profit goals while balancing long-term market share growth. Monitor industry trends, competitor pricing, and consumer behavior to stay ahead of market dynamics. Assess macroeconomic factors such as inflation, commodity costs, and wage trends to adjust pricing strategies. Lead and continuously improve consumer research methodologies to assess willingness to pay and to optimize menu pricing and coupon / offer constellation

Knowledge Development and Deployment:

Develop and evolve pricing guidelines and frameworks to drive customer-centric and competition-aware pricing strategies and decisions in our international marketsConsolidate learnings and best practices from U.S. and international markets into scalable frameworks, playbooks, and guidance. Develop and maintain standards, tools, and resources that enable markets to define consumer-validated and competition-informed pricing strategies and execute consistently and effectively across channels. Facilitate structured knowledge‑sharing forums to accelerate learning and adoption within DPI and across International Markets

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration:

Serve as the pricing thought leader, influencing senior executives and franchise partners. Oversee and develop partnerships with external Pricing or Revenue Management consulting firms or service providers. Work closely with marketing in DPI and MFZ organizations to align pricing with brand positioning, value messaging, and promotional strategy. Lead and recruit a strong team of pricing analysts and develop talent by offering constructive and actionable feedback and creating opportunities for learning. Foster a collaborative culture and lead with a unified and ambitious vision. Recognize, engage, and motivate team members. Encourage transparent communication and mutual respect among team members and stakeholders. 

Qualifications

Strong academic credentials, Bachelor’s Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Business Administration or other related field, Masters or MBA strongly preferred15+ years of experience in pricing strategy, revenue management, or analytics, preferably in QSR, retail, or consumer goods. Strong analytical and financial acumen, with expertise in SQL, Excel, or similar data tools. Proven track record of driving revenue growth through data-driven pricing strategies:Experience with price elasticity modeling, A/B testing, and machine learning-driven pricing optimization is a plus. Experience designing, running and analyzing customer quantitative surveys to determine pricing strategies is advantageous. Demonstrated ownership to drive content and action through proactive problem-solving, pragmatism, and the ability to handle ambiguity with a continuous learning mindset. Solid project management skills and attention to detail. A history of leading and developing high-performance teams. Ability to thrive in a collaborative, complex cross-functional team environment. Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and franchise partners. Experience working across multiple Geographies and Regions

Additional Information

Benefits:

 Paid Holidays and Vacation   Medical, Dental & Vision benefits that start on the first day of employment No-cost mental health support for employee and dependents Childcare tuition discounts No-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs Fertility benefits Adoption assistance 401k matching contributions   15% off the purchase price of stock   Company bonus  

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Teamwork makes the stream work. Roku is changing how the world watches TVRoku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines. Our work ships to hundreds of millions of devices worldwide.We move fast and hold a high bar. Engineers on this team own features end-to-end — from the OS platform layer through BrightScript/SceneGraph UI to cloud integration — and collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional engineering partners to bring ambitious ideas to production at scale.

You will drive architecture and delivery across the OS client stack: SceneGraph component framework, performance and memory optimization, and the user-facing experiences built on top of it. For California Only - The estimated annual base salary for this position is between $370,000 - $400,000 annually. Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location.
